2025-12.daily_overview: On the first day of December, after her morning yoga and meditation, Sun Yuwei went to Mingyuan Bookstore to do the year's final workspace maintenance, making her work area warm and orderly. After finishing communication on publication details with editor Xu Mingyuan, she also published her first watercolor painting tutorial on the official account, trying a content transformation. In the evening, she took a walk around Green Lake with her parents as usual.

She took photos as a memento and wrote in her journal: "In this small space, I have kept my flow."

The article introduced in detail the tool list for self-taught watercolor, basic techniques, and how to combine them with journaling, and included step-by-step images of the Erhai sunset painting and journal page layout results. 2025-12.daily_overview: On Friday, Sun Yuwei reached a milestone in her writing career: in the morning, she received, in her home mailbox, a letter of intent for a publishing contract for 'Slow Travel Notes' from the publisher. After checking repeatedly, she immediately video-called her parents to share the news, then took the bus home and hugged her family tightly in celebration. In the afternoon, she attended a newly added Friday yoga class (to coordinate next week's schedule adjustments), and shared the good news with Director He Lu after class. In the evening, the whole family went out for a mushroom hot pot to celebrate, overflowing with happiness.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation
events.description: The morning proceeded as usual. Sun Yuwei felt inner peace during meditation, which set the stage for the upcoming surprise.

events.name: Received the letter of intent for the publishing contract of Slow Travel Notes.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei logged into her email at her desk in Mingyuan Bookstore and found a formal email from a publisher expressing intent to offer a publishing contract for 'Slow Travel Notes', planned for release in spring 2026 with an initial print run of 2,000 copies. She read it three times to make sure there were no mistakes, was thrilled, and immediately took a screenshot and saved it.

events.name: Video call with parents to share the good news
events.description: After confirming the email, Sun Yuwei, her hands trembling, dialed a video call on her phone. On the screen, her mother Li Xiulan covered her mouth and tears fell when she saw the news; her father Sun Mingyuan nodded repeatedly, too excited to speak coherently. She shared the good news with her family and thanked them for their silent support over the years.

events.name: Returned home and hugged my parents to celebrate.
events.description: After hanging up the video call, Sun Yuwei immediately set out from the study and walked about 20 minutes back to her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District. As soon as she entered, she tightly embraced her mother and father, who had been waiting in the living room. The three were moved to tears; years of writing had finally come to light.

events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei happily attended the extra Friday class that the yoga studio had added this week and was especially focused during the practice. After class, she told her mentor, Director He Lu, the good news about the publication. He Lu was happy for her and encouraged her to continue cultivating herself through writing.

events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and her parents went to the mushroom hot pot restaurant they often visited near their community to celebrate. At the table, her parents felt proud of their daughter, and the three of them discussed the first print run of the new book and the promotional plans for next spring. The atmosphere was warm and lively.

events.name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
events.description: After the celebration, the three of them took a walk around Cuihu Lake under the streetlights. In the night, her father uncharacteristically hummed an old song.

end_state.mood: Grateful and happy

Then she logged into her email, found the submission address of the literary editor of Dianchi magazine, and wrote a greeting email with the feeling of "a New Year's gift," sending the two polished essays as attachments.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation

Sun Yuwei felt deeply honored, agreed immediately, and asked about the deadline, December 14, and the delivery method. After the call, she began to plan her upcoming work schedule.

She reviewed artist materials, studied planning proposals, took extensive notes, and formed an initial structure. That evening she went home to report her progress to Chen Sisi and receive more material. There was no yoga class today (it had been moved to Friday), but she still kept up her evening walk.

events.name: Do research for the exhibition foreword at the Municipal Library.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei took her notebook and computer to Kunming City Library. First, in the art literature section, she looked up the personal backgrounds, artistic resumes, past exhibition records, and representative work images of the participating artists, and recorded key information by taking photos with her phone and writing notes by hand. In the afternoon, she continued reading the exhibition planning proposal provided by Chen Sisi, understanding the overall structure of the exhibition and the curatorial logic behind each piece, accumulating rich material for writing the preface later. She spent the whole day at the library and didn't leave until it closed.

events.description: Back home in the evening, Sun Yuwei organized the day's notes and structural outline into an electronic document, briefly reported her progress to Chen Sisi via WeChat, and exchanged a few key concepts. Chen Sisi quickly replied with approval and also sent more high-resolution images of the works and artist interview records. Sun Yuwei archived them for use the next day.

events.name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
events.description: After returning from the library, Sun Yuwei took time to accompany her parents on a walk. Although she was a bit tired, the lake breeze refreshed her mind.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Friday morning, after her morning yoga meditation, Sun Yuwei continued writing the preface at home. In the afternoon, she went to Mingyuan Bookstore and had a breakthrough after exchanging ideas with Qin Mingyuan. Unexpectedly, on her way home from the bookstore in the evening, her phone slipped out of her hand and fell, shattering the outer screen. She changed her plans and went to the repair shop, and while waiting, chatted with the technician about digital dependence. That evening, she used the photo of the cracked screen to develop a new essay. Her original Friday yoga class was canceled because of the accident, but she still did breathing exercises before bed.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation
events.description: Completed at 6:15. Today's meditation theme was accepting impermanence.

events.name: Wrote the exhibition foreword at home in the morning.
events.description: Sun Yuwei continued writing the exhibition foreword in her study, blending the artist backgrounds she had researched yesterday with the exhibition theme Urban Memory and Reconstruction. When she had written about 1,000 words, she felt slightly stuck and decided to go to Mingyuan Bookstore in the afternoon for a change of scenery and to find inspiration.

events.name: Afternoon: exchange and breakthrough at Mingyuan Bookstore.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went to Mingyuan Bookstore and discussed the idea for the preface with Qin Mingyuan. Qin Mingyuan suggested using the imagery of 'memory fragments' to connect the works of the various artists, which made her suddenly enlightened. She then revised and continued with two more paragraphs at her desk in the bookstore.

events.name: On the way home in the evening, my phone screen accidentally shattered.
events.description: In the evening, on the walk home from Mingyuan Bookstore, on the bluestone-paved Wenlin Street in Wuhua District, Sun Yuwei took out her phone to check a message when the shoulder strap of her messenger bag suddenly slipped off, causing the phone to drop from her hand and hit the ground. She picked it up at once and found the outer screen on the upper-left corner cracked, but the touch and display functions were both normal. Helplessly, she photographed the play of light on the broken screen as a keepsake.

events.name: Go to the phone repair shop, prompting thoughts about digital dependence.
events.description: Sun Yuwei walked about 10 minutes with her damaged phone to the Xunjie Mobile Phone Repair shop near Renmin Middle Road. Master Li, the shop owner, checked it and concluded that only the outer screen needed replacing. He quoted 270 yuan and said it would take about an hour. While waiting, she chatted with Master Li about modern people's dependence on phones. Master Li sighed, I repair more than a dozen screens a day, all from carelessness. She shared her views on digital life, and these conversations later became inspiration for her essays. After it was repaired, she paid 270 yuan by scanning a QR code and left. Because of the repair delay, she missed today's Friday yoga class.

events.name: In the evening, plan the essay Fragments
events.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei used her backup phone to search for the official screen replacement policy for that model and saved it for later use, then transferred the light-and-shadow photos taken before the screen cracked to her computer. Looking at the cracks, inspiration struck, and she decided to use this incident as a starting point for an essay about digital fragility. She drafted the opening and structure on her computer, with a working title of "Fragments." Before bed, she did a 10-minute breathing exercise to calm herself down.

events.name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
events.description: Despite her phone trouble, Sun Yuwei hurried home after the repair and insisted on accompanying her parents for a walk around Cuihu Lake, pouring out the day's misfortunes.

end_state.mood: Calm after the accident

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga meditation for 15 minutes; in the evening, a 40-minute walk with parents around Green Lake.

In the afternoon, she was invited to a literary salon at Green Lake Café, broadening her social circle; afterward, she returned to the bookstore and talked at length with Qin Mingyuan, jointly planning a “Digital Detox Hour” event for next January and sketching a poster. In the evening, she finally finished the remaining part of the exhibition preface, ready for the next day's delivery.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation
events.description: Conducted at 6:10; meditation on a cloudy day brings inner sunshine.

events.name: Cross-training: brisk walking in the park
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei did a 30-minute brisk walk in Green Lake Park, with a pace of 9 minutes per kilometer. Despite the cold and overcast weather, her body warmed up quickly.

events.name: In the morning, picked up the phone at the repair shop and went to the bookstore.
events.description: Sun Yuwei went to the official authorized store in the morning as scheduled to pick up her phone whose outer screen had been replaced; it worked perfectly. She then walked directly to Mingyuan Bookstore. After arriving, she ordered a cup of hot tea and sat down at her usual window-side workstation.

events.name: Write the essay "Fragments" and post it on Xiaohongshu.
events.description: At her seat in Mingyuan Bookstore, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and expanded last night's inspiration into a short essay, 'Fragments'. Starting from the cracked-screen incident, she reflected on the fragility of digital life and the memories and creativity that screens carry. After finishing, she photographed that cracked light-and-shadow image with her phone to use as an illustration, edited it, and posted it to her personal Xiaohongshu account 'Yuwei's Slow Record'. Within hours of posting, she received nearly a hundred comments; readers shared their own cracked-screen stories, and she replied to them one by one, creating a lively interaction.

events.name: Attend the Green Lake Literary Afternoon Tea Salon.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei was invited by a member of her writing group to an art and literature salon at a café near Green Lake. The salon brought together several local art and literary enthusiasts, including writers, independent bookstore readers, and illustrators. At the salon, she talked with everyone about essay writing, local culture, and Yunnan cuisine, made new friends, and gained creative inspiration.

events.name: Planned a 'one-hour digital detox' with Qin Mingyuan and drew a poster sketch in the journal
events.description: After the salon ended, Sun Yuwei returned to Mingyuan Bookstore and had an in-depth discussion with Qin Mingyuan about the essay Fragments. Qin Mingyuan remarked that it was common to see customers in the bookstore with their heads down, scrolling through their phones. The two talked about digital dependency, the warmth of paper books, and the value of deep reading. Based on their shared understanding, they decided to embed a one-hour digital detox session into next January's reading club: participants would check their phones at the door and focus on reading and face-to-face communication. They discussed the event flow and promotional approach. Sun Yuwei sketched a draft of the event poster in her journal, and Qin Mingyuan smiled and added a few strokes to refine the composition.

events.name: Returned home in the evening and completed the first draft of the exhibition preface.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei packed up her things, said goodbye to Qin Mingyuan, and walked home. At night, in the study, she combined all the day's inspiration and finished the rest of the exhibition foreword in one go, about 1,500 characters in total. After reading through and checking it, she backed it up and saved it, planning to do the final polish and delivery tomorrow.

events.name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
events.description: Although today was packed with social activities, Sun Yuwei still went out with her parents after dinner. After the rain, Green Lake was especially fresh.

start_state.mood: With lingering annoyance over the cracked screen but looking forward to creating

end_state.mood: Excitement and satisfaction after creative work and socializing

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga and meditation for 15 minutes, brisk walking in Cuihu Park for 30 minutes, a fair amount of walking totaling about 5 kilometers, and a 40-minute evening stroll around Cuihu with her parents.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Sun Yuwei did morning yoga and meditation and went on a 9-kilometer long run (a new distance breakthrough). After returning home, she gave the foreword a final polish and sent it to Chen Sisi. Sisi's extreme satisfaction made her feel a huge sense of relief. In the afternoon, she attended the art exhibition preview as a VIP guest. Seeing her words printed on the entrance exhibition wall, she took a photo with Chen Sisi as a memento. In the evening, she began reading the literature recommended by her advisor to prepare for tomorrow's academic discussion.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation
events.description: Start promptly at 6:00, preparing body and mind for the long run.

events.name: Long slow run, 9 kilometers
events.description: At 6:30, Sun Yuwei completed a 9 km jog on the Cuihu Lake–Panlong River greenway, with a pace of 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. She felt a bit tired along the way but kept going, finishing just one step short of her 10 km goal. After the run, she stretched thoroughly.

events.name: Delivered the exhibition foreword and received positive feedback from Chen Sisi.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei made final polishes and additions to the draft exhibition foreword in her home study, repeatedly checking grammar and punctuation, and refined the full text to 1,500 characters. At noon, she sent the final version to Chen Sisi via WeChat. After reading it, Chen Sisi was very satisfied and confirmed that the foreword would be printed with the exhibition brochure and displayed on the entrance wall on the opening day. Sun Yuwei felt relieved; this task, created for a close friend, had been successfully completed.

events.name: Visit the VIP preview of the art exhibition
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei was invited to the VIP preview of the contemporary art exhibition 'Urban Memory and Reconstruction' curated by Chen Sisi. As she entered the exhibition hall, she saw that the preface she had written was enlarged and printed on the huge wall at the entrance, with many visitors stopping to read it. In her opening speech, Chen Sisi specifically thanked her for her written support. The two took a photo together in front of the display panel, as friendship and professional collaboration elevated each other.

events.name: Read the literature recommended by my supervisor in the evening.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei opened CNKI in her study, downloaded and read the two papers that her supervisor Professor Wu Mingyuan had mentioned on WeChat: "The Rural Gene in Contemporary Yunnan Prose" and "The Subjectivity Construction of Regional Narrative". She took detailed reading notes to fully prepare for tomorrow afternoon's academic discussion.

events.name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
events.description: Despite returning late from the exhibition preview, Sun Yuwei still went for a walk with her parents and shared what she had seen at the exhibition.

end_state.mood: Sense of accomplishment and calm after completing the task

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga and meditation for 15 minutes, a 9 km long run (pace 7'30"), and a 40-minute walk around Green Lake with parents in the evening.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, after morning yoga and meditation, Sun Yuwei jogged 5 kilometers along Cuihu Lake and conceived her essay Pace. In the morning, she handled the fund investment deduction and bookkeeping, and began writing the year-end closing column. In the afternoon, after organizing her notes on Yunnan essays, she went to Yunnan University to discuss her academic year paper topic with Professor Wu Mingyuan, settling on the direction of regional writing in contemporary Yunnan essays. In the evening, she compiled the discussion into digital notes and made a winter vacation reading plan. Before bed, she did gratitude meditation and journaling. Today her weight reached 47.5 kg, and her healthy weight-gain plan is progressing steadily.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation
events.description: Starting at 6:00, Sun Yuwei began her new day with breathing meditation and stretching.

events.name: Morning jog around Cuihu Lake and writing the essay Pace.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei changed into her sportswear and jogged 5 kilometers around Green Lake Park in the crisp winter air of Kunming. She matched her breathing rhythm to her stride, watched the city waking in the morning light, and after the run immediately noted keywords in her phone's memo app. Back home, while the feeling was fresh, she turned her thoughts into an essay, "Pace," depicting the city's morning light through a runner's eyes.

events.name: Handle fund regular investment and bookkeeping
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei's fund investment account was automatically debited 500 yuan at the preset time to purchase the CSI 300 index fund. After receiving the bank debit notification, she opened the expense-tracking app Suishouji and added an investment expense record with the note: December CSI 300 auto-investment. Then she switched to the budget page, checked the execution of this month's budget items, confirmed that the monthly savings goal was half completed, and felt satisfied with her financial situation.

events.name: Write the year-end closing column article.
events.description: Starting at 11 a.m., Sun Yuwei began writing her year-end column article "Looking Back at 2025: A Freelance Writer's Desk" at her study workstation. She summarized her writing trajectory, travel gains, and personal growth over the past year, reflected on her shortcomings, and outlined key priorities for 2026 at the end of the article. In the meantime, she also communicated with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat about their collaboration plans for next year.

events.name: Organizing Yunnan essay notes to prepare for the thesis discussion.
events.description: After finishing the column, Sun Yuwei organized in her study the notes she had taken on previously read Yunnan contemporary prose writers such as Yu Jian and Lei Pingyang, sorted out possible entry points for regional writing, and drafted several key points for a thesis topic, to prepare for the afternoon meeting with her advisor.

events.name: Finalized the academic year thesis topic with advisor Wu Mingyuan.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei arrived at Professor Wu Mingyuan's office in the School of Liberal Arts at Yunnan University at the agreed time, and reported to her advisor her interest in researching regional writing in contemporary Yunnan prose. Professor Wu fully affirmed the value of the topic, suggested she focus on reading works by authors such as Yu Jian and Lei Pingyang, and recommended 5 core references on the spot. The two exchanged preliminary views on the research framework and agreed to submit the thesis proposal before the winter vacation.

events.name: Organized the discussion notes from the supervisor and planned the next steps.
events.description: Back home in the evening, Sun Yuwei organized the afternoon's discussion with Professor Wu into an electronic document, including the confirmed topic direction, key writers, and a list of recommended literature, and created a mind map. She annotated the materials she needed to look up next and drew up a detailed reading and research plan for the first three weeks of winter break.

events.name: Gratitude meditation and journaling before bed
events.description: Before going to bed, Sun Yuwei opened her journal and wrote down three things she was grateful for today: 1) a rewarding discussion with her advisor; 2) feeling free during her morning run; 3) successfully completing her column article. Then she used the Tide app for a 5-minute meditation and fell asleep with a peaceful mind.

events.name: Evening walk with parents at Green Lake
events.description: In the evening, she went for a walk as usual. Sun Yuwei shared the takeaways from her meeting with her advisor with her parents, who encouraged her to focus on academics.

end_state.mood: Peace after a bountiful harvest

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga and meditation for 15 minutes, a 5 km morning run, and a 40-minute evening walk with my parents around Cuihu Lake

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 16, Sun Yuwei started an energetic day with a morning run, then went to the library to gather literature for her academic year thesis, and advanced the publication process of her essay collection through online communication. In the evening yoga class, she successfully performed a headstand for the first time, achieving a breakthrough in the pose.

events.name: Early morning jog along the Panlong River.
events.description: At 6:20 in the morning, Sun Yuwei put on her running shoes and jogged 5.5 kilometers along the greenway beside the Panlong River, keeping a steady pace of 7:05 per kilometer. She did dynamic stretches before the run and static stretches after, with her sports watch recording the data. The winter morning wind was crisp; she wore gloves and earmuffs, and after the run she walked slowly along the riverbank to cool down.

events.name: Went to the Yunnan University library to borrow essay collections and research works.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei went to the Yunnan University Library. Using the book list provided by her advisor Wu Mingyuan, she searched the collection system and borrowed five prose collections and related research works, including Yu Jian's "On This Side of Yunnan" and Lei Pingyang's "The Order of the Yunnan Dusk", to gather material for her thesis proposal. She also browsed the tables of contents of some books in the reading area and preliminarily marked key chapters.

events.name: Discussed the publication progress of the essay collection with editor Xu Mingyuan.
events.description: After returning from the library in the morning, Sun Yuwei communicated with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat about the publication progress of "Slow Travel Notes," learning the publisher's current feedback and follow-up arrangements and that everything was moving forward as planned.

events.name: Submitting the final draft and preface of 'Slow Travel Notes'
events.description: Sun Yuwei formally sent the final manuscript and author’s preface of “Slow Travel Notes,” revised according to the editor’s feedback, to Xu Mingyuan by email, marking the manuscript’s entry into the publisher’s review process. In the email, she also stated her expectations for the following milestones.

events.name: Discuss cover design and promotional copy.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei and Xu Mingyuan continued their detailed discussion of the cover design and promotional copy for 'Slow Travel Notes,' exchanging their ideas and suggestions for revisions, and initially settling on a fresh, literary visual direction.

events.name: Set a time for the publishing house's internal topic-selection meeting
events.description: After communication, Sun Yuwei and Xu Mingyuan agreed to hold an internal topic-selection meeting at the publishing house next week to further advance the publication plan for 'Slow Travel Notes.' She recorded the time in her journal and gained a clearer understanding of the process.

events.name: First successful unassisted headstand in yoga class
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei went to Jingxin Yoga Studio for the Tuesday yoga class. Under the guidance and protection of instructor He Lu, she successfully completed an unsupported headstand for the first time and held it for 30 seconds, an important milestone in her asana practice. After class, she practiced Ujjayi breathing and drank ginger and red date tea.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming
start_state.mood: Anticipation mixed with slight nervousness, as she awaits publication feedback

Based on her advisor's suggestions and borrowed literature, she established the basic framework of the paper. In the evening, she accompanied her parents for a walk around Green Lake to relieve the fatigue of sitting for long hours, and read to relax at night.

events.name: Write the first draft of the academic-year thesis proposal.
events.description: On December 17, in her home study in Kunming, Sun Yuwei devoted herself to writing the first draft of her term paper proposal, based on her advisor's guidance and relevant literature. She focused on sorting out the research status, research significance, and preliminary framework of regional writing in contemporary Yunnan prose. She completed the main content of the draft in one day and planned to refine and submit it before the winter vacation. During breaks, she brewed a cup of black tea to refresh herself.

events.name: Evening walk around Green Lake
events.description: At 18:00, Sun Yuwei walked with her parents in Green Lake Park, strolling slowly for about 40 minutes and talking about what they had seen and heard during the day. Her father mentioned a colleague at his workplace who was about to retire, and her mother asked about her thesis progress. The family of three enjoyed a peaceful time in the winter sunset.

events.name: Evening reading and relaxation
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei did not continue her thesis proposal work. Instead, she sat down on the living room sofa and read Yu Jian's This Side of Yunnan, flipping through a few pieces at random to switch her brain's channel and enjoy a moment of peace.

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 18, Sun Yuwei took the final exam for Modern Chinese Literary History and performed steadily. Before the exam, she had insomnia due to anxiety over the publisher's topic-selection meeting. She used mindfulness meditation and a gratitude journal to calm her anxiety, and from then on began a bedtime gratitude ritual that lasted until the end of the month.

events.name: Morning easy run around Green Lake
events.description: At 6:10 in the morning, because she had an exam that morning, Sun Yuwei only went for a light 3-kilometer jog (pace 7 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer). She breathed fresh air by Cuihu Lake, did some simple stretching, and then went home to freshen up and prepare for the exam.

events.name: Taking the final exam in Modern Chinese Literary History
events.description: On the morning of December 18, from 9:00 to 11:00, Sun Yuwei took the final exam for Modern Chinese Literature History in the First Teaching Building of Yunnan University. She answered calmly. One question on the paper asked for an analysis of the artistic characteristics of Shen Congwen's “Border Town.” Combining her review accumulation and personal understanding, she completed the discussion in an organized manner and felt good after the exam. After submitting the paper, she briefly exchanged a few words with classmates.

events.name: For pre-exam insomnia, did mindfulness meditation and gratitude journaling.
events.description: On the evening of December 18, Sun Yuwei was anxious and unable to sleep because she was waiting for feedback from the publisher's topic-selection meeting. She remembered the mindful breathing technique learned in yoga class, so she sat cross-legged on her bed in the bedroom, opened the Tide app, and followed a 10-minute guided meditation for breathing relaxation. After meditating, she opened her journal and wrote down three small things to be grateful for (the delicious milk tea she drank during the day, the encouraging WeChat message from a friend, and the beautiful sunset seen outside the window). This successfully eased her anxiety. For the first time, she combined meditation and a gratitude journal into a bedtime ritual and decided to persist with it every night.

events.name: Reviewing Introduction to Linguistics at home in the afternoon
events.description: After the exam, Sun Yuwei returned home, had a simple lunch, and then took out her Introduction to Linguistics notes and textbooks in the study to do targeted review for the last exam on the 22nd. She focused on reviewing the phonetics and lexicology chapters and did several practice questions.

end_state.mood: Calm and peaceful after meditation.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 3 km

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 19, Sun Yuwei carefully prepared for the next day's journal-sharing event at the community library, and attended an evening yoga class to keep her mind and body steady. In the evening she discussed details with her mother, and before bed did a gratitude journal meditation.

events.name: Prepare materials for the journal sharing session
events.description: On December 19, in the study at her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei selected representative pages from her travel journal, reading journal, and inspiration notebook, organized collage and watercolor tools and composition examples, and wrote a brief presentation outline, making full preparations for the sharing session at the Cuncaoxin Community Library the next day. She categorized the journals by theme and marked key points with sticky notes.

events.name: Went to Mingyuan Bookstore at noon in search of inspiration.
events.description: At noon, Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Bookstore to find a reference book on journal aesthetics. Qin Mingyuan wasn't there, so she browsed by the bookshelves herself and eventually borrowed "Life on Paper: The Art of Travel Journaling," and casually sketched a page of journal layout in the reading area.

events.name: Attend the regular Friday yoga class
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei went to Jingxin Yoga Studio for the Friday yoga class. Under the guidance of instructor He Lu, she did regular asana practice. After class, she practiced Ujjayi breathing and drank ginger and red date tea. During the practice, she also tried a longer Downward-Facing Dog to build arm strength.

events.name: Evening discussion with mother about the sharing session details
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei showed her mother, Li Xiulan, the journal and presentation materials she would use the next day. Her mother gave her quite a bit of encouragement and reminded her to bring a USB drive and backup materials. The mother and daughter chatted in the living room for a while.

start_state.mood: Calm, with a meticulous energy for preparation.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and looking forward to tomorrow.

2025-12.daily_overview: December 20 was a Saturday, and Sun Yuwei had a full and warm day. In the morning she held a journal-sharing session that received an enthusiastic response; in the afternoon she sorted out her reflections; in the early evening she completed a freestyle arrangement in her third flower arrangement class; in the evening she attended the year-end event of the writing group, where she was chosen to write the preface for the annual anthology, and her essay 'Pace' was also published online, interweaving a sense of community belonging with creative fulfillment.

events.name: Morning cross-training
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei did a 30-minute brisk walk along the Panlong River (pace 9 min/km) as her weekly Saturday aerobic cross-training. She felt refreshed in the morning light and bought a cup of hot soy milk afterward.

events.name: Going to the community library and buying milk tea
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei brought her prepared journal works and presentation materials and walked from her home on Renmin Middle Road to Cuncaoxin Community Library in Wuhua District. On the way, she dropped by a shop to buy a cup of brown sugar pearl milk tea, feeling relaxed and full of anticipation.

events.name: Held the second sharing session of “Life Aesthetics in Journaling.”
events.description: Sun Yuwei held the second free sharing session, “Life Aesthetics in Journaling,” in the reading room of the Cuncaoxin Community Library, for about 20 community residents. She showed travel journals, reading journals, and inspiration collection notebooks, explained collage, watercolor, and simple composition techniques on the spot, and led participants in hands-on practice. A middle-aged woman was moved by the sharing, held her hand, and said: “You remind me of myself when I was young.” The event's response exceeded expectations.

events.name: Recording reflections at home after the sharing session.
events.description: After the sharing session ended, Sun Yuwei walked home. In the afternoon, she quietly organized the day's experiences in her study. She opened her journal and wrote down the day's reflection: 'Sharing makes the beauty of solitude flow.' She also pasted in a photo from the event and a bookmark she had brought back from the library.

events.name: Attend the third ikebana experience class
events.description: From 17:30 to 19:30, Sun Yuwei attended her third flower-arranging experience class at Jingxin Yoga Studio, with the theme of free-form flower arrangement creation. Ten students each independently completed a free-form flower piece using what they had learned in the first two classes. Sun Yuwei gave feedback on each piece in turn, offering suggestions for improvement in terms of line, color, and space. After class, she discussed the next year's course plan with He Lu in the studio's rest area, and they initially decided to offer one new theme per quarter.

events.name: Attend the writing group's Saturday evening activity
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei attended the writing group's last Saturday-night activity of the year on the second floor of Mingyuan Book House. She actively joined the discussion and answered other members' questions about essay writing, fully integrated into the community by now. The group leader affirmed her growth over the year, and everyone unanimously recommended that she write the foreword for the annual anthology. She was moved and agreed. After the event, she exchanged contact information with several core members and arranged to talk individually later.

events.name: The prose essay 'Pace' was published online.
events.description: On the same day, Sun Yuwei submitted the completed essay 'Pace' to the 'Kunming Slice' column of the magazine 'Cultural Vision'. After review by editor Xu Mingyuan, it was published online on December 20, 2025. The essay reflected on the rhythm of life through running and resonated with many fellow runners.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but full of anticipation.

end_state.mood: Moved, fulfilled, with a strong sense of community belonging.

2025-12.daily_overview: On the Winter Solstice, December 21, after finishing a 9-kilometer run in the early morning, Sun Yuwei spent a warm family day with her parents. From her mother buying ingredients to the whole family wrapping dumplings and cooking and sharing them together, the ritual of the traditional solar term filled the home with warmth. After the meal, the family watched a documentary, and the plain, peaceful companionship brought the Winter Solstice to a close.

events.name: Morning long-distance run of 9 km
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei went to Green Lake Park for her weekly Sunday long slow run: 9 kilometers today, at a pace of 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. She wore a windbreaker, warmed up fully before the run, and stretched and drank warm water afterward. The long run refreshed her body and mind and gave her energy for the day's Winter Solstice activities.

events.name: Mother went to the food market to buy ingredients for the Winter Solstice.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei's mother, Li Xiulan, went to the nearby market to buy chives, eggs, cabbage, pork, flour, and other ingredients needed for making dumplings for the Winter Solstice. After returning home, she told Yuwei to get ready and make them together.

events.name: Mother and daughter made the filling and dough together
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan began preparations in the kitchen. Her mother was in charge of making the filling, preparing two kinds: chive and egg, and cabbage and pork; she chopped and seasoned them. Sun Yuwei was responsible for mixing the dough and kneading it into a smooth ball, and while the dough rested, she helped peel garlic. Her father Sun Mingyuan rested in the living room, occasionally coming in to check on their progress.

events.name: Making dumplings together as a family.
events.description: Afternoon to evening, Sun Yuwei made dumplings with her parents in the dining room. Sun Yuwei was in charge of rolling the wrappers, her mother Li Xiulan wrapped them, and her father Sun Mingyuan also joined in and wrapped a few dumplings of different shapes, while telling stories about the custom of eating dumplings at the winter solstice in their hometown and amusing anecdotes from earlier years. The family chatted as they wrapped, creating a warm scene.

events.name: Enjoy the Winter Solstice dumpling feast
events.description: After the dumplings were cooked, Sun Yuwei's family of three sat around the table enjoying the dumplings they had made by hand. Her mother had prepared a dipping sauce (vinegar, minced garlic, chili oil). They ate and chatted while commenting on the different fillings. Her father also had a little wine, and the atmosphere was congenial. Yuwei felt that their own dumplings were especially delicious.

events.name: Cleaning up after the meal and watching a nature documentary
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei cleared the dishes together with her parents, and then the family of three sat on the living room sofa and watched a nature documentary about wildlife. Sun Yuwei made hot tea, her mother brought out snacks, and her father occasionally commented on the documentary. After it ended, they chatted for a while longer, bringing the cozy Winter Solstice evening to an end.

start_state.mood: Woke up full of energy, ready for a long run.

end_state.mood: Warm, content, overflowing with family happiness.

state.daily_exercise: Morning 9-kilometer run; making dumplings at home.

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 22, Sun Yuwei finalized the first batch of design drafts for the Yunnan botanical stickers with her roommate Zhou Lin in the morning, and in the afternoon finished her last final exam — Introduction to Linguistics — formally entering her winter-break creative mode. After an evening walk with her parents, she tried posting the initial sticker designs on Xiaohongshu for the first time and received encouraging likes from Zhou Lin and her roommates.

events.name: Confirmed the botanical sticker design draft online with Zhou Lin.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei used WeChat to finalize the first batch of design drafts for the Yunnan Flora Sticker Series with her college roommate Zhou Lin (online), including patterns such as camellias, bougainvillea, and ferns. The two discussed colors, layout, and details and reached an agreement.

events.name: Scanning and retouching photos
events.description: Sun Yuwei scanned the finalized hand-painted watercolor draft using a home scanner to create a digital copy, then used photo editing software on her computer to fine-tune the colors, ensuring accurate color reproduction and alignment with the cultural creative style; she adjusted the saturation and brightness.

events.name: Print sample sheets and compare
events.description: Sun Yuwei printed a physical proof of the fine-tuned digital design using her home printer, compared it with the original hand-drawn draft, and checked whether the printed colors, details, and overall texture were consistent. Satisfied with the result.

events.name: Film the design process and draft the tutorial copy.
events.description: Sun Yuwei used her phone to take photos and short videos of the entire process from scanning and color correction to print comparison, organized the footage, and drafted copy for a beginner watercolor tutorial, planning to post it later on Xiaohongshu to pave the way for launching the cultural and creative products.

events.name: Archiving design drafts
events.description: Sun Yuwei organized the final confirmed design files (PNG/PDF formats) and physical samples into a computer folder, backed them up to the cloud, and completed the final wrap-up of the first batch of the Yunnan Plants Sticker Series.

events.name: Took the final exam for Introduction to Linguistics
events.description: On the afternoon of December 22, from 14:00 to 16:00, Sun Yuwei took the Introduction to Linguistics final exam in the No. 1 Teaching Building at Yunnan University. She arrived early to prepare. During the exam, she answered questions on phonetics, lexicology, and syntactic analysis one by one. Overall, the exam went smoothly, and she did not encounter any particularly difficult questions. After the exam, she breathed a sigh of relief; all her final exams were now over, and she felt relaxed.

events.name: Evening walk and sharing design updates.
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei took a 40-minute walk around Green Lake with her parents. After returning home, she posted a brief update on Xiaohongshu’s “Yuwei’s Slow Journal” about the sticker design process. Zhou Lin commented “Looking forward to the finished product” right away, and the roommate group chat became lively.

start_state.mood: Busy and focused, slightly stressed before the exam.

end_state.mood: Relaxed; all academic tasks completed, and a desire to create is emerging.

events.name: Morning easy run around Green Lake
