events.name: Attend Tuesday's yoga class to try the wheel pose backbend
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei attended the Tuesday yoga class at Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio in Kunming. With the assistance of her instructor He Lu, she tried the wheel pose backbend to further open her chest and shoulders. After class, she practiced Ujjayi breathing and drank ginger and red date tea.

events.name: Browsed the movie schedule and bought tickets online
events.description: After returning home from the yoga studio in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei browsed the screening schedule of an independent art cinema in Wuhua District on her phone in the study. She found that the art film Southern Afternoon was showing that evening. The film tells the story of changes in rural Yunnan, and because of her travel and fieldwork experiences, she was very interested. She immediately bought a ticket online and chose an evening seat.

events.name: Walk to the cinema
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei set out on foot from home, walked along Renmin Middle Road toward Green Lake, and arrived at the Elephant Screening Art Cinema on Wenlin Street, Wuhua District, about 20 minutes later. On the way, she wore earphones listening to the film's original soundtrack, feeling calm and expectant.

events.name: Watching the movie "Southern Afternoon"
events.description: Sun Yuwei picked up her ticket at the self-service kiosk in the cinema lobby, then passed through the ticket check to enter Theater 3 and found her seat. The movie started on time at 19:00. She watched "Southern Afternoon" with full attention, moved by the delicate rural light and shadow and the slow narrative pace, recalling her own field trips to Dali, Lijiang, and other places.

events.name: Wrote her thoughts after the film in the cinema guestbook.
events.description: After the movie ended at 21:00, Sun Yuwei walked out of the screening room, paused at the guestbook in the corridor, took out the fountain pen she carried with her, and wrote a reflection of about 200 characters, recording her impressions of the film's light-and-shadow imagery and thinking of the cultural travel essays she was working on.

events.name: Return home to document light and shadow and rest.
events.description: At 21:20, Sun Yuwei left the cinema and walked home, arriving at about 9:40 p.m. She sat at her desk and briefly recorded in her journal the light-and-shadow scenes from the film that had impressed her, and marked imagery she could draw on for her next writing. Then she washed up and rested.

end_state.mood: Sighing emotionally, the film's lingering afterglow interwove with creative inspiration.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, yoga 60 minutes, walking to and from the cinema.

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 24, Christmas Eve, Sun Yuwei spent the morning drafting the foreword for the writing group's annual anthology, laughed a lot during an afternoon video group chat with college roommates, stopped by Mingyuan Bookstore in the evening and ran into Qin Mingyuan, chatting about his new book, and continued reading Yunnan essays at night. She received a message from editor Xu Mingyuan saying that the topic selection meeting for 'Slow Travel Notes' was going well.

events.name: Preface to the Annual Anthology of the Creative Writing Group
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei began drafting the preface to the writing group's annual anthology in her study at home. She revisited excerpts of works shared by group members, thought about how to use words to convey everyone's writing characteristics and shared growth, and typed the opening of the first draft on the keyboard.

events.name: Video group chat with college roommates.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei had a video group chat with her college roommates Zhou Lin, Liu Jia, and Zhao Xiaowen. They shared the relief after the exams and their holiday plans; Zhou Lin also showed the cat she keeps in Shenzhen. Yuwei told them about the progress of her Yunnan plants stickers and got a wave of eager anticipation.

events.name: Went to Mingyuan Bookstore in the evening
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Bookstore. She had intended to read quietly, but happened to meet Qin Mingyuan sorting through a newly arrived batch of local historical records. After greeting each other, Boss Qin recommended a book, 'Old Images of Kunming,' saying it would inspire her Yunnan essay writing. Sun Yuwei leafed through it, loved it, and bought it on the spot.

events.name: Reading Yunnan essays in the evening and learning about publication progress.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei sat in the chair by the window in her study and continued reading Yu Jian's "This Side of Yunnan," copying sentences into her journal as she read. Her phone vibrated, and she received a WeChat message from her editor, Xu Mingyuan, informing her that the book proposal for "Slow Travel Notes" had been approved and the contract would soon take effect. Excitedly, she wrote in her journal: "The dust has settled, a new beginning."

end_state.mood: Surprise, a feeling of fulfillment brought by good news about socializing, reading, and publishing

state.daily_exercise: Walk to the bookstore and back

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 25, Sun Yuwei used her writing payment to express gratitude to her parents. After an easy morning run, she spent the day at home sorting sticker tutorials. In the evening, there was a lively and warm family dinner; her father joked that she was "supporting the family." She shared her feelings on Moments; her older sister liked and commented, drawing the family closer.

events.name: Easy morning run
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei ran an easy 5 kilometers along the Panlong River at a 7:10-per-kilometer pace. During her post-run stretching, she thought about giving her parents red envelopes today, and the corners of her mouth unconsciously turned up.

events.name: Use the royalties to send red envelopes to her parents and a voice message of gratitude
events.description: In the morning, at her home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei transferred 2000 yuan to each of her father Sun Mingyuan and her mother Li Xiulan via WeChat mobile banking, and recorded a grateful voice message to send to her parents, thanking them for their continued support and companionship. She listened to the recording several times to make sure her tone was sincere.

events.name: Organizing the draft of a botanical sticker tutorial
events.description: After the morning transfer, Sun Yuwei, in her study, integrated the sticker materials and copy she had shot over the previous two days into a draft Xiaohongshu tutorial, adjusted the order of images and the captions, and scheduled it to be published after New Year's Day. Because she was in a good mood, she worked quite efficiently.

events.name: Had a warm dinner with parents
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei enjoyed a hearty dinner at home with her parents. Her mother, Li Xiulan, had specially made mushroom hot pot and several signature dishes and kept putting food on her plate. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, looked at the transfer screenshot again and again, his eye wrinkles full of smiles, and half-jokingly said that his daughter had finally started supporting the family. The dinner table was full of laughter and emotion, and the family was joyful. Yuwei felt that she had really grown up, and also noticed a few more white hairs at her father's temples, feeling a sense of responsibility rise in her heart.

events.name: Post a gratitude update on WeChat Moments.
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei took a photo of the warm scene that evening (a corner of the dining table), paired it with a short grateful message, and posted it on Moments. It received countless likes. Her sister Sun Yutong commented below, "Little sis has really made something of herself." She felt waves of warmth from social media.

start_state.mood: Gratitude, a subtle sense of adulthood.

end_state.mood: Happiness, contentment, and strong family connection

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 26, Sun Yuwei wrapped up the month with the last Friday yoga class. In the morning she refined the sticker tutorial, in the afternoon she read and drank tea on the balcony, in the evening after yoga class she exchanged year-end reflections with He Lu, at night she video-called her older sister to share updates, and before bed she did a gratitude meditation.

events.name: Refine the botanical sticker tutorial and pre-release it.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei finalized the draft of the sticker tutorial at home and scheduled it to be published on Xiaohongshu (on the morning of New Year's Day), then confirmed the product launch time with Zhou Lin via WeChat.

events.name: Reading and tea tasting on the balcony
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei made a cup of Dianhong black tea, moved a chair onto the balcony, and bathed in the rare soft winter sunlight while reading Lei Pingyang's The Order of Yunnan Dusk. When she came to a passage that struck a chord, she paused and looked into the distance, enjoying a slow, restful time at home.

events.name: She attended the last Friday yoga class of the month.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei attended the last regular Friday class of the month at Kunming Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio. Under the guidance of instructor He Lu, she practiced asanas, and after class did Ujjayi breathing and drank ginger and red date tea. After class, she chatted with He Lu and two other students in the foyer, exchanging their year-end plans. He Lu reminded her to attend tomorrow's year-end closing class.

events.name: Evening video call with my older sister.
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei video-called her elder sister, Sun Yutong. The sisters chatted about Yuwei's New Year plans in Dali and the progress of her essay collection's publication. Her sister shared amusing stories about life in Shenzhen and urged her to book the family's Sanya trip tickets early. The call lasted nearly an hour, until the phone got hot.

start_state.mood: Peaceful, preparing for the weekend's relaxation.

end_state.mood: Relaxed, the lightness after stretching the body

state.daily_exercise: Yoga for 60 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: On Saturday, December 27, Sun Yuwei wrote the first draft of the preface to the annual anthology in the morning and sent it to the team leader for review. In the afternoon, she went to Mingyuan Bookstore to finalize the details of the "One-Hour Digital Detox" event with Qin Mingyuan, and casually sketched the bookstore in the reading area. In the evening, she received an approving reply from the team leader and felt a deep sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Morning cross-training
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei did a 30-minute brisk walk in Cuihu Park (pace 9 min/km) as her weekly Saturday aerobic cross-training. The morning air was crisp and cool. After stretching, she bought rice cakes for breakfast.

events.name: Writing the first draft of the preface to the annual anthology.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei sat in the study at home and, based on her outline, expanded the preface of the writing group's annual anthology into a full piece. She recalled each member's writing style and wrote with delicate brushstrokes about their growth between ink and breath. After completing the first draft, she sent it to the group leader via WeChat for feedback.

events.name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore to discuss the event with Qin Mingyuan
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Bookstore and met with the owner, Qin Mingyuan. They first talked about how "Fragments" had resonated with readers on Xiaohongshu, then got down to business and finalized the detailed schedule and promotional copy for the January 2026 book club event 'Digital Detox for One Hour.' Sun Yuwei was responsible for designing the initial poster draft.

events.name: Reading at the bookstore and journaling
events.description: After the discussion, Sun Yuwei sat in the reading area of Mingyuan Bookstore for a while, leafing through a book about the Yunnan Tea Horse Road that Qin Mingyuan had recently brought in, and casually sketched a corner of the bookstore in her journal, noting the materials needed for the January event.

start_state.mood: Focused on creative urges; looking forward to community activities.

end_state.mood: Satisfaction, the sense of accomplishment from contributing to the group.

state.daily_exercise: Brisk-walked for 30 minutes to the bookstore and back.

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 28, Sun Yuwei completed a 9.5 km long-distance run in the early morning, taking a key step toward reaching her 10 km goal. She then packed her luggage at home, booked the Dali trip, informed her parents of the travel arrangements, and shared the plan with her older sister via video call. In the evening, a family dinner was held to see her off, and she wrote in her journal about her expectations for the trip and her attachment to home.

events.name: Morning long run, 9.5 km
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei completed a 9.5 km long slow run at Green Lake Park (pace 7:30 per km), setting a new personal distance record. Though tired after the run, she felt a surge of confidence. She stretched carefully and logged the milestone on her sports watch.

events.name: Pack luggage and book the Dali trip
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei began packing at her home in Kunming, neatly placing clothes, a camera, and journaling tools into a travel bag. She used her phone to book a flight from Kunming to Dali on December 30 and a well-reviewed Bai ethnic guesthouse by Erhai Lake. With the itinerary confirmed, she breathed a sigh of relief.

events.name: Inform parents of travel arrangements
events.description: After tidying up, Sun Yuwei went to the living room and told her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan about her travel plans. Her parents asked in detail about flight times and accommodation, reminding her to be safe. Her mother also slipped her a pack of Yunnan Baiyao band-aids, saying just in case.

events.name: Video-called her older sister to share travel plans.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei had a video call with her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen and excitedly talked about the plan to go to Dali for New Year's Eve. Her sister urged her to take some good photos and said, "When you come back, our whole family will go to Sanya for a vacation." The sisters had a great time chatting.

events.name: Family dinner and farewell.
events.description: In the evening, Mother Li Xiulan specially made the mushroom hot pot that Yuwei loves, and the family of three sat around together. After dinner, Father helped her check the charger and the lens, while Mother reminded her again and again. The warmth carried a hint of parting. Yuwei promised to keep them updated on her safety. Before bed, she opened her journal and wrote: “About to set off, flying toward Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake with my family’s love.”

start_state.mood: Excited and expectant, filled with anticipation for the trip.

end_state.mood: Excitement mixed with attachment to her parents.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 9.5 km, packing luggage, light activity

2025-12.daily_overview: December 29 was Sun Yuwei's last full day in Kunming and the final day of her yoga year. In the morning, she made her final pre-trip checks and learned about the progress of the publication contract. At noon, she went to the flower market to pick out small bouquets for the trip to Dali. In the afternoon, she attended the final class of the year at Jingxin Yoga Life Studio, received The Tree of Yoga as a gift, and completed 108 Sun Salutations on her own, bidding farewell to 2025 with sweat and gratitude. In the evening, she returned home and rested early to prepare for the next morning's departure.

events.name: Pre-trip check and update on publication progress
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei did a final check at home to make sure she had all her items, such as the camera battery, memory card, and journal. Then she called the editor Xu Mingyuan to confirm that the letter of intent for the publishing contract for 'Slow Travel Notes' had been sent out and that the first advance payment of 8,000 yuan was about to arrive. The burden on her heart finally lifted, and she wrote 'See you in spring' in her journal.

events.name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to select a travel bouquet.
events.description: At noon, Sun Yuwei took the bus to Dounan Flower Market to pick a small bunch of chamomile and eucalyptus leaves for her trip to Dali, wrapped them in kraft paper, and planned to put them in the homestay room. At the flower market, she ran into Su Man, a fellow flower-arranging enthusiast, and the two happily agreed to practice flower arranging together after New Year's Day.

events.name: Heading to the yoga studio for the year-end closing class.
events.description: On the afternoon of December 29, 2025, Sun Yuwei left her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, and took the bus to Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio in Panlong District. After arriving, she changed into her yoga clothes, spread out her yoga mat, and adjusted her breathing in preparation for the year-end closing class. Outside, a light rain began to fall, but inside the studio it was warm and quiet.

events.name: National mentor He Lu gave me the book 'The Tree of Yoga'
events.description: Sun Yuwei attended the last yoga class of the year at Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio, where instructor He Lu led basic asana practice, breathing meditation, and a gratitude session. At the end of the class, He Lu gave Sun Yuwei a copy of The Tree of Yoga wrapped in a plain, elegant book cover and said, 'The changes in your body and mind over this year are like a tree slowly taking root.' Sun Yuwei was touched as she accepted the book and briefly shared her practice reflections with He Lu.

events.name: Completed 108 Sun Salutations alone
events.description: After class, when the other students had left, Sun Yuwei remained alone in the classroom. With the dimming winter light outside the window, she practiced 108 full rounds of Sun Salutations, breathing in and out with each movement. Sweat dripped onto the yoga mat; every salutation was a gesture of gratitude and farewell to a year of persistence. The entire session lasted about 1.5 hours. Afterward, she felt incredibly light, as if she had set down all her burdens.

events.name: Returned home feeling moved.
events.description: After the practice, Sun Yuwei packed up her yoga mat and clothes and left the yoga studio with "The Tree of Yoga" gifted by He Lu. She took the bus home, put the book on her desk, and opened her journal to record this special practice experience, then rested early to prepare for the trip the next morning. During her gratitude meditation before bed, she especially thanked yoga and all the encounters of this past year.

start_state.mood: Firm and grateful, ready for the farewell ceremony

end_state.mood: Moved, fulfilled, and spiritually uplifted

state.daily_exercise: 60-minute yoga class + 108 Sun Salutations, about 90 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 30, Sun Yuwei flew alone to Dali to begin a year-end creative field trip. From the early morning flight to checking into a Bai ethnic guesthouse by Erhai Lake, she immersed herself in the Cangshan Mountains and Erhai Lake. In the afternoon she hiked along the lake, photographing clouds and light; at night she leaned by the window recording travel fragments, and before bed reported to her parents that she was safe, gaining a first taste of the joy of "deep nature writing."

events.name: Flew to Dali in the early morning
events.description: At 5:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei, escorted by her parents, arrived at Kunming Changshui Airport, checked in by herself, and boarded the flight to Dali. After about an hour, she arrived at Dali Airport. Stepping out of the plane, she was struck by the clear sky and the mountains, and then took a taxi to a guesthouse by Erhai Lake.

events.name: Checked into a Bai ethnic guesthouse by Erhai Lake.
events.description: After Sun Yuwei arrived in Dali, she checked in at a Bai ethnic guesthouse by Erhai Lake. The guesthouse was a renovated traditional Bai folk residence with a courtyard and terrace. She put down her luggage, placed the chamomile she brought into a vase and set it on the windowsill, familiarized herself with the room and its surroundings, and when she pushed open the window she could see Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake, feeling elated.

events.name: Photographed light and shadows while walking along Erhai Lake.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei hiked alone along the shore of Erhai Lake, using her DSLR camera to capture the ever-changing clouds over Cangshan Mountain from milky white to crimson, recording the natural light and shadow. She walked and stopped, smiling and greeting local villagers, immersed in Dali's winter scenery. After about 2 hours of hiking, she sat down at a lakeside cove, took out her watercolor sketchbook, and drew a quick sketch.

events.name: By the window, jotting down snippets of the trip.
events.description: After nightfall, Sun Yuwei returned to the guesthouse, sat by the windowsill, and turned the shifting light and shadow she had seen during the day, along with her inner feelings, into written passages, recording her field trip reflections. She also briefly planned the next day's shooting route, and sent her parents a WeChat message to let them know she was safe, attaching a photo of the sunset over Cangshan.

start_state.location: Kunming Changshui Airport or en route.

end_state.location: A Bai ethnic guesthouse by Erhai Lake in Dali
end_state.mood: Tranquil, free, immersed in nature

state.daily_exercise: Hiked along Erhai Lake for about 2 hours.

2025-12.daily_overview: On December 31, Sun Yuwei spent New Year's Eve in Dali at a leisurely pace. She was woken by the sunrise over Cangshan Mountain in the early morning; during the day she continued gathering inspiration by Erhai Lake and refined her nature notes. In the evening, she had an early video New Year countdown with her best friend group and shared New Year goals under the stars. After sitting meditation at night, she fell peacefully asleep at 22:30, welcoming 2026 with a rested body and mind.

events.name: Early-morning Cangshan sunrise meditation.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Sun Yuwei was awakened by the faint light outside the window of the guesthouse. She wrapped a blanket around herself and walked to the terrace, where she did 15 minutes of breathing meditation facing the sunrise over Cangshan Mountain, then walked slowly for half an hour by Erhai Lake. Back in her room, she read aloud from the English edition of Walden for 30 minutes, starting the New Year's Eve day with a morning ritual.

events.name: Continue the field trip to Erhai Lake to refine nature notes.
events.description: During the day, Sun Yuwei kept walking along the shore of Erhai Lake, using her camera to capture the clouds over Cangshan Mountain and the reflections on the lake under different light, and completed the observation notes from the previous day. She stopped for a long while in front of a patch of reeds, wrote down the feel of the wind and the calls of birds, and decided to include these details in her first essay of the new year.

events.name: Evening old-town stroll and New Year's Eve video call with best friend
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei took the homestay owner's tricycle to Dali Ancient Town. She wandered through the alleys hung with red lanterns and bought a small tie-dye ornament. At 18:30, she found a quiet corner of the city wall and started a video call with her close friends group (Zhang Jing, Chen Sisi, Wang Xinran). The four raised their cups across the distance (Yuwei used her thermos cup lid), shared their growth over the past year, exchanged blessings, and agreed to have a cheongsam photo shoot in spring. Amid laughter, she showed the outline of Cangshan Mountain to the camera, as if blending the warmth of friendship into the landscape.

events.name: Return to the homestay rooftop to record the starry sky and New Year goals
events.description: Returning to the guesthouse at 20:00, Sun Yuwei carried a blanket to the rooftop, set up her tripod, and photographed the last starry sky of 2025. Then she opened her journal and solemnly wrote on the first page: '2026, deep immersion in Yunnan nature writing.' She also pasted in a photo of Erhai Lake's light and shadow that she had taken during the day.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and gratitude journal
events.description: At nearly 21:30, Sun Yuwei returned to her room, did a 10-minute body-scan meditation, and wrote in her gratitude journal (thanking her family, friends, editor, and her own persistence). At 22:00 she turned off her electronic devices, read *The Tree of Yoga* for half an hour, and turned off the lights and went to sleep at 22:30.

end_state.location: A Bai ethnic minority guesthouse room by Erhai Lake in Dali
end_state.mood: Excited, expectant, and full of New Year's resolutions.

state.daily_exercise: Strolled around Erhai Lake for about 3 hours; morning meditation and stretching.

2025-02.daily_overview: At the end of the Spring Festival holiday, Sun Yuwei stayed home to collect herself and took a concrete first step toward her goals for the new year. She transferred the first installment of her travel fund and sketched out an alluring cultural travel blueprint in her journal. The whole day was leisurely, with chats with her mother and flipping through old family photos — warm and steady. In the afternoon, Aunt Xie from next door brought over some homemade cured meat, and the mother and daughter gave her New Year candies in return.

events.name: First deposit into the travel fund.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei used the mobile banking app to transfer 2,000 yuan from her personal savings account to a specially set-up travel fund account. After confirming the transfer was successful, she checked the balance of the fund account and sent a screenshot to her sister Sun Yutong.

events.name: Journal entry recording the first travel fund contribution
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei took out her journal, pasted clippings about Spring Festival travel guides on a blank page, and used colored pens to record the details of depositing the first 2,000 yuan into her travel fund. She listed candidate destinations such as Hangzhou, Dali, and Chengdu, drew simple route sketches with watercolor pens, and filled the space around them with aspirations for cultural travel within the year.

events.name: Sorting through the lingering memories of the Spring Festival.
events.description: In the morning, before making the transfer, she and her mother Li Xiulan sorted through the New Year goods left over from the Spring Festival, dividing the candies and flower cakes into small portions to give to their neighbor Aunt Xie. As they tidied up, they chatted about amusing incidents from visiting relatives and friends during the holiday.

events.name: Looking through family photo albums
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and her mother sat on the living room sofa and pulled out a few old photo albums to revisit the past. Her mother pointed at a photo of her as a child in Green Lake Park and told the embarrassing story of the first time she fed the gulls and got her finger pecked. The mother and daughter couldn't stop laughing.

events.name: Neighborhood sharing
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Aunt Xie Xiulan, the neighbor, knocked on the door and brought over a piece of homemade cured pork, saying she had made extra for the Spring Festival. Mother took it, thanked her, and asked Yuwei to bring Aunt Xie some of the just-divided New Year candies and flower cakes. Aunt Xie praised Yuwei for becoming more quiet and gentle, and warmly invited her to come over and learn to make pickled vegetables whenever she had time.

end_state.mood: Content and full of anticipation

state.daily_exercise: None

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy to sunny, afternoon temperature 16°C

2025-02.daily_overview: Her sister was about to return to Shenzhen. It was the last day of the Spring Festival holiday, and the whole family pitched in to prepare a farewell dinner for her. Sun Yuwei got up a little earlier, followed her mother to the vegetable market for a big shopping trip, and helped wash and chop vegetables. The kitchen was filled with steam and the unique taste of home. In the evening, the laughter around the dinner table was captured by the mirrorless camera, and in her journal she left her sister the gentlest wishes. In the middle of the night, a sudden rain shower set in. Yuwei got up to close the window and took the chance to send her sister a message telling her to let them know when she arrived safely.

events.name: Shopping for ingredients for the farewell dinner
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei and her mother, Li Xiulan, walked together to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market in Wuhua District, Kunming. At the market, they selected fresh mushrooms, various vegetables, meat, and seasonings. Her mother specifically reserved the soup base for crossing-the-bridge rice noodles—her sister's favorite—at a stall she knew well. Sun Yuwei also used her phone to photograph the colorful market scenes, thinking she would keep them as material.

events.name: Collaborating in the kitchen on a family feast
events.description: From afternoon to evening, Sun Yuwei helped her mother in the family kitchen. She put on an apron and was responsible for washing the mushrooms, chopping scallions, and watching the heat, while her mother cooked specialty dishes such as crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, mushroom hot pot, and steam-pot chicken. Her older sister Sun Yutong occasionally came in and sneaked two slices of ham, and her father Sun Mingyuan helped by setting the table and letting the red wine breathe.

events.name: Family farewell dinner
events.description: At seven in the evening, the four of them, Sun Yuwei, her father Sun Mingyuan, her mother Li Xiulan, and her elder sister Sun Yutong, sat around the round table at home. Steaming dishes filled the table as everyone ate and chatted. Sun Yutong shared news from her job in Shenzhen, and their parents reminded her to take care of her health. Sun Yuwei raised her glass and toasted her sister, 'Wishing you a bright future.' The atmosphere was warm yet tinged with a hint of reluctance.

events.name: Capturing reunion through the lens
events.description: During dinner, Sun Yuwei took out her Sony mirrorless camera and kept moving around the table, capturing lively scenes of family toasting, laughing, and picking up food. She especially focused on her sister Sun Yutong's profile and smiling eyes. At the moment she pressed the shutter, she also etched the last scene of the Spring Festival reunion into her heart.

events.name: Journal entry for the farewell night.
events.description: After the dinner party was over and the dishes were cleared away, Sun Yuwei returned to her room and imported the photos from her mirrorless camera into her laptop. She selected a few she was most satisfied with and printed them with the portable printer she had brought. Then she opened her journal, decorated it with cherry-blossom stickers and washi tape, stuck in the photos, and wrote beside them with a brush pen: 'May my sister continue to shine brightly in Shenzhen, and remember to come home often for soup.'

events.name: Closing the windows during late-night rain
events.description: A little after 3 a.m., a sudden rain shower began outside, and raindrops clattered against the awning. Sun Yuwei woke up, got up to close the bedroom and balcony windows, and took the chance to send her sister a WeChat message: 'Remember to bring an umbrella before you leave; it may rain in Shenzhen too.'

start_state.mood: Looking forward to seeing my older sister off, though a little reluctant

end_state.mood: Warm and content, fell asleep peacefully with blessings for my older sister

state.daily_exercise: None

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to cloudy, with light morning mist, temperature 7-15°C

2025-02.daily_overview: Elder sister set off on her journey back to Shenzhen, and the house suddenly became quiet. The morning farewell hug still had tears, but the sticky note found while tidying the room turned the tears into smiles for mother and daughter. That day moved from parting sorrow to warmth; in the evening, looking through old photo albums completely dispelled the sadness and turned it into an endless stream of memories. In the afternoon, Yuwei found that her phone had been left in her sister's room. While searching for it, she unexpectedly found her sister's diary from her school days and couldn't help laughing.

events.name: Seeing my elder sister off in the early morning
events.description: At six-thirty in the morning at her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, Sun Yuwei, along with her mother Li Xiulan and father Sun Mingyuan, saw her elder sister Sun Yutong off. Before leaving, Yutong took a sticky note out of her bag and put it on the mirror by the entryway. It read, 'Eat on time, don't stay up late, I'll come back to check next time.' Yuwei helped her sister carry her luggage to the taxi waiting outside. The two sisters hugged tightly; Yuwei's eyes were red, but she smiled hard and waved. The family watched the taxi disappear into the morning mist.

events.name: Organizing my older sister's bedroom.
events.description: At nine in the morning, after seeing her sister off, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan began tidying the bedroom her sister had stayed in. They took off the sheets and quilt covers and put them in the washing machine, placed the scattered novels and magazines back on the bookshelf, and wiped the desk. Her mother held a pearl hair clip her sister had left behind and was momentarily dazed. Sun Yuwei took it with a smile and put it in the desk drawer, saying, 'She is really scatterbrained. I'll keep it safe for her and give it back to her next time she comes home.'

events.name: Organize my sister's suitcase and clothes.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei and her mother opened the two large suitcases left by her older sister and took out the clothes one by one. Her mother sorted them by season, hanging the heavy coats back in the wardrobe and folding the thin tops into storage bins. Sun Yuwei arranged her sister's skincare samples neatly in an acrylic box and found an unopened tube of hand cream. She said with a smile, “Perfect, I can use this — consider it a gift from my sister.”

events.name: Comfort Mom and suggest looking at the photo album.
events.description: After finishing the tidying-up in the evening, her mother Li Xiulan sat on the sofa, gazing out the window and sighing, in low spirits. Sun Yuwei walked over, sat down beside her, put her arm around her mother's shoulder, and said softly, 'Mom, sis might come back again around May Day, and transportation is so convenient now. Look, the note she left is still there.' To shift her attention, she suggested flipping through the family photo album together that evening. Her mother's eyes lit up, and she immediately went to the kitchen to brew two cups of Pu'er tea.

events.name: The whole family turned through old photo albums together.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei sat with her mother and father (who had returned from work) on the living room sofa, with three thick family photo albums spread out in front of them. Her mother pointed at old photos one by one and told the stories behind them—the childhood photo of the two sisters at Cuihu Lake, the embarrassing moment when her father was chased by a goat during the family trip to Dali, and the candid shot of Yuwei crying at her elementary school graduation ceremony. Her father also added comments from time to time. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious, her mother's sadness completely dispelled, and the room filled with laughter again.

events.name: Discovered my older sister's old diary.
events.description: While tidying up in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei realized that her phone had somehow been left on the nightstand in her sister's room. When she went to retrieve it, an old notebook fell out from a gap in the nightstand. When she opened it, it turned out to be her sister's high school diary, in which was written childishly, 'My little sister again secretly drank my Coke today, how annoying.' She took a photo and sent it to her sister, who instantly replied with a string of ellipses and a devastated emoji. The mother and daughters were highly amused.

start_state.mood: Reluctant to leave, eyes turning red

end_state.mood: Warm and peaceful, with the warmth of memories.

2025-02.daily_overview: A day to reset her mood. In the morning, she went through her graduation thesis proposal one last time, and the interview plan was already taking shape in her mind. In the afternoon, she attended the first yoga class after the Spring Festival as scheduled. She and He Lu encouraged each other, feeling their bodies awaken through their breath. On the bus home after class, Yuwei listened to a podcast she had often listened to last year and felt that her days had returned to an orderly rhythm. Before bed, she tried a 15-minute full-body scan meditation.

events.name: Refine the thesis proposal
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk at home, opened her laptop, and, based on the feedback in her supervisor's previous email, revised the proposal for her graduation thesis “A Study of the Cultural Space of Independent Bookstores in Kunming” point by point. She restated the research question more sharply and confirmed the feasibility of the oral history method, printed out the final draft, put it in a document folder, and prepared to submit it the next day.

events.name: First yoga class after the holiday
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei and her yoga partner He Lu met at Kunming Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio for the first flow yoga class after the Spring Festival. During class, she shared a funny little story about being fed by her family over the holiday and feeling stiff, and with He Lu's encouragement, she tried the humming-bee breathing technique, focusing on the rise and fall of her abdomen. After the class, although some poses felt unfamiliar, her body gradually woke up from the holiday sluggishness. Afterward, the two briefly exchanged their practice experiences in the locker room and agreed to come together next time.

events.name: Listen to podcasts on the bus.
events.description: After yoga class, Sun Yuwei took the bus home alone. She put on her earphones and opened the cultural podcast she often listened to, "The Folding City." This episode told the story of Shanghai lane bookstores, which reminded her of Wenlin Street in Kunming, so she quietly noted down a few keywords in her phone memo.

events.name: Organized the interview outline in the evening
events.description: After arriving home and taking a shower, Sun Yuwei made a cup of rose tea. At her desk, based on the revised thesis proposal, she used XMind software to draw a mind map of the paper’s preliminary interview outline, listing several dimensions of possible questions for Qin Mingyuan and planning to refine them during tomorrow’s face-to-face meeting.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: At 23:00, Sun Yuwei leaned against the headboard, opened the 'Tide' app, and tried a 15-minute full-body scan meditation, gradually relaxing from toes to the top of the head. After it ended, she felt her shoulders and neck relaxed, and soon fell into a deep sleep.

start_state.mood: Calm but with a sense of purpose

end_state.mood: Body relaxed, mindset positive.

2025-02.daily_overview: An energetic day back at school. In the morning, she submitted her thesis proposal, and the conversation with her advisor was a godsend, clarifying the direction of her next stage of research. There were already some classmates who had returned to campus early, and she stopped by the library on the way to return books. In the evening, she copied the advisor's suggestions into densely written notes, feeling full of motivation for the upcoming fieldwork. That night, a message suddenly popped up in the high school class group chat about organizing a weekend get-together, and Yuwei was a bit hesitant.

events.name: Submit the thesis proposal
events.description: At ten in the morning, Sun Yuwei arrived at the teaching building of the School of Literature at Yunnan University and knocked on the door of her supervisor Wu Mingyuan's office to formally submit her graduation thesis proposal and finalize the topic “A Study of the Cultural Space of Kunming's Independent Bookstores.” After reading it carefully, Professor Wu affirmed the topic's local value, suggested that she add oral history methods to increase depth, and recommended that she interview Qin Mingyuan, the operator of Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, to obtain first-hand materials on the changes of old Kunming bookstores. Sun Yuwei nodded while jotting down key points in her notebook.

events.name: In-person meeting with supervisor in office.
events.description: After she submitted the report, Wu Mingyuan asked her to stay for a cup of tea, and the two chatted in the office for more than half an hour. Professor Wu emphasized that oral history should focus on 'the truth of details,' and suggested that in addition to Qin Mingyuan, she could later seek out owners from one or two other bookstores of different types. Sun Yuwei wrote down several reference books recommended by her advisor and asked about the operational details of recording and informed consent.

events.name: Campus stroll and book return
events.description: After leaving the College of Literature at noon, she stopped by the campus library on the way to return the novel she had borrowed before winter break, then took a walk along the ginkgo path, enjoying the winter sunlight. Looking at the branches that had not yet fully turned green, she silently thought that she should add a sketch of the campus in early spring to her journal.

events.name: Draft the outline framework for the interview
events.description: When she got home in the evening, Sun Yuwei organized her advisor's suggestions into digital notes, then drew a simple interview outline framework on an open notebook. She listed broad themes such as "bookstore founding history," "changes in the old Kunming bookstore landscape," and "customer stories," planning to go to the library tomorrow to find methodology books to enrich it.

events.name: Message in the high school classmates group
events.description: At nine in the evening, the long-silent high school class group suddenly came to life. Someone suggested a gathering near Green Lake this weekend. Yuwei was tempted by the messages but worried that it would take up her inspiration-gathering time, so she only replied with “TBD” and planned to decide tomorrow.

end_state.mood: Clear goal, eager to get started.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-02.daily_overview: A day spent in the library. Diving into the social sciences reading area, she plowed through most of two thick books on oral history practice. Highlighter strokes marked key operational points, and her notebook was filled with interview templates she could apply directly. When she left in the evening, it was already dark; her head felt heavy, but her steps were light. Passing by a newly opened milk tea shop on Qianju Street, she treated herself to a brown sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar.

events.name: Borrowed methodology books from the library.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei went to the social science reading area of the Yunnan University Library. Following the reference list given by her supervisor, she used the front desk retrieval system to find the locations of two books: "A Practical Guide to Oral History" and "Qualitative Research Methods". After checking them out, she took them to a seat by the window, put down her bag, and began focused reading.

events.name: Focus on studying interview techniques.
events.description: At her seat in the library, Sun Yuwei spent nearly three hours reading, with a focus on content about interview techniques, recording equipment selection, informed consent procedures, and transcription standards in two books. As she read, she highlighted keywords with a marker and copied question templates and transcription templates suitable for her research context into her A5 notebook. At key points, she stopped writing to think about how to apply them to Qin Mingyuan's interview.

events.name: Drafted preliminary interview questions
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei did not rest right away. Instead, she turned on the computer and, based on her daytime notes and the thesis topic, listed 10 semi-structured interview questions for Qin Mingyuan in a Word document, from 'What circumstances led you to open this bookstore?' to 'What role do you think the bookstore plays in the community?' She also deliberately left room for follow-up questions.

events.name: Milk tea break
events.description: Leaving the library at six-thirty, Sun Yuwei felt parched. She saw a newly opened milk tea shop called 'Spring Tea Alley' on Qianju Street and went in to order a brown sugar pearl milk tea with less sugar. While waiting, she casually took a photo of the wooden menu, thinking it might be useful for her column later.

end_state.mood: Tired but very rewarding

2025-02.daily_overview: An efficient and romantic day. In the morning she finalized the time for the first interview for her paper; in the afternoon she cleared out the clutter in her body through yoga; and in the evening she immersed herself in the images and reflections of 'Soul'. After the movie, the postcard she had bought was now lying in her journal, beside her words still carrying warmth. After the film, she couldn't help sharing a line from it on Moments, which drew quite a few likes.

events.name: Draft an interview outline and contact Qin Mingyuan
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei, in her home study, based on the previous framework and the methods she had studied the day before, drafted a formal semi-structured interview outline for Qin Mingyuan, covering dimensions such as his entrepreneurial experience, the bookstore's changes, customer stories, and the significance of urban cultural spaces. At eleven-thirty, she contacted Qin Mingyuan via WeChat and explained in detail the purpose of the interview for her graduation thesis. Qin Mingyuan quickly replied, expressing understanding and support, and readily agreed to meet at Mingyuan Bookstore at two o'clock the next afternoon (February 8).

events.name: Prepare interview equipment
events.description: As arranged, Sun Yuwei checked the battery levels of the voice recorder and spare batteries, fully charged the power bank, and loaded new film into the Polaroid camera. She found a plain canvas bag and put in the voice recorder, notebook, fountain pen, Polaroid camera, and a small-format oral history methods quick-reference manual.

events.name: Afternoon yoga practice
events.description: Following the practice plan for every Tuesday and Friday, at 3 p.m. Sun Yuwei went alone to Kunming Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio for today's vinyasa flow practice. She focused on completing a set of basic poses, and in Warrior II tried using the bee breathing technique learned two days earlier to stabilize her core. After an hour of practice, she felt her shoulders and neck significantly looser, and her body regained a sense of stability. After class, she chatted with He Lu on WeChat about the new props the teacher had mentioned in class.

events.name: Watched "Soul" at an independent cinema
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei walked from home to an independent cinema on Qianju Street in Wuhua District. She bought a hot brown sugar pearl milk tea at a familiar milk tea shop nearby, then picked up her movie ticket and entered the theater. There weren't many people in the screening room, and she found a seat toward the middle-back. The re-release of Soul, with its warm story, made her eyes well up several times. Especially the line, 'The spark is not a life goal. The moment you want to live, the spark has already been lit,' made her nod hard in the darkness.

events.name: Record film-viewing reflections on a postcard
events.description: After the movie ended, Sun Yuwei wiped the corners of her eyes and walked out of the cinema, then stepped into the convenience store next door and picked out a postcard printed with a starry sky from the rack. Standing at a table in the corner of the store, she wrote on the back of the postcard with the pen she carried: "2025.2.7 Re-release of Soul, suitable for revisiting in uncertain times. A spark is life itself."

events.name: Gathering the day's keepsakes in the journal
events.description: At nine in the evening, Sun Yuwei returned home, took a shower, changed into loungewear, and sat down at her desk. She found the postcard and movie ticket stub she had written earlier that night and opened a new page in her journal. Using washi tape, she pasted the ticket stub and postcard in a staggered arrangement, and added two short passages beside them—one was the movie line that struck her most, and the other was a brief recap of today's yoga and interview preparation. Before closing the journal, she ran her hand contentedly over the pages filled to the brim.

events.name: Share on Moments.
events.description: Before going to sleep, Sun Yuwei posted the postcard photo to her WeChat Moments with the caption "Sparks are not the goal of life..." Within a few minutes, she received interactions from Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi. Zhang Jing commented that they should watch it together again another day, and Yuwei happily agreed.

end_state.mood: Feeling healed, my heart soft and content.

2025-02.daily_overview: The field research officially set off. In the early morning she went to the flower market to pick flowers, letting her fingertips first take in the scent of soil and dew; in the afternoon, amid the tea fragrance in the bookstore, she listened to Uncle Qin talk about the rise and fall of old Kunming bookstores—details not found in written texts buried themselves like seeds in her notebook. The essay she wrote that evening was the best echo of the day. At noon she happened to meet Su Man at the flower market, and they made a plan to arrange flowers together next week.

events.name: Bought floral materials at Dounan Flower Market.
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei took the subway alone to Dounan Flower Market in Chenggong. She lingered in the flower trading hall and finally picked out a bundle of full long-stemmed white roses and a cluster of gray-green eucalyptus leaves at a stall she knew well. The stall owner, a friendly older woman, enthusiastically taught her the trick of 'reviving flowers in deep water.' As she paid, she thought the flower arrangement assignment today could try the basic rikka style.

events.name: Running into Su Man at the flower market
events.description: On the second floor of the flower market, Sun Yuwei happened to meet Su Man, a fellow flower arranging enthusiast. Su Man was buying green plants for the botanical garden. The two stood and chatted for a quarter of an hour. Su Man recommended several seasonal flower varieties that are easy to care for, and suggested they practice flower arranging together on Yuwei's balcony next Wednesday. Yuwei happily agreed and noted down the appointment.

events.name: Oral history interview at Mingyuan Bookstore.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street in Wuhua District as agreed. Qin Mingyuan had already prepared Pu'er tea at a tea table in the corner. She turned on her voice recorder and placed it between them, then followed the outline and began by asking why Qin Mingyuan had come to Kunming to open a bookstore twenty years ago. Qin Mingyuan slowly recounted his early days of hunting for old books around town, the dense ecosystem of small bookstores around Qianju Street at the time, and the stories of industry peers who had moved or closed down over the years due to the impact of the internet. The interview lasted nearly two hours. Sun Yuwei occasionally used her Polaroid to photograph the piles of old books on the desk, the hanging wooden menu, and the natural hand gestures Qin Mingyuan made while speaking. At the end, she asked to take a photo with Qin Mingyuan, and the old man smiled and adjusted his collar.

events.name: Organizing recordings and writing an essay
events.description: When she got home at seven in the evening, Sun Yuwei imported the audio from the voice recorder into her computer, put on earphones, and listened back. When she heard Qin Mingyuan say, 'A bookstore is like a bookworm that has wedged itself into the crevices of the old city walls,' her heart gave a jolt and she immediately paused the recording. She opened a new Word document, used that sentence as the title and inspiration, and spent an hour and a half writing a 1,200-word essay, 'The Bookworm's Hiding Place,' recording the moments that had touched her that day and her feelings about urban cultural spaces. Afterwards, she backed up the recording and jotted down several key timestamps from the interview in her notebook.

events.name: Sharing gains with her mother
events.description: After finishing the essay, Sun Yuwei excitedly took the Polaroid photos to the living room to show her mother, who was knitting a sweater. She told her a few warm stories that Qin Mingyuan had told, and her mother said with relief, 'What you are doing is very meaningful. Write these things down, and in the future they will be the memory of the people of Kunming.'

end_state.mood: Deeply moved, creative urge ignited

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 8,000 steps (commuting between the flower market and the bookstore).

2025-02.daily_overview: A peaceful day at home. She secured a spot in the meditation class, and the valuable takeaways from the interview were carefully filed away. In the afternoon, she fiddled with flower branches and scissors on the balcony, and an asymmetrical standing flower arrangement gradually took shape. In the evening, another page of flower-scented writing was added to her journal. Flower arranging, journaling, and meditation — today she connected several of her favorite things. In the evening, she received a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking about the progress of the column concept, and Yuwei replied that she would discuss it in detail next week.

events.name: Sign up for a meditation trial class
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei opened the WeChat official account of Jingxin Yoga Life Studio on her phone at home and carefully read the details of tomorrow afternoon's meditation special experience class. Seeing that only three spots were left, she quickly filled in the registration information and paid the fee online. Only after receiving the confirmation notice did she breathe a sigh of relief.

events.name: Organized and archived interview materials
events.description: At ten in the morning, Sun Yuwei took out the Polaroid photos taken the day before to dry, and chose two she was most satisfied with: a single portrait of Qin Mingyuan and a view of the bookstore interior. She took out a thick material journal she had bought specifically for her thesis, opened a new page called 'Interview Inspiration Page', pasted the photos with washi tape, and wrote by hand next to them the interview date, the interviewee's name, key quotes (such as 'embedded in the wall cracks'), and her immediate feelings. Then she filed all the audio recordings, text notes, and electronic essay drafts into the 'Thesis/Field Research' folder on her computer.

events.name: At-Home Floral Arrangement
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei spread a waterproof mat on her flower arrangement worktable on the balcony and took the roses and eucalyptus leaves she had bought yesterday out of the bucket. Following the Ikenobo textbook, she first used flower scissors to trim away extra leaves and branches, cut the stem ends at a 45-degree angle, and then carefully secured them on the needle frog. She repeatedly adjusted the angles of the main branch and secondary branches, giving the whole arrangement the characteristic asymmetric balance of rikka. About forty minutes later, a rikka piece with simple lines and staggered spacing was complete, and the breathing room between flowers and leaves left her satisfied.

events.name: Record insights on flower arranging in the journal
events.description: After completing the flower arrangement, she took photos of the piece from multiple angles with her phone and chose one to print. Returning to the study, she pasted the photo into her journal and, with a fine-tip pen, neatly wrote the date of creation, the flowers used, and a reflection: 'The process of adjusting branches is much like adjusting one's inner self: less is more, and leaving blank space creates space.' Finally, she moved the vase to the living room coffee table for the family to enjoy, and cleaned the tools.

events.name: Evening tea and books
events.description: In the evening, her mother went out to buy groceries and her father read the newspaper in the living room. Sun Yuwei sat down in the rattan chair on the balcony, made a cup of jasmine tea, and opened Taipei People, which she hadn't finished a few days earlier, reading about forty pages. The evening breeze was gentle, and the eucalyptus leaves on the plant stand gave off a faint fragrance.

events.name: Contact editor Xu Mingyuan
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei checked WeChat and saw a message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking if she had any new ideas for the column. She thought for a moment and replied that she had been working on oral histories of bookstores, and maybe she could write a series on “Cultural Landmarks of Kunming” based on that; she agreed to send him a topic outline by Wednesday.

start_state.mood: A calm, orderly start to the day.

end_state.mood: Peaceful and content, with the fragrance of flowers and the spirit of books.

2025-02.daily_overview: The first week of the new semester officially began, and more figures with backpacks appeared on campus. Sun Yuwei plunged into the library to dig up literature, stocking up on a lot of "food" for her thesis. In the afternoon, her first meditation experience was like a SPA for the brain. Those distracting thoughts were still there, but she had learned to watch them quietly. In the evening, she organized her reading list in the dormitory and felt especially grounded. Before bed, she tried the new breathing technique Teacher Zhao had taught her and felt that she fell asleep faster.

events.name: Library literature search and borrowing
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei went to the Yunnan University library. In the literature retrieval system, she searched using keyword combinations such as 'Lefebvre', 'production of space', 'independent bookstore', and 'cultural space', and finally located relevant chapters of The Production of Space and several papers by local scholars on Kunming's urban cultural space. She noted down the call numbers and electronic resource links, checked out two paper books from the stacks, and downloaded the electronic versions of the papers on a library computer. Then she packed the materials into her canvas bag and stopped by the campus store to buy a hot Americano.

events.name: First meditation experience in the afternoon
events.description: At 2:45 p.m., Sun Yuwei changed into loose clothes and walked to the Jingxin Yoga Life Studio. In the meditation room, instructor Zhao Lihua first explained the essentials of abdominal breathing, then guided the thirteen students, including her, to sit quietly with their eyes closed. At first her thoughts wandered wildly, jumping from thesis requirements to plans for tomorrow and the day after, but following the instruction to "observe the breath," she slowly brought her attention back to the rise and fall of her abdomen. Within five minutes, she briefly experienced the tranquility of an empty mind, and after opening her eyes felt a great release in her shoulders and neck. After class, she took the initiative to talk with Teacher Zhao and noted down a small daily practice: "three deep-breathing pauses each day."

events.name: Evening preparatory reading of literature
events.description: At seven in the evening, Sun Yuwei returned to her dormitory (today she chose to stay on campus so she could focus on reading tomorrow), and spread the borrowed book on her desk. She first went through the table of contents and introduction of Chapter 3 of "The Production of Space," highlighting core concepts such as "social space" and "absolute space" with a highlighter, and made preliminary notes organizing the terminology in her notebook. Seeing the lights of Wenlin Street beginning to come on outside the window, she decided to continue tomorrow from a seat by the window in the library.

events.name: Journaling the initial feelings of meditation
events.description: Before sleep, Sun Yuwei opened her journal and wrote on the day's blank page: "Distracting thoughts drift by like clouds, but I no longer rush to drive them away. I'll stick with it for two weeks and see what changes." She also stuck the small meditation guide card image from the yoga studio on the footer of the page and set a daily meditation reminder in her phone's memo app.

events.name: Practicing a new breathing technique before bed
events.description: Before lights-out in the dormitory, Sun Yuwei lay half-reclined on the bed and practiced abdominal breathing using the method Teacher Zhao taught: inhale for four seconds, hold for four seconds, exhale for six seconds. After repeating ten times, she felt her eyelids grow heavy and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Calm, ready to dive into academic work.

end_state.mood: Introspective and peaceful, developed an interest in meditation.

2025-02.daily_overview: Fixed-rhythm day. In the morning, she plowed through most of Lefebvre's theory in one go, her notebook densely covered with arrows and frameworks. In the afternoon, yoga made her stiff neck flexible again, and He Lu also asked her to try the newly opened yin yoga class next week. In the evening, she installed the meditation app and did not forget to make a commitment on WeChat Moments to that 'ten minutes a day' check-in. Before bed, she did not forget to fit in flower arranging, trimming the leftover roses and eucalyptus leaves from the previous day into a free-style arrangement and placing it on the corner of the desk.

events.name: Focused literature study at the library
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei sat down with her laptop and the books she had borrowed the day before at her favorite window seat in the library. She spent three hours finishing the rest of Chapter 3 of The Production of Space, and read it alongside the local scholar's paper on bookstores in Kunming. As she worked on the computer, she took excerpts and wrote annotations in her own words. She eventually organized about 5,000 words of notes and built a preliminary framework linking concepts such as 'spatial practice' and 'representational space' to the themes of the paper.

events.name: Afternoon recovery yoga practice
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went to Jingxin Yoga Studio again. Today was a core flow class; she worked hard to maintain her breathing rhythm and completed several sets of Boat Pose and Downward-Facing Dog. Although her abdomen was still trembling slightly, it was steadier than last week. After class, she met He Lu in the locker room, and they agreed to come next Tuesday to try the newly opened Yin Yoga class.

events.name: Download a meditation app and make a plan
events.description: At seven in the evening, Sun Yuwei searched for meditation apps on her phone and finally downloaded the highly rated 'Tide'. After registering, she joined a check-in community called '21-Day Meditation Introduction', and set Tuesday and Saturday afternoons as her regular meditation time, staggered with her yoga practice. She also told He Lu about the plan, and He Lu replied with a 'supervise.gif'.

events.name: Tried a short meditation before bed
events.description: At 11 p.m., after washing up, Sun Yuwei sat on the bed and opened the 5-minute bedtime meditation guide on Tide. She put on earphones and followed the guide to relax her body. Although she yawned midway, she felt her mind clearer than usual after it ended, and soon fell asleep.

events.name: Evening freestyle flower arrangement practice.
events.description: Before meditating, Sun Yuwei noticed the remaining roses and eucalyptus branches in the bucket, so she trimmed them on a whim, arranged them in a ceramic vase in a free-form flower style, and casually placed them in the corner of her desk. A faint fragrance accompanied her into sleep.

end_state.mood: Body relaxed, full of confidence in the meditation plan.

2025-02.daily_overview: Lantern Festival coincided with a major life event. She was still immersed in thesis literature when her phone buzzed with an invitation to sign a column contract. Her mother's gentle yet firm support left not a trace of hesitation in the finger that signed the agreement. That evening, the family ate tangyuan, and the pen her father gave her shone brighter than any lantern — today she officially became a columnist. Su Man came as promised, and in the afternoon the two of them sat on the balcony arranging a festival flower piece, filled with laughter and chatter.

events.name: All-Day Literature Study
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei continued reading the remaining ethnographic research papers on independent bookstores in the Yunnan University library. She singled out the application cases of oral history methods in research on different cultural spaces and made a memo of key operational points. At two in the afternoon, she moved to the reading area of Mingyuan Book House, and while drinking the ripe Pu'er tea brewed by Qin Mingyuan, she finished the last two papers against the soft background jazz. Over the course of the day, she completed about 5,000 characters of notes and summarized four main application models of the oral history method.

events.name: Lantern Festival flower arrangement with Su Man.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Su Man visited, bringing pink lilies and pine branches from Dounan. The two set up a worktable on the balcony, discussing the proportions of Ikenobo-style ‘rikka’ while creating a mixed-flower arrangement for the Lantern Festival. Su Man suggested naming the work ‘A Sense of Reunion’; Yuwei took a photo and sent it to her mother.

events.name: Received an invitation to sign a column contract
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., while Sun Yuwei was reading the last few pages in the bookstore, editor Xu Mingyuan sent her a formal invitation via WeChat for the "Kunming Slices" column of Culture Vision magazine, along with an electronic contract. She quickly browsed the contract terms: four 1,500-word articles about urban culture per month, at 300 yuan per 1,000 characters. Surprised and delighted, she closed her notebook and decided to call her mother immediately.

events.name: Discussed with mother and signed the contract
events.description: Sun Yuwei walked out of the bookstore and called her mother Li Xiulan on Wenlin Street. Her voice trembled slightly as she explained the column requirements and payment in detail. On the other end of the line, her mother happily kept saying, 'What great recognition this is!' and reminded her to carefully check the copyright ownership. With her mother's support, she went through the contract item by item on her phone again, then signed her name through an e-signature app. After taking a screenshot and saving it, she took two deep breaths before pushing the door open to return to the bookstore and pack up her things.

events.name: Family Lantern Festival dinner and celebration
events.description: At seven in the evening, Sun Yuwei returned home. Her mother had already cooked a pot of black sesame tangyuan and specially made Yuwei's favorite steam-pot chicken. Her father, Sun Mingyuan, came back from work carrying a long gift box—a blue Lamy fountain pen—saying he wanted to celebrate their daughter becoming a columnist. At the dinner table, the family of three ate tangyuan while listening to Yuwei talk about how she signed the contract. Her father took a sip of wine and said, uncharacteristically sentimental, 'Our family is going to produce a writer.' After dinner, they watched the Lantern Festival Gala for a while, with the bright full moon hanging high outside the window.

events.name: Journaling milestone
events.description: After clearing away the dishes at night, Sun Yuwei returned to her room and carefully wrote the signing date, 2.12, on this month's calendar in her journal. On that day's page, she stuck one of her treasured small gold medal stickers at the top left corner. She wrote: 'From today on, I am the storyteller of Kunming Slices. I need to write so that people like Uncle Qin will see it and nod.'

start_state.mood: Routine work, head buried in the literature

end_state.mood: Excited and joyful, with a strong sense of professional identity.

2025-02.daily_overview: The gears of column writing began to turn. The topic meeting settled on morning and evening on Wenlin Street, and the photos and recordings in her journal were pulled out again to savor. To write it well, she decided to grit her teeth and get up early tomorrow to gather material. The street scenes she photographed while strolling gave her more confidence about tomorrow’s images. In the afternoon, she suddenly got a call from He Lu, who invited her to take a walk around Cuihu Lake and watch the black-headed gulls over the weekend. Yuwei happily agreed.

events.name: Discussing column topics with the editor.
events.description: At ten in the morning, Sun Yuwei held an online topic selection meeting with editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat voice from her home study. Drawing on her earlier interview material with Qin Mingyuan, she proposed writing the first column piece on 'Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street,' portraying the daily life of the bookstore street through slices of time. Xu Mingyuan said the topic was very practical, reminded her to use more sensory details, and set the deadline a week later.

events.name: Review materials and plan the framework
events.description: After the call ended, Sun Yuwei opened the Kunming Writing Materials folder on her computer and found photos of the inside and outside of the bookstore taken a few days earlier, street ambient sound clips recorded during interviews, and scattered observation notes from her journal. She selected details such as the bookstore unloading its door planks in the morning light, the warm glow of evening, and Uncle Qin wiping the bookshelves, then wrote out an article outline in her notebook: introduction, morning scene paragraph, evening scene paragraph, character close-up, and closing reflections.

events.name: Formulate a photography plan for the field trip
events.description: During planning, she found that the photos on hand were not enough to reproduce the full atmosphere of dawn and dusk, so she decided to go to Wenlin Street with her mirrorless camera over the next two days to shoot early morning and evening separately. In her phone memo, she wrote down in detail the shooting time (arrive at Wenlin Street at 6:50 tomorrow morning), camera positions (in front of the bookstore, the corner of Qianju Street), and the light and shadow she needed to capture.

events.name: Scouting Wenlin Street before the evening
events.description: At four in the afternoon, realizing dusk light wouldn't wait, Sun Yuwei grabbed her mirrorless camera and cycled to Wenlin Street. She walked back and forth on the west side of the street twice, taking a few photos of people's shadows cast on old walls as sunlight filtered through the plane tree branches. At the entrance of an alley she met a resident walking a dog and chatted a little about the history of the street. On the way back she bought a hot oat milk, feeling more confident about the visual imagery for her article.

events.name: Organize reading notes.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei consolidated nearly 10,000 characters of thesis notes from handwriting and her computer over the previous two days. She used mind-mapping software to sort out the theoretical framework, marked the citation relationships among the various sources, and saved the key operational points of oral history methodology as a separate practical guide. After finishing this step, she let out a long sigh of relief, feeling that the literature review section of her thesis was beginning to take shape.

events.name: He Lu called to invite her for a walk.
events.description: At nine in the evening, He Lu called, saying the weather was nice on the weekend and wanted to invite Yuwei to Cuihu Lake to see the black-headed gulls that had just returned. The two chatted on the phone for twenty minutes, from yoga progress to newly released movies, and finally agreed to meet at the east gate of Cuihu Lake on Saturday morning.

start_state.mood: Eager to try, full of creative desire

end_state.mood: Looking forward to tomorrow, inspiration is spinning in my head.
