2025-02.daily_overview: An afternoon stuck in a creative bottleneck was enlightened by her mother’s ‘street vendor’s perspective.’ The editor’s phone call also acted like a reassuring pill, boosting her confidence in column writing. That evening, as she wrote down the new idea, the pen nib scratched softly—tomorrow, she would go to the vegetable market to take in the real breath of everyday life. The afternoon flow yoga was thoroughly invigorating, completely releasing her shoulders and neck, and also built up energy for tomorrow’s early rise.

events.name: Organize the feedback and call the editor
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei spread out her notebook in the study and listed a few points to confirm with editor Xu Mingyuan: the overall positioning of the column, the reader profile, and the acceptance of personal narrative. At exactly ten o'clock, she called Xu Mingyuan. The two chatted for half an hour. Xu Mingyuan affirmed the 'local perspective' and suggested that the second piece could write about Kunming's flower market or food market, encouraging her to 'put the fieldwork skills from her thesis to use.' After the call, she jotted down the words 'point the lens at ordinary people' in her notebook.

events.name: Routine vinyasa flow practice
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei arrived on time at the Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio for this week’s vinyasa flow yoga class. Today the teacher focused on the shoulder-and-neck relaxation sequence. In cat-cow pose and eagle pose, Yuwei felt the stiffness between her shoulder blades gradually melt away. After class, she chatted briefly with He Lu in the locker room, and the two confirmed their Sunday appointment at Green Lake.

events.name: Writing the first draft of 'Poems of the Wet Market' (first half)
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei opened a blank document and began writing the second essay in her collection, “The Poetry of the Vegetable Market.” She described the colors and vendor cries of the Zhuanxin Vegetable Market in her memory, but after writing 800 characters she got stuck — the words felt like a layer of gauze, not vivid enough. She stood up and spent a while on the balcony, listening to a few songs by Li Jian, but it still didn't improve.

events.name: Mother offered guidance on creative perspective
events.description: At seven in the evening, she mentioned her creative block to her mother at the dinner table. Her mother Li Xiulan picked up a piece of greens with her chopsticks and said, "Try becoming that auntie who sells mushrooms. How does she carry her shoulder pole in the morning, how does she bargain with people, and what is on her mind?" This remark made Sun Yuwei go back to the study right after dinner, write "immerse yourself in the vendor's five senses" on a sticky note, and decide to go to the wet market with her mother the next day to gather inspiration on site.

events.name: Received a postcard from my sister
events.description: While picking up a package in the evening, she received a postcard from her elder sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen. It featured a painting of the Shenzhen Bay Bridge and read, 'These days Shenzhen is as hot as summer. I miss the wind of Kunming. Keep up the column!' She tucked the postcard into her journal and felt a surge of support from afar.

start_state.mood: Clear thinking, with slight creative pressure

end_state.mood: Suddenly enlightened, looking forward to tomorrow's outing for inspiration.

state.daily_exercise: Vinyasa Flow Yoga, 60 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Clear, slightly cool in the morning, warm sunshine in the afternoon, temperature 7-18°C

2025-02.daily_overview: The lively atmosphere of the vegetable market gave the writing its true soul. I walked with my mother from stall to stall, the camera filled with glistening light and vivid colors. In the evening, I lost track of time revising the draft, until the cursor stopped at the ending and outside the window it was already pitch black. Rubbing my eyes, she sent the piece off — this poem finally had the breath of soil. In the morning, I walked with He Lu by Green Lake and watched the seagulls, already thinking that the next column could be about these migratory birds from afar.

events.name: Morning walk with He Lu at Cuihu Lake to watch seagulls
events.description: At eight in the morning, Sun Yuwei and He Lu met at the East Gate of Green Lake. The two strolled slowly along the lakeside path, while flocks of Siberian black-headed gulls circled and scrambled for food above the lake. He Lu had brought whole-wheat bread and gave some to Yuwei to feed the gulls. Yuwei used her phone to capture the moment when a gull spread its wings, thinking that these creatures that travel thousands of kilometers might also be a great subject for Kunming Slices. The two walked to near Nine Dragon Pool, found a bench, and sat down, chatting about what they had each seen and heard during the week. They agreed to meet again after yoga next Tuesday.

events.name: Field visit to Zhuanxin Food Market
events.description: At 10 a.m., Sun Yuwei rushed home to meet her mother and they went to Zhuanxin Vegetable Market together. Carrying her mirrorless camera, she strolled through the fresh meat section, vegetable section, and mushroom stalls. At the mushroom lady's stall, she crouched down to photograph the termite mushrooms still covered in soil, listening as the lady called out prices in Kunming dialect. At the tofu pudding stall, she pressed the shutter just as the vendor skimmed off the foam. Her mother picked out vegetables while casually telling her the stories behind each stall. The two stayed at the market for more than two hours, and at noon they went to a nearby noodle shop and ate two bowls of tofu pudding rice noodles.

events.name: Sort photos and materials in the afternoon.
events.description: Arriving home at 1:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei imported several hundred photos into her computer and selected more than twenty with the most vivid colors. She took a forty-minute nap to refresh herself, then sat back at her desk, arranged the photos according to the market's layout, and wrote handwritten notes beside them about the memorable sounds and scents from that day.

events.name: Spent the whole night revising the essay The Poetry of the Wet Market and shaping the column concept
events.description: At 8 p.m., Sun Yuwei opened her previous half-finished document and began making bold revisions. She made 'the auntie who sells mushrooms' the central character, adding details of carrying loads on a shoulder pole in the morning, the rhythm of her vendor calls, and small talk with regular customers, and weaving in the smells, textures, and crowds of the vegetable market. She was completely immersed in her writing, drinking half a pot of tea, until she typed the final period at 1 a.m. She saved the revised draft as 'The Poetry of the Vegetable Market · Final Version' and jotted down an inspiration at the end of the document: 'The seagulls and the food market are both the breathing of Kunming.' When she stood up, her back was stiff and sore, but her eyes were shining.

events.name: Send the sample manuscript to the editor.
events.description: Before going to sleep, Sun Yuwei sent a WeChat message to Xu Mingyuan: 'Editor, I wrote an essay about the vegetable market. It's not for the column, but I'd like you to critique it.' After attaching the document, she turned off her phone and plugged it in to charge. As she lay down, the bustle of the market and the cries of gulls at Cuihu Lake still echoed in her mind.

start_state.mood: Feeling invigorated, ready to conduct in-depth fieldwork.

end_state.mood: Tired but extremely satisfied; the breakthrough in the manuscript brought a sense of exhilaration

events.name: Morning meditation and journaling.

events.name: Tending to flower arrangements.
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei trimmed the lisianthus and eucalyptus leaves bought last week at Dounan Flower Market by the living room window at home, adjusted the branches according to Ikenobo style techniques, and placed the new arrangement in the center of the dining table.

events.name: Organize sharing notes for the book club
events.description: On the afternoon of February 16, Sun Yuwei was in her home study organizing her recent observation notes on independent bookstores in Kunming (including Mingyuan Bookstore, Xiangxing Bookstore, etc.), and selected her reading reflections on 'Old Stories of the South of the City' to write a sharing outline for the evening's online book club. She focused on the relationship between independent bookstores and urban culture, and prepared talking points based on her own experiences.

events.name: Join the online reading-sharing session.
events.description: On the evening of February 16 at 8 PM, Sun Yuwei joined the online reading-sharing session themed "City and Literature" held by the Douban Group via Tencent Meeting. events.description: After the book-sharing session, Sun Yuwei received Douban private messages from two fellow readers (one called Yang Fan, the other Zhou Min). The two expressed appreciation for her sharing and further discussed the topic of independent bookstores. Yuwei replied warmly, exchanging their respective views on urban literature and physical bookstores.

events.description: After exchanging private messages, Sun Yuwei, Yang Fan, and Zhou Min swapped WeChat IDs and moved their online contact to WeChat. Learning that Yang Fan was also a Kunming local, the two found they had more and more to talk about, so they agreed to go 'book hunting' at a distinctive independent bookstore together next weekend. 2025-02.daily_overview: At six-thirty on Monday morning, Sun Yuwei went to Wenlin Street to gather creative inspiration and capture the morning atmosphere of the old street. After returning home, she shut herself in her study and devoted herself to writing "Morning and Evening on Wenlin Street". The whole day was spent in intense writing and revising; several times her mother brought tea and snacks, but she barely paid attention. When she finally finalized the draft late at night, she was exhausted but filled with the satisfaction of completion.

events.name: Morning outing to Wenlin Street for inspiration
events.description: At 6:40 a.m. on February 17, Sun Yuwei walked alone to Wenlin Street in Kunming to observe the early morning scene: elderly people exercising, breakfast shops opening one after another, street vendors arranging flowers, and students riding bikes to school. Drawing on details from a previous interview recorded in her journal, she used her phone's memo app to jot down observations and took several photos, gathering vivid material for her column article.

events.name: Focus on writing the first draft of the column
events.description: After the field trip, Sun Yuwei returned to her home study and focused on writing the first piece of Kunming Slices, titled Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street. She depicted what she saw and felt with delicate brushstrokes, but during writing she was dissatisfied with the style and structure several times, overturned the draft and re-conceived it, revising and polishing repeatedly, engaged in intense creation from day to evening. During this time, her mother Li Xiulan twice brought her homemade sour plum drink and cut fruit; she simply thanked her and continued burying herself in writing.

events.name: Late-night revisions and finalization
events.description: Late on February 17, after a whole day of multiple revisions, Sun Yuwei finalized the text of *Morning and Dusk on Wenlin Street*. She checked the full text with satisfaction, saved the document after confirming it was error-free, backed it up to the cloud drive, and decided to submit it to the editor the next day.

events.name: Mother brought warm honey water.
events.description: At 11 p.m., her mother Li Xiulan knocked on the door and brought a cup of warm honey water, telling her not to stay up too late. Sun Yuwei responded that she would go to sleep soon. The brief conversation revealed her mother's care.

events.name: A brief reflection and relaxation before bed.
events.description: After finalizing the draft, Sun Yuwei chatted with her mother, who had not yet gone to bed, in the living room about what she had seen and heard during her field trips. She drank a glass of warm milk, spent five minutes doing a few shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the stiffness from sitting for a long time, and then washed up and went to bed.

start_state.mood: Because the drowsiness from waking early was intertwined with the anticipation of creating.

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied; finishing the manuscript brought a deep sense of fulfillment.

Sun Yuwei immediately revised it accordingly and resubmitted the final version before 11:00. The editor's quick approval encouraged her greatly.

events.name: Attending yoga class and sharing with partners
events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei walked to Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center to attend a flow yoga class. events.name: Planning fieldwork and reading materials for the thesis

events.name: Supermarket shopping with Mom and discussion of family dinner

events.name: Prepared materials for discussion with advisor

events.name: Going to Yunnan University
events.description: On the afternoon of February 19, Sun Yuwei set out from her home in Wuhua District, Kunming, walked to the bus stop, and took the bus to the School of Literature at Yunnan University. The trip took about 30 minutes.

events.name: Discussed thesis progress with supervisor
events.description: At 3 p.m. on February 19, Sun Yuwei discussed the progress of her graduation thesis with her advisor, Mr. Wu Mingyuan, in his office at the School of Liberal Arts, Yunnan University. Mr. Wu reviewed the interview records with Qin Mingyuan and highly praised the details about the changes in old Kunming bookstores revealed in the interview. He provided supplementary reference materials on oral history methods and suggested that she deeply integrate academic fieldwork with her column writing practice, producing writing that is both scholarly and warm. The discussion lasted about an hour.

events.name: Returned home and organized notes.
events.description: After the discussion ended, Sun Yuwei left the School of Literature and took the bus back home to Wuhua District, Kunming. Once home, she organized the teacher's suggestions into her thesis notebook and marked the passages from Qin Mingyuan's interview that could be used for her column writing.

events.name: Boiling brown sugar eggs and writing in the journal
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei cooked herself a bowl of brown sugar eggs. While eating, she jotted down ideas for her new column topic in her phone memo. During the day she carefully made a greeting card and selected a fountain pen; in the afternoon she celebrated her best friend Zhang Jing's new job at a café, sharing joy and future plans. In the evening she hurried to Yunnan University to attend a cultural geography lecture, and after speaking with the lecturer, she gained theoretical inspiration for placing independent bookstores within the space of urban cultural memory.

events.name: Making greeting cards and preparing gifts.
events.description: On the morning of February 20, Sun Yuwei made a new-job greeting card by hand for her best friend Zhang Jing in the study of her home in Kunming. She used colored pens to draw the exterior of Mingyuan Bookstore, where the two had often browsed together, and wrote a blessing inside the card. Then she took out a Hero fountain pen she had treasured from a drawer, and put it into a gift bag together with the card as a gift for starting the new job.

events.name: Celebrating with best friend Zhang Jing over coffee.
events.description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei walked from home carrying a gift bag to the 'Rainforest Café' in Wuhua District, Kunming. At 4:00 in the evening, she met Zhang Jing at the café. Sun Yuwei handed Zhang Jing a handmade greeting card and a fountain pen as a gift. Zhang Jing was very surprised and delighted, and the two hugged tightly. They ordered their favorite milkshakes and sat by the window. Zhang Jing shared details about starting her job at a cultural and creative company. Sun Yuwei expressed her congratulations, and they discussed their respective future plans. The conversation lasted about an hour and a half.

events.name: Attended an academic lecture.
events.description: On the evening of February 20, after a quick dinner at home, Sun Yuwei walked from home at 6:50 to the lecture hall of the School of Liberal Arts at Yunnan University to attend the lecture 'Urban Culture and Memory Spaces'. The speaker was a well-known cultural geographer in China. She took careful notes and, during the lecture, thought about how to apply memory-space theory to analyze Kunming's independent bookstores.

events.name: After the lecture, talked with the speaker.
events.description: After the lecture, Sun Yuwei took the initiative to talk with the speaker, using an independent bookstore in Kunming as an example to discuss the theoretical application of urban cultural memory spaces, and received the speaker's recommendation of a new perspective on 'emotional geography.' She then organized her notes and walked back home.

events.name: Make an appointment for a physical examination.

start_state.mood: Happy for my best friend, filled with warmth.

events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei went to the Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio to attend the weekly Friday flow yoga class. events.name: Rest and reading after physical examination.
events.description: After the health check-up, Sun Yuwei and her mother had a bowl of light rice noodles near the hospital, then went home. Feeling a bit tired, she lay in bed for half an hour, then sat in the study and continued reading the local cultural and historical materials Old Tales of Kunming borrowed from Mingyuan Bookstore, excerpting content about the historical changes of Wenlin Street in her notebook.

events.name: Evening walk in the neighborhood
events.description: At 5:30 in the evening, Sun Yuwei and her mother put on jackets and walked three laps around the garden in their residential community. As they walked, Yuwei listened to her mother talk about the recent news of old neighbors in the community. Sun Yuwei mentioned that her older sister, Sun Yutong, would video call tomorrow. Her mother happily said she would prepare some local specialties to send over. The walk made Sun Yuwei feel physically comfortable and temporarily forgot her worries about the physical exam.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous, a little uneasy about the physical exam results.

end_state.mood: After finishing the check-up, she breathed a sigh of relief, and after a walk she felt relaxed both physically and mentally.

state.daily_exercise: Take a 30-minute walk

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy with sunny spells, temperature 9°C to 19°C, abundant sunshine

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday afternoon, Sun Yuwei and her best friend Chen Sisi met at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum to see a group exhibition of young artists. Sisi interpreted the works from a professional perspective, while Yuwei resonated with them from a literary angle; the two gained a lot from the collision of art and literature. After the exhibition, they shared their thoughts at a café, and Yuwei encouraged Sisi to curate a joint exhibition of literature and art. After returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei pasted the exhibition inspirations next to the photos and organized them into her journal.

events.name: Confirm the exhibition visit arrangement with Chen Sisi
events.description: On the morning of February 23, Sun Yuwei contacted her best friend Chen Sisi from home in Kunming via WeChat to confirm the meeting details for viewing the 'Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition' at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum at 2 p.m. that day, and she had already looked up the participating artists' information online beforehand.

events.name: Go to the art museum to meet Sisi
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei took a bus from home to the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum and met Chen Sisi at the museum entrance at the agreed time. Sisi was wearing a gray coat. They smiled, hugged, and entered the museum together.

events.name: Viewing the group exhibition of young artists together
events.description: On the afternoon of February 23, Sun Yuwei and Chen Sisi carefully viewed the "Yunnan Young Artists Group Exhibition" at the Kunming Contemporary Art Museum. As a gallery administrative assistant, Chen Sisi used her professional knowledge to explain the creative background, techniques, and artistic concepts of each work to Sun Yuwei, while Sun Yuwei shared her feelings from the perspective of literary imagery and linguistic rhythm. The two stood before each work discussing it, and the collision of ideas gave Sun Yuwei a new understanding of the synesthesia between art and text.

events.name: Dessert shop gathering after the exhibition.
events.description: On the evening of February 23, after seeing the exhibition, Sun Yuwei and Chen Sisi went to a dessert shop beside the art museum and ordered rose yogurt and mango pomelo sago. Chen Sisi shared her experiences and amusing stories about curating exhibitions at the art museum, and Sun Yuwei encouraged her to try organizing an exhibition combined with literature in the future. As they parted, the two agreed to attend an artist lecture at the museum together next time.

events.name: Return home and organize exhibition notes
events.description: On the evening of February 23, Sun Yuwei returned home in Kunming and recorded today's ticket stubs, photos, and inspirations from the exhibition in her journal. She sketched the outline of the exhibition hall with colored pens and marked the term 'material memory' mentioned by Sisi as a clue for future writing. Before bed, she had a video call with her sister Sun Yutong and shared her impressions of the exhibition.

end_state.mood: Satisfaction and inspiration after being nourished by art

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-02.daily_overview: On Monday, Sun Yuwei went to the hospital alone to pick up her physical examination report and learned that her BMI was on the low side and she had mild iron-deficiency anemia. After returning home, she had a serious discussion with her mother about the report. Together they made a weight-gain diet plan and immediately went to the supermarket to buy high-protein ingredients. In the afternoon, mother and daughter designed a weekly meal plan in the kitchen together and posted it on the refrigerator. She set up a dedicated food diary page in her journal, determined to change her habits starting today. In the evening, she also walked a few laps around the neighborhood with her father, listening to him talk about his initial ideas for a retirement trip.

events.name: Morning meditation
events.description: After getting up at 7 a.m., Sun Yuwei did a 5-minute mindful breathing meditation in the bedroom. This is a new habit she added to help herself concentrate.

events.name: Pick up the physical exam report
events.description: At 9 a.m., Sun Yuwei went alone to the First People's Hospital of Kunming to pick up her physical examination report. The report showed that all indicators were basically normal, but her body mass index was low (BMI 17.2) and she had mild iron-deficiency anemia. The doctor advised her to strengthen her nutrition, eat regularly, and gain a modest amount of weight, and wrote a small note with dietary suggestions.

events.name: Discussing the physical exam results with Mom.
events.description: Returning home on the morning of February 24, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan carefully looked through every page of the report in the living room. Her mother pointed out the anemia indicators, and Sun Yuwei felt a bit upset, but her mother comforted her, saying, 'Youth is exactly the time for recuperation.' The two set goals together to gain weight and improve their diet, and decided to start that very day.

events.name: Shopping for nutritious ingredients at the supermarket.
events.description: At 10:30 a.m., Sun Yuwei and her mother went together to the Carrefour supermarket in Wuhua District, Kunming. Following an initial plan from a weight-gain recipe she had found online, she picked eggs, chicken breast, milk, broccoli, tomatoes, bananas, nuts, and whole wheat bread, among other ingredients, and the shopping cart was piled high.

events.name: Create a weight-gain meal plan and post it up
events.description: On the afternoon of February 24, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan worked together at the kitchen island to make a detailed weight-gain meal plan, deciding on the contents of three daily meals and two snacks, increasing high-quality protein, fruits, and vegetables. For example, breakfast always includes eggs and milk; lunch and dinner ensure meat and two vegetables; afternoon snacks are fruit or nuts; and a glass of hot milk before bed. Sun Yuwei neatly copied the meal plan onto a sticky note and put it on the refrigerator door.

events.name: Create a diet-tracking journal page.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei set aside a special "Diet Diary" page in her journal. Using a ruler, she drew a table with columns for date, three meals, snacks, water intake, exercise, and so on, and drew little apples and broccoli illustrations in the footer. She also pasted in today's shopping list.

events.name: Took an evening walk with my father.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., her father Sun Mingyuan suggested taking a walk after dinner, and Sun Yuwei accompanied him for four laps around the residential garden. Her father mentioned that after retirement he wanted to drive the whole family on a trip to western Yunnan, and Sun Yuwei excitedly said she could be in charge of planning the itinerary.

start_state.mood: A little nervous about the health checkup results.

end_state.mood: Becoming positive and determined thanks to clear goals and a firm resolve to act.

state.daily_exercise: Walk for 30 minutes, meditate for 5 minutes in the morning.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, temperature 9°C to 20°C, southerly winds in the afternoon.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Tuesday, at her mother's suggestion, Sun Yuwei bought a comprehensive accident insurance policy on her phone to cover her frequent upcoming trips. After her afternoon yoga class, she came home and found her father organizing a stack of printed travel materials on the table—he had drafted a retirement travel route for the West Yunnan loop. During dinner, the whole family sat around and discussed enthusiastically, finally settling on the approximate itinerary of Dali–Lijiang–Shangri-La. Her mother had also bought a few bunches of carnations to decorate the living room, and the home was filled with the scent of flowers and anticipation of the trip.

events.name: Morning meditation and nutritious breakfast
events.description: After getting up at 7:15 in the morning, Sun Yuwei did 5 minutes of morning meditation, then followed the recipe to eat a hearty breakfast: eggs, whole-wheat bread, and milk, and checked it off on her food diary.

events.name: Mother suggested buying accident insurance.
events.description: During breakfast, Sun Yuwei discussed with her mother Li Xiulan the risks of increased frequency of going out for creative inspiration and of planning domestic cultural trips. Her mother suggested she buy a one-year comprehensive accident insurance policy for basic protection. Sun Yuwei nodded in agreement, feeling it was necessary.

events.name: Purchase comprehensive accident insurance
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei used a mobile app in the study to browse one-year comprehensive accident insurance products from several insurance companies, comparing coverage amounts, premiums, and protection scope. She finally chose a comprehensive accident insurance policy with a premium of 380 yuan, filled in the insurance application information, and paid the premium with WeChat Pay. After receiving the electronic policy, she saved the file to her phone and cloud drive, and printed a paper copy for her journal folder.

events.name: Attend yoga class.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei went to the yoga studio for class as usual. Today's class added core strength exercises. Although she found it somewhat strenuous, she persisted to the end. After class, she made an appointment with He Lu to try a newly opened vegetarian restaurant together after Saturday's class. Before class, she also ate an extra banana as a snack.

events.name: Father brought out the initial draft of the retirement travel route.
events.description: Back home in the evening, Sun Yuwei found her father Sun Mingyuan spreading out a map of Yunnan and a printed itinerary on the living room coffee table. It turned out he had used his lunch break to put together a preliminary route for the western Yunnan loop trip, listing the driving distance and scenic spots for each day. Sun Yuwei excitedly sat down beside him and used her phone to look up accommodation reviews.

events.name: Family discussion finalizes the travel plan.
events.description: At the dinner table, the whole family discussed travel details while eating the stir-fried lean pork with wood ear mushrooms that Mother had specially made to supplement Sun Yuwei's iron. In the end they settled on the West Yunnan loop route: Kunming—Dali—Lijiang—Shangri-La—Deqin—back, planning to travel in June after Father retired. Mother Li Xiulan said on the spot that she could handle the flight and accommodation bookings, and Sun Yuwei would be responsible for finding bookstores and cafés along the way.

events.name: Mother Buying Flowers to Decorate the Home
events.description: In the afternoon, her mother Li Xiulan, who had gone out, brought back several bunches of pink carnations and baby's breath from Dounan Flower Market. She put them in the living room vase, and the whole home instantly became bright and cozy. Sun Yuwei photographed the bouquet with her phone and sent it to her older sister.

events.name: Evening walk
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei and her mother took a 30-minute walk around the neighborhood, keeping up their daily walking habit, and chatted about travel plans.

start_state.mood: The peace of mind that comes with having security.

end_state.mood: Full of anticipation for the family trip, enjoying a warm and harmonious family atmosphere.

state.daily_exercise: 1 hour of yoga, 30 minutes of walking, 5 minutes of morning meditation

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with brief showers in the afternoon, temperatures 10°C to 18°C.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Wednesday morning, Sun Yuwei carried her camera and headed to Dounan Flower Market to gather material. She wove through the market, chatted with flower farmers, took a large number of photos, and bought some freesias that were about to bloom. After returning home, she immediately imported the photos into her computer, organized the interview notes, and sorted out the framework for the second column, “Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market.” That evening she wrote at her desk until late at night, turning what she had seen and felt into lively words.

events.name: Morning meditation and breakfast
events.description: Sun Yuwei got up at 6:30 in the morning, did five minutes of meditation, ate a simple breakfast (eggs and cereal), and then set off.

events.name: Early morning visit to Dounan Flower Market to gather inspiration.
events.description: At 7 a.m. on February 26, Sun Yuwei brought her mirrorless camera, spare batteries, and notebook, and took the bus to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming. She moved through the market, observing the trade of bundled roses, lilies, and local unknown wildflowers, chatted with a few familiar vendors about the process of flowers from the fields to flower shops, and captured lively moments of an old flower farmer counting money and a tourist holding a bouquet. Before leaving, she bought a bunch of pale purple freesias, planning to arrange them in a vase at home.

events.name: Organizing Fieldwork Materials
events.description: After returning home at 11 a.m., Sun Yuwei imported the photos from her camera into her computer, selected more than 30 representative photos, and supplemented her notebook with key points from her conversation with the flower farmer. Combining this with her experience learning Ikenobo flower arranging, she preliminarily sketched out the structure of the article: from the clamor of the flower market to the quiet after a bunch of flowers enters a home. For lunch, her mother made beef noodles, and she ate a full bowl.

events.name: Evening walk
events.description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei took a 30-minute walk with her mother around the residential complex. Since there had been a shower outside, the air was fresh.

events.name: Write the initial draft of the second draft of the column article
events.description: On the evening of February 26, Sun Yuwei opened a document in her study and began writing the first draft of "Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market." She described the bustle of the flower market in the early morning, the rough hands of the flower farmers, and the emotional value different flowers carry, and ended with her delicate feelings as she arranged freesias. She was so absorbed in writing that she forgot her mother calling her to have a snack, until her mother brought milk and walnuts to her desk.

start_state.mood: Filled with the excitement of exploration

end_state.mood: The exhaustion after completing the first draft and the exhilarating satisfaction of creation.

state.daily_exercise: Walk for 30 minutes, meditate for 5 minutes in the morning.

date_attribute.weather: Showers turning cloudy, 8°C to 16°C, wet and slippery roads

2025-02.daily_overview: On Thursday, Sun Yuwei spent the day carefully polishing the flower market draft from the previous night, weighing every word, and only finalized it to her satisfaction in the afternoon. That evening she sent the article to editor Xu Mingyuan and immediately received a warm reply praising her for capturing the everyday life behind the flower market. After completing her second column, she rewarded herself with a hot brown sugar pearl milk tea, and discussed the plan for tomorrow's month-end review with her mother.

events.name: Morning meditation and nutritious breakfast
events.description: Sun Yuwei got up at 7:45, and after five minutes of meditation, ate the specially prepared spinach and pork liver congee and boiled eggs to boost her iron intake. She filled out her food diary carefully.

events.name: Revise and polish the column manuscript.
events.description: During the day on February 27, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and revised the first draft completed the previous night paragraph by paragraph. She cut lengthy descriptions and added a dialect phrase from a flower farmer, making the article more vivid. Several times she got up to study the freesias she had arranged, checking their forms and correcting her wording. It was not until 4 p.m. that she felt the article was ready for finalization.

events.name: Evening stroll and chat with Mom
events.description: At 5 p.m., Sun Yuwei and her mother took a walk in the neighborhood. The air was damp after the rain, and her mother reminded her to remember to weigh herself tomorrow.

events.name: Submitted the manuscript and received the editor's praise
events.description: At 7 p.m. on February 27, Sun Yuwei submitted the final draft of 'Flowers and Life at Dounan Flower Market' by email to editor Xu Mingyuan. In less than an hour, the editor replied on WeChat, praising her 'remarkable observation' and saying she 'captured the soul of the flower market,' and encouraged her to continue uncovering the poetry in Kunming's daily life. Sun Yuwei happily took a screenshot of the editor's words and saved it.

events.name: Drank milk tea to celebrate and chatted with her mother.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei bought a cup of hot brown sugar pearl milk tea at a milk tea shop near her home as a small reward for herself. After getting home, she sat on the sofa with her mother and shared the editor's feedback. Her mother stroked her head, proud of her. When the conversation came around to the end of the month, Sun Yuwei said that tomorrow she would do a proper review of February and plan her March column topics and thesis progress.

start_state.mood: Woke up with the afterglow of creative work, looking forward to finalizing the draft.

end_state.mood: Filled with joy after receiving recognition, and motivated for future creative work.

state.daily_exercise: Walk for 30 minutes, meditate for 5 minutes in the morning.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, with scattered light rain in the evening, temperature 7°C to 15°C.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of February, Sun Yuwei opened her journal at home in the morning to review her finances and creative work, recording royalty income, travel fund deposits, and dietary improvements. At noon, the family unanimously approved the final western Yunnan loop route refined by her father, and her father began calling to book accommodation. In the afternoon, she organized her healthy eating records and brainstormed topics for the March column. In the evening, she walked with her mother in the rain, and after attending a yoga class at night, she wrote a clear to-do list for the next month and fell asleep feeling fulfilled and expectant.

events.name: Morning meditation and breakfast
events.description: Sun Yuwei got up at 7:30 in the morning, did 5 minutes of morning meditation, then ate a bowl of beef rice noodles with an egg while recording her diet.

events.name: Month-end journal review
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and opened her journal to review February's income and expenses: column royalties of 2,400 yuan (fees for two articles still pending settlement, with part of the advance already received), 2,000 yuan deposited into the travel fund, and daily expenses mainly for groceries and insurance. On her creative progress page, she pasted printed samples of the two finalized articles from this month and annotated the editor's feedback. The weight record showed an increase of 0.4 kg, but her anemia had not improved significantly; she reminded herself to stick to the iron-rich diet in March.

events.name: The whole family approved the final route for the retirement trip.
events.description: At noon, her father Sun Mingyuan spread the revised travel plan on the dining table and explained in detail the daily driving distances, planned accommodation points, and alternative options. After listening, her mother Li Xiulan and Sun Yuwei unanimously approved the final West Yunnan loop itinerary: set out on June 2, first go to Dali to circle Erhai Lake, then Lijiang Old Town, then Tiger Leaping Gorge, then Shangri-La, and finally view Meili Snow Mountain from Deqin before returning. Her father immediately called a retired colleague to ask about inns along the route and began booking the most popular ones.

events.name: Organize healthy diet records
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei summarized the week's data on the diet-tracking page of her journal. She found that she had kept up well with snacks, but sometimes did not drink enough water. She used a highlighter to mark the areas that needed strengthening, and decided that starting in March, she would drink a glass of warm water every morning before breakfast.

events.name: Brainstorming topics for the March column
events.description: After organizing her health records, Sun Yuwei opened her notebook and wrote down several keyword ideas for her March column: mornings at the Zhuanxin Food Market, the pingtan-performing elderly at Green Lake Park, and the changes of the flower market on Shangyi Street. She planned to visit Mingyuan Bookstore on the weekend to ask Boss Qin for some old photos as reference.

events.name: Evening walk in the rain
events.description: At 5 p.m., a light drizzle began in Kunming. Sun Yuwei and her mother walked around the neighborhood under an umbrella, breathing the moist air, and talked about tomorrow being March 1, planning to deposit another 2,000 yuan into the travel fund. Her mother reminded her to also start paying attention to the mid-term review schedule for her graduation project.

events.name: After attending yoga class, made next month's plan.
events.description: At 7 PM, Sun Yuwei went to Jingxin Yoga Life Studio for Friday's vinyasa flow yoga class. During meditation, she set 'deep cultivation' as her keyword for March. After returning home, she wrote March to-dos on a sticky note: save for travel fund (3/1), check out restaurants with Yang Fan (3/5), complete the field research for the third piece in the essay collection, and conduct the second interview for her thesis. She stuck the note on the wall directly in front of her desk.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei did a 15-minute body scan meditation, reviewed the day, and fell asleep feeling content.

end_state.mood: Clear goals, filled with determination and anticipation for March after having made plans.

state.daily_exercise: 1 hour of vinyasa yoga, 30 minutes of walking, 5 minutes of morning meditation, 15 minutes of bedtime meditation.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the first day of August, Sun Yuwei started the new month with a short morning run. Though she was out of breath, the beautiful scenery of Cuihu Lake lifted her spirits. In the morning, she set up her workspace at Mingyuan Bookstore and organized the revision comments from her advisor and editor. In the afternoon, she printed a sample copy of her essay collection and bought a pair of professional running shoes. In the evening, she started the monthly bookkeeping and reviewed her meal plan — fulfilling and well-organized.

events.name: Try a morning run around Green Lake.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei put on her old sports shoes and walked from her home on Renmin Middle Road to Green Lake Park. She jogged slowly along the lake, but because she had not exercised for a long time, she was out of breath after only 800 meters and had to switch to brisk walking. The morning glow over Green Lake and the egrets moved her, and she resolved to make running part of her routine. After stretching, she walked home and used her phone to record her first running experience.

events.name: Buy professional cushioned running shoes
events.description: In the afternoon, at the recommendation of her yoga partner He Lu, Sun Yuwei went to a sporting goods store in Wuhua District, tried on and bought a pair of lightweight, cushioned running shoes to prepare for subsequent training.

events.name: Start monthly bookkeeping and budgeting
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei downloaded a money-tracking app on her phone, set categories such as fitness, dining, and creative work, listed the flexible-employment social insurance deducted on the 15th of each month as a fixed expense, and recorded her first spending. She drew a savings progress bar on the financial page of her journal and resolved to take control of her personal income and expenses.

events.name: Maintaining the creative ritual at her workspace
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei came to Mingyuan Bookstore. Following her usual routine at the start of the month, she took down the old sticky notes, put up the August goal cards, decorated the desk with fresh-cut eucalyptus leaves and dried flowers, and stuck a photo of her workspace in her journal with the words 'August, take it slowly.'

events.name: Organize the revision comments and formulate a revision plan
events.description: At her workstation, Sun Yuwei consolidated advisor Wu Mingyuan's email comments and editor Xu Mingyuan's voice suggestions, highlighted key points in the sample book with a marker, and created a 10-day chapter-by-chapter revision plan, which she posted on her partition.

events.name: Print a sample copy of the prose collection
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei took the electronic manuscript of "Slow Travel Notes" to Yunyin Print Shop on Wenlin Street. She chose cream-white paper and thread binding, and printed and bound 10 sample copies. When she smelled the ink, she felt for the first time the real sense of the work taking shape.

events.name: Reviewed the weight-gain diet and adjusted next week's menu
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei looked through last week's food diary and found that vegetables and protein were still lacking. She discussed this with her mother, Li Xiulan, and set next week's menu, adding eggs, tofu, and broccoli. Her mother agreed to go to the vegetable market together the next morning.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Renmin Middle Road
start_state.mood: Looking forward to the start of the new month

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Renmin Middle Road
end_state.mood: Fulfilled and a little tired

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 0.8 kilometers, walking about 5 kilometers

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, I went out for photography to capture the light and shadows of Green Lake. In the late morning, I designed my first set of botanical stickers at home. In the afternoon, I gave sample copies of my essay collection to my parents and advisor. In the evening, I shared my creative routine on Xiaohongshu. The pace was gentle yet full of ritual.

events.name: Photography class outdoor shooting practice at Green Lake
events.description: At 8 a.m., Sun Yuwei brought a borrowed mirrorless camera to the outdoor shooting session of her photography course. Under the teacher's guidance, she tried horizontal compositions of the lake and lotus flowers, learned aperture-priority mode, and took candid shots of elderly people doing morning exercise, accumulating visual material for her writing.

events.name: Designed and hand-printed the Botanical series stickers.
events.description: After getting home in the morning, Sun Yuwei opened her drawing tablet and drew simple patterns such as leaves and vines, printed them on sticker paper with a home printer, carefully cut them out, and pasted them into her journal. Though the result was a bit clumsy, she enjoyed the joy of creating something by hand.

events.name: Give complimentary copies to my parents and mentor.
events.description: At noon, Sun Yuwei gave three sample copies to her father Sun Mingyuan and mother Li Xiulan, who read them with satisfaction. In the afternoon, she met her advisor Wu Mingyuan at the Yunnan University faculty apartment, presented the sample copies in person and briefly explained her revision approach. Professor Wu promised to read them carefully and add annotations.

events.name: Updated the sticker creation process on Xiaohongshu.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei uploaded the sticker design steps and photos of the finished product to "Yuwei's Slow Journal", with a caption recording her crafting insights, and received likes and comments from fans, replying to a few casually.

events.name: Accompanied mother for a walk around Cuihu Lake in the evening
events.description: After dinner, mother suggested going for a walk around Green Lake. The mother and daughter strolled along the lakeside for half an hour, chatting about elder sister Sun Yutong's recent situation and Sun Yuwei's creative plans. Mother encouraged her not to push herself too hard.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Renmin Middle Road

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Renmin Middle Road
end_state.mood: Satisfied, somewhat looking forward to feedback

state.daily_exercise: Morning outdoor photo shoot, walking about 5 km; evening stroll of 2 km

2025-08.daily_overview: Braving the showers at Mingyuan Bookstore, she buried herself in revising the first three chapters of the prose collection. In the afternoon, she gave sample copies to close local friends and to teachers and friends far away. In the evening, she had a video chat with her elder sister, warmed by family affection. Although the rain disrupted her walking plan, her writing made solid progress.

events.name: Focus on revising the first three chapters of the essay collection
events.description: Light rain in the early morning. Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Bookstore with an umbrella. At her regular seat, she revised chapter by chapter according to her advisor's and editor's comments, adjusted paragraph order, cut redundant descriptions, and marked the improved parts with green labels. Outside the window, the rain rustled; at the desk, she was fully focused.

events.name: Distributing sample copies to Qin Mingyuan, Zhang Jing, and courier Zhou Lin
events.description: After the rain stopped in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei first went to Mingyuan Bookstore to give the sample copy to Qin Mingyuan. Boss Qin praised the writing and agreed to give feedback. Then she met her best friend Zhang Jing at a café, handed over the sample copy, and exchanged journaling ideas. On the way home, she sent a sample copy to Zhou Lin in Shenzhen via Cainiao Station, and prepared to courier the other copy to editor Xu Mingyuan the next day.

events.name: Video call with her elder sister Sun Yuting.
events.description: At 9 p.m., Sun Yuwei video-called her older sister in Shenzhen for 40 minutes. Her sister shared updates on her new project, and Sun Yuwei talked about the progress on her essay collection. Her sister encouraged her and promised to bring cultural creative gifts next time. The two agreed that if her sister came back to Kunming at the end of August, they would visit some trendy shops together.

events.name: At-home shoulder and neck stretching and meditation.
events.description: Since the weather kept her from exercising outside, Sun Yuwei did neck and shoulder stretches and 10 minutes of abdominal breathing meditation before bed to relieve the fatigue of sitting for hours while revising her draft.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Renmin Middle Road

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Renmin Middle Road
end_state.mood: Warm, and full of anticipation for future feedback.

state.daily_exercise: No special exercise; walked about 6 km outside

2025-08.daily_overview: On Monday morning, I extended my running distance to one kilometer; the small progress was delightful. During the day at the bookstore, I gathered materials for a new column piece and scheduled an interview, the daily routine of a professional writer busy yet orderly. In the evening, I made a brief record on Xiaohongshu, also passing on the warmth of perseverance to strangers.

events.name: Second morning run, breaking the one-kilometer mark
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei changed into her running shoes and went to Green Lake. She adjusted her breathing and jogged slowly. Although she got a stitch on the way, she persisted and completed 1 kilometer in about 8 minutes. After stretching, she sat by the lake watching an elderly person practice tai chi, feeling calm and more confident.

events.name: Collect materials for the column and determine the interview direction
events.description: At 9 a.m. at Mingyuan Bookstore, Sun Yuwei created a new document 'Kunming Column August', searched for historical articles on independent bookstores, flipped through notes from her conversation with Qin Mingyuan, settled on 'The Changing Independent Bookstores of Kunming' as the theme, and listed three bookstores to visit.

events.name: Call to schedule an interview at Bowen Bookstore
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei called Elder Li at Bowen Bookstore on Dongfeng West Road using the contact information Qin Mingyuan had given her, and successfully scheduled an in-person meeting for Wednesday morning. In her journal, she drafted an interview outline covering the bookstore's founding story, operational changes, and old street culture.

events.name: Share running progress on Xiaohongshu
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei posted her morning run photo and 1 km record to Xiaohongshu, with the caption 'From 800 meters to 1 kilometer, take it slow.' She replied to encouraging comments and browsed updates from several book bloggers.

events.name: Received initial voice feedback from editor Xu Mingyuan about the sample book.

2025-08.daily_overview: First hike in Xishan, rekindled friendship with childhood friend Zheng Yu. The spectacular view of Dianchi Lake from the summit opened my mind, and we made a pact to hike every month; in the evening, a walk uncovered our family's cultural heritage, and at night, the watercolor class taught the dry-layering method, letting body, mind, and spirit relax amidst nature and art.

events.name: Xishan Forest hike
events.description: At 6:30 a.m., she got up to prepare for the Xishan hike. She changed into sportswear and hiking shoes, packed mineral water, nuts, sunscreen, and her journal into her backpack, and confirmed with her childhood friend Zheng Yu that they would meet at 9:00 at the main gate of Xishan Forest Park. She set off at 8:15, took a dedicated bus line for 40 minutes, and met Zheng Yu, who had been waiting early. From Qianbu Cliff to Longmen, the route was about 6 km with an elevation gain of 400 m. She started at a fast pace at first, but after half an hour she was out of breath and her legs ached. Zheng Yu taught her to adjust her breathing (inhale for two steps, exhale for two steps), and she gradually adapted. Along the way, they enjoyed the azaleas and old trees and chatted about what was going on in their lives. At 11:10, they reached the Longmen viewing platform at an altitude of about 2,300 m, overlooking the vast blue waves of Dianchi Lake and suddenly feeling a sense of expansiveness. The two rested on a bench and ate nuts. Zheng Yu took photos of Yuwei, and she recorded her feelings in her journal. At 11:50, they descended along the gentle slope, and Zheng Yu reminded her to control her speed. At 1:00 p.m., they reached the foot of the mountain, had a lunch of cold rice noodles at a nearby snack shop, and then went home separately. Yuwei got home at 2:00, soaked her feet to relax, then recorded the route, her feelings, and the photos in detail in her journal. She wrote: "Standing on the mountaintop looking at Dianchi Lake, I suddenly felt my heart open up. It turns out nature's power is so healing." She set a goal to include at least one outdoor hike each month starting next month in her journal's monthly habit tracker. She selected today's photos and posted them on Moments with the caption: "First hike check-in, in love with the wind on the mountaintop."

Mother shared her original intention in choosing to become a Chinese language teacher because she loved literature. Sun Yuwei was pleasantly surprised to discover that her interest in writing had a family origin, so she opened a special chapter titled "Literary Legacy" in her material notebook. When they reached the fish-viewing platform in the center of the park, the three of them stopped to watch koi competing for food. Father talked impromptu about the first large-scale renovation of Green Lake in 1986 and pointed out where things had been. After returning home, Sun Yuwei backed up the recorded conversation (with her parents' consent) to cloud storage as important material for future writing.

2025-06.daily_overview: Rehabilitation yoga eased my shoulders and neck; floral design inspiration surged; the unexpected farewell with Lin Shen stirred emotional ups and downs. Mother's summer vacation made home even warmer.

events.name: Confirm the rehabilitation yoga private lesson and make preparations.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Sun Yuwei sent a WeChat message to He Lu from the study at home to confirm the time of the 2 p.m. private rehabilitation yoga class. He Lu replied, "Okay, I'll be waiting for you." She then prepared her yoga clothes, sports water bottle, and sweat towel, put them into a canvas bag, and watched a few videos He Lu had sent of shoulder and neck relaxation poses to preview.

events.name: Mother Li Xiulan is on summer break; family lunch.
events.description: At noon, her mother Li Xiulan finished her end-of-semester work and came home from school, carrying freshly bought vegetables and a roast duck. She said happily, 'Summer vacation is finally here. These two months I can properly stay with you two.' She cooked her specialty tomato and egg noodles, and Sun Yuwei helped set out the bowls and chopsticks. At the table, Li Xiulan mentioned that she planned to go to the community center every day to do aerobics, and also wanted Yuwei to teach her flower arranging. Sun Yuwei smiled and agreed, feeling that the home was a little livelier.

events.name: Heading to the yoga studio, enjoying the street view
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei changed into comfortable clothes, slung on her canvas bag, and set off from home. It was sunny today, so she decided to walk (about 25 minutes) to the Jingxin Yoga Life Studio in Panlong District, passing familiar streets and plane tree shade along the way, feeling relaxed and expectant.

events.name: One-on-one therapeutic yoga practice to relieve shoulder and neck tension
events.description: From 2 to 3 p.m., in the private training room at the yoga studio, He Lu guided Sun Yuwei through 60 minutes of rehabilitative yoga. The class focused on the neck, shoulders, and upper back, using movements such as Cat-Cow, Eagle arms, and wall-assisted shoulder openers, combined with breathing to gradually release tight muscles. He Lu occasionally touched her shoulder blades gently to correct her alignment and encouraged her to “focus on the breath and breathe out the stress.” Sun Yuwei felt that the stiffness in her neck and shoulders from long hours of writing at her desk had clearly eased.

events.name: After-class exchange and going home
events.description: After the class, Sun Yuwei drank a glass of lemon water in the rest area and shared her practice feelings with He Lu. He Lu suggested doing three simple stretches for 5 minutes every day (neck side bend, shoulder circles, doorway chest opener), and they agreed on the next fixed class time (next Tuesday). Sun Yuwei noted it carefully in her journal, then packed up and walked home. She realized that "self-care should begin with small daily persistence."

events.name: Planning the first floral design
events.description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei returned home, spread the floor plan of the yoga studio on her desk in the study, and, based on He Lu's request that "green and white flowers bring a sense of tranquility," began to conceive the first floral design of July. She decided on the theme of "Summer Charm and Gentle Breeze," chose white calla lilies, green areca palm leaves, white jasmine, and light green lisianthus, paired with a ceramic vase, and sketched the general layout and budget list in her notebook.

events.name: Saying goodbye to Lin Shen at Mingyuan Bookstore
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei walked to Mingyuan Book House, intending to return the copy of Eight Lessons on Poetry she had borrowed last time. As soon as she entered, she found Lin Shen, a graduate student in the history department, sitting in his usual spot. He smiled and said, "I'm leaving campus tomorrow, so I came specially to wait for you." He took out from his backpack a handwritten anthology of modern poetry—neatly copied on loose-leaf paper with poems by Bei Dao, Gu Cheng, and Hai Zi, and a kapok flower drawn on the cover. Lin Shen said, "Your words have power. Please keep writing." Sun Yuwei took the poetry collection, her fingertips trembling slightly, and thanked him in a low voice. They talked a little longer about literature and the future, but there was more silence. When the bookstore closed, Lin Shen shouldered his bag and walked into the night. Sun Yuwei stood at the door watching until his figure disappeared. She opened the first page of the anthology, on which was written, "For Yuwei, wishing you freedom in writing—Lin Shen, 2025.6.20." After this farewell, the two never saw each other again.

end_state.mood: Melancholy and moving

state.daily_exercise: Walked to and from the yoga studio and the bookstore; 60 minutes of rehabilitative yoga

2025-06.daily_overview: Using words to remember a meteor-like encounter, the day was spent in creation, rest, and family companionship, and my heart gradually calmed. An evening walk soothed my emotions.

events.name: Writing the prose piece A Solo Journey
events.description: After a restless night, Sun Yuwei woke up at 6 a.m. She sat down in the study, the scene of Lin Shen handing over the poetry collection last night replaying in her mind, emotions churning. She opened a blank document and began to write about this brief yet profound encounter. From the first conversation at dusk on June 10 in the bookstore, to several late-night chats, to yesterday's farewell, she depicted the emotional journey with delicate strokes, turning unspoken feelings into words. By 11 a.m., a 2,000-character essay was completed, titled “A Journey Alone”. She read it again, smiling through tears, and saved it to the folder of her essay collection “Slow Travel Notes” as the 16th piece.

events.name: Afternoon yoga practice and meditation
events.description: Emotionally drained after writing, at 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei did a gentle yin yoga sequence on her yoga mat in the study, holding each pose for 3-5 minutes to let her thoughts settle. Afterward, she sat in meditation for 10 minutes, feeling the flow of her breath.

events.name: Visited the vegetable market with her mother to prepare summer ingredients
events.description: In the evening, her mother, Li Xiulan, took Sun Yuwei to the nearby Zhuanxin Farmers' Market. Summer mushrooms were in season, so they bought green-cap mushrooms and porcini mushrooms, planning to make mushroom hot pot for dinner. Sun Yuwei also bought flowers, blueberries, and mint to brighten up the home. The market was buzzing with voices and full of the flavor of everyday life.

events.name: Family dinner, sharing graduation photos
events.description: At 7 p.m., the family of three sat around eating mushroom hot pot. Sun Yuwei cast her phone to the TV and shared photos and videos from the graduation ceremony. Her parents smiled and laughed while watching, and her father, Sun Mingyuan, remarked that his daughter had grown up. After the meal, Sun Yuwei carefully put the poetry collection Lin Shen had given her into a drawer, deciding to treasure this memory.

events.name: Evening walk around Green Lake to process thoughts.
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei went alone to Cuihu again and walked around the lake for about 30 minutes. On the night of the summer solstice, a gentle breeze was blowing. Thinking about the day's writing, she made up her mind to continue and complete the essay collection.

events.name: Bedtime reading and journaling
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei read the nonfiction work River Town recommended by Yang Xiao in bed for an hour, then made a brief journal entry about today's writing reflections, and finally turned off the lights at 23:00.

end_state.mood: Tranquility

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes of yoga, about 8,000 steps walking around the market and Green Lake.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Sunday, went home to visit parents, and amid warmth formally bid farewell to campus life. Family memories and future plans interweave, a warm and grounded happiness.

events.name: Returned to school to check out of the dormitory and bought gifts.
events.description: On Sunday morning, Sun Yuwei took the bus back to Yunnan University, went to the dormitory management office to complete the formal check-out procedures, returned her keys, and retrieved a few forgotten notebooks from the locker. Afterwards, she walked to the time-honored pastry shop 'Dianxiangyuan' near the school and bought freshly baked flower cakes, her mother's favorite, and an old-tree pu'er tea cake, her father's favorite, and packed them in a gift box.

events.name: Returning home with gifts and warm family interaction
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei took a bus back to her home in Wuhua District carrying gifts. When she entered, her father Sun Mingyuan was reading the newspaper in the living room, and her mother Li Xiulan came out of the kitchen upon hearing her. Sun Yuwei handed over the gifts: "Mom, the flower cakes you like are still warm; Dad, this is fine Pu'er." Her mother took them in surprise, and her father smiled and thanked her. The three sat down and chatted. Sun Yuwei mentioned that she had completed the dormitory check-out procedure and truly said goodbye to college life.

events.name: Mother felt emotional about my independence and gave a warm hug.
events.description: Her mother stroked her daughter’s hand and said with emotion, “That little girl who needed me to walk her to the classroom door at the start of school is now a grown young woman who can sign contracts and write articles on her own. It really makes me reluctant to let you go.” Sun Yuwei’s eyes reddened, and she stepped forward to give her mother a tight hug. “Because I have you both as my support, I dare to fly freely.” Her father, Sun Mingyuan, sat nearby, a smile at the corner of his mouth, silently watching them.

events.name: Looking through old photo albums, recalling childhood together
events.description: After dinner, her father pulled out a few yellowed photo albums from deep inside the study cabinet. The family of three squeezed together on the sofa, looking from Sun Yuwei's hundred-day photo to her first recitation on stage in elementary school, winning an award in middle school, and graduating from high school... Her parents told the story behind each photo, and laughter never stopped. Sun Yuwei took photos of several childhood pictures, saying she would use them later for her memoirs. Late into the night, they put the albums away, still reluctant to stop.

events.name: Plan the first draft of the summer road trip
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei briefly discussed the route for the summer road trip to Yunnan with her father in the study. Her father took out a map of Yunnan and marked several alternatives: the Dali-Lijiang route, the Xishuangbanna route, and the Shangri-La route. In the end, they tentatively settled on starting from Kunming in late July, going around Dianchi Lake and then on to Dali, with the specifics to be decided. Sun Yuwei recorded the travel ideas in her journal, looking forward to the family trip.

end_state.mood: Warm and happy

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 6,000 steps

2025-06.daily_overview: Kicking off the first full work week after graduation, I woke up the ritual of working from home by revamping my study. Everything is in order, and creative energy is high.

events.name: Thoroughly organized the study and divided it into two functional zones.
events.description: In the morning, with her mother's help, Sun Yuwei did a thorough reorganization of her study. She arranged the writing area by the window with the best light, placing a laptop and a drawing tablet on the left side of the desk and frequently used reference books and journaling materials on the right. On the other side against the wall, she set up a flower arrangement practice area, laid a waterproof mat, and placed tools such as a kenzan, flower scissors, and a water basin, and hammered up a white pegboard to hang her ikebana apron. Her mother helped wipe the windowsill, and her father helped move the bookcase. After three hours of work, the study was completely refreshed, and writing and flower arranging no longer interfered with each other. Sun Yuwei took a satisfied photo and decided to write a reflection on the reorganization in the evening.

events.name: Planning this week's column topics
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei sat in her tidied study, opened her note-taking app, and planned the next topic for her 'Kunming Slices' column. She listed three directions: 'A Field Guide to Wild Vegetables at Zhuanxin Farmers Market,' 'The Morning Exercise Ecology of Cuihu Park,' and 'Time at the Old Teahouse on Wenming Street.' After comparing them, she decided to write about the old teahouse first, and planned to spend the next two days on a field visit to Wenming Street. She marked in her planner: field trip on Wednesday and Thursday, first draft on Friday.

events.name: Email communication with editor Xu Mingyuan about the new draft.
events.description: Sun Yuwei emailed Xu Mingyuan, reporting her topic idea about the old teahouse, and attached the revised draft of "The Bustling Life of Wenlin Street Morning Market" as well. Xu Mingyuan replied quickly, affirmed the topic, and reminded her to pay attention to the demeanor of guests from different generations in the teahouse.

events.name: Evening yoga practice (online follow-along)
events.description: At 6 p.m., Sun Yuwei sat on her yoga mat in the study and followed along for 45 minutes with the online “Shoulder and Neck Rehabilitation Yoga” video recommended by He Lu, focusing on repeating the movements she had learned on Friday to retain muscle memory.

events.name: Evening walk in the neighborhood to relax.
events.description: After yoga, Sun Yuwei went downstairs and walked slowly around the neighborhood for about 40 minutes, listening to music and reviewing the day's work to recharge for tomorrow.

events.name: Bedtime reading and social media updates
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei read parts of Fei Xiaotong's From the Soil on WeRead, then posted a photo-and-text post on Xiaohongshu under the name "Yuwei Slow Notes," showing the before-and-after comparison of her study and a corner of her journal, with the caption: "Zoning the space, and tidying the heart - the first full workday after graduation." She soon received a fan comment: "So healing."

end_state.mood: Satisfied and organized

state.daily_exercise: 45 minutes of yoga, 40 minutes of evening walk.

2025-06.daily_overview: A day of full preparation for the flower arrangement workshop: yoga practice brought energy, buying tools and previewing knowledge, and unexpectedly meeting Su Man at the flower market added even more confidence.

events.name: Regular early morning yoga class: flow yoga
events.description: At 7 a.m., Sun Yuwei got up early and went to the Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center to attend the 8 a.m. Vinyasa flow yoga class. It was her first scheduled practice of the week. Following the instructor's fluid sequence of poses, her body warmed up slightly. Yoga refreshed her and stored up energy for the day's shopping and preparations.

events.name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to purchase flower arrangement tools
events.description: At 9 a.m., after finishing yoga, Sun Yuwei went home, had a quick breakfast, and carrying a large eco-friendly bag, took Metro Line 1 to Dounan Flower Market in Chenggong District. As the largest fresh-cut flower trading market in the country, the moment she stepped through the gate, a sea of colorful flowers and the buzz of the crowd rushed toward her. She found a professional flower arrangement supply store, and following the owner's recommendation, bought a beginner's kenzan (medium), a pair of Ikenobo flower scissors, an antique-style water dish, and a roll of binding aluminum wire, spending about 300 yuan. She also bought a few pink carnations and eucalyptus leaves to try at home.

events.name: Bumped into Su Man and discussed workshop details
events.description: In the rest area at the center of the flower market, Sun Yuwei ran into Su Man, a fellow flower-arranging enthusiast. Su Man excitedly told her that she was the assistant instructor for this three-day Ikenobo flower arrangement workshop. She took out the course schedule and shared with Sun Yuwei the theme for each day — rikka, seika, and jiyuka — and some of the instructor's preferences, emphasizing, “Make sure to choose a heavy kenzan, or it won't be stable.” The two strolled around the flower market a bit longer and agreed to share a ride to the classroom the next morning.

events.name: In the afternoon, tried pre-treatment of free-style flower arrangement
events.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei was in the floral arrangement practice area. Using the newly bought flower materials and tools, she tried to preprocess them: trimming branches, removing leaves, and making cuts, and tried to fix the carnations onto the pin frog. Though still unskilled, she basically mastered the fixing angle. She took pictures of the process and sent them to Su Man for advice. Su Man replied, “Place water in the tray before inserting them—the effect is better.”

events.name: Evening reading of flower arrangement books to build background knowledge
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei took out the borrowed 'Ikenobo Kaden' and the lecture notes downloaded from the internet from the bookshelf, carefully studied the basic structure of Rikka (shin, soe, uke, hikae, nagashi, do), and took notes. She drew a diagram in her journal, marked the length ratios of the main branches, and made theoretical preparations for tomorrow's class.

events.name: Plan the flower purchase list for the yoga studio.
events.description: Before bed, she opened the flower arrangement design notes from the yoga studio and, based on the theme 'Summer Charm and Clear Breeze,' made a preliminary list of flowers to purchase: 10 white calla lilies, 5 areca palm leaves, 1 bundle of jasmine, and some light green lisianthus. She decided to go to Dounan to buy wholesale after the flower arrangement workshop.

end_state.mood: Thorough preparation.

state.daily_exercise: Yoga for 60 minutes, and nearly 10,000 steps walking around the flower market

2025-06.daily_overview: Her flower arrangement practice encountered a small setback, but her creative career gained a small blessing: over a thousand followers and a publishing invitation, bearing witness to the power of persistence. She rationally declined and focused on her dream.

events.name: In the morning, she discovered that her Xiaohongshu followers surpassed 1,000.
events.description: At 7:45 in the morning, the first thing Sun Yuwei did after waking up was check her phone. She opened Xiaohongshu and was delighted to find that her account 'Yuwei Slow Journal' had surpassed 1,000 followers, with many new messages in the comments and direct messages. Several users wrote, 'Your layout is so pleasing' and 'I want to start journaling right away after seeing this.' She felt greatly encouraged and immediately took a screenshot, thinking that her persistence in sharing had finally paid off. Then she quickly washed up, organized her flower arrangement tools, and got ready to leave.

events.name: Ikenobo Ikebana Workshop, Day 1: Rikka Basics
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei attended a three-day intensive Ikenobo flower arrangement workshop at a floral classroom near Dounan Flower Market. On the first day, instructor Su Man taught the basic rules of Rikka, explaining the material selection principles and angle-fixing techniques for the three main branches: shin, soe, and uke. Sun Yuwei practiced repeatedly with about 15 stems (pine branches, lilies, iris leaves, etc.). Twice, her fingers were pricked by the needle holder, producing tiny drops of blood, but she put on a Band-Aid and continued. When Su Man walked around, she gave special guidance: “The shin branch should stand as straight as a tree trunk, and the soe branch should be offset by 15 degrees.” At the end of the workshop, Sun Yuwei’s Rikka work received the comment “stable structure.”

events.name: After the workshop ended, bought medicine on the way home.
events.description: After class at 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei bought a box of waterproof band-aids and iodine cotton swabs at the pharmacy at the entrance of the flower market, then took the subway home. On the way, she reviewed what she had learned today and drew a diagram of rikka in her journal.

events.name: In the evening, politely declined the publisher's offer to publish.
events.description: When she got home at 5:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei opened Xiaohongshu while eating the meal her mother had left for her and found an unread message from that afternoon: a publishing house editor asking if she would be willing to have her journal content planned and published as a book. She was a bit surprised. After thinking it over carefully, she replied: "I'm very honored to receive your recognition, but I am currently focusing on writing my essay collection "Slow Travels" and hope to finish that work first. Perhaps we can collaborate on publishing my journal in the future. Thank you." After sending it, she felt a sense of certainty.

events.name: Evening stroll around the neighborhood to relax.
events.description: After dinner, because she had been standing too long during the day, Sun Yuwei took a 30-minute walk in the community garden to stretch her legs, while wearing earphones and listening to a new podcast to relax.

events.name: Browsed illustration content in the evening and developed an interest in learning it
events.description: In the evening, after taking a shower, Sun Yuwei lay in bed browsing Xiaohongshu. Seeing several photo-and-text bloggers skillfully combine hand-drawn illustrations with journal content for a very vivid visual effect, she browsed many posts and felt the urge to learn digital illustration. She then opened her laptop and searched a search engine for keywords such as "learning digital illustration from scratch" and "drawing tablet recommendations," noted down some course and tool information, and decided to sign up for a course soon.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and a little tired

state.daily_exercise: Walking commute, standing flower arranging all day, 30-minute evening walk

2025-06.daily_overview: Her flower arrangement skills continued to improve, and evening yoga relaxed her body and mind; her father's award brought joy to the family. Life is like a living flower, naturally unfolding.

events.name: Call to make a beauty salon appointment.
events.description: At 8 a.m., before setting out, Sun Yuwei remembered she needed to do skin care on the 28th. She found a beauty salon recommended by her best friend Chen Sisi, "Yueji Beauty and Wellness Club," called, and booked the basic facial treatment for Saturday at 10:00 a.m., confirming the service includes deep cleansing, hydration, and soothing massage at a price of 188 yuan. The customer service staff reminded her not to wear makeup when coming, and she noted it in her journal.

events.name: Second day of the Ikebana workshop: Basic Seika form
events.description: From 9 a.m. to 4 p.m., the second day's workshop focused on the basic forms of seika, emphasizing the natural postures of plants and asymmetrical aesthetics. The instructor demonstrated seika arrangements in different containers (vases, bowls, and plates), emphasizing the angles of stems and their growth directions. Sun Yuwei practiced with all three types of containers, using bamboo, anthurium, and bird-of-paradise leaves—15 stems of material in all—and she was no longer afraid of the needle frog.
