During the lunch break, Su Man gave her individual guidance on adjusting the tilt of the anthurium stems to make the work more dynamic. Sun Yuwei's seika work received the comment that it gave 'a feeling of a gentle breeze brushing the face.'

events.name: Regular evening yoga class: rehabilitation and therapeutic yoga
events.description: After the flower arrangement workshop, Sun Yuwei hurried to the Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio for the 6 p.m. rehabilitative yoga class. This was her second regular practice of the week. The class targeted the shoulder and arm tension caused by long-term flower arranging, using gentle twists and supporting poses to relieve fatigue. After class, she felt that the pain in her fingertip wound had eased noticeably.

events.name: Father's photography won an award, family celebration
events.description: In the evening, she returned home. During dinner, her father Sun Mingyuan happily announced that his photography work 'Morning Mist over Green Lake' had won the 'Best Artistic Conception Award' in the final photography evaluation at the senior college, and the work would be recommended for the district's public art exhibition. Her mother Li Xiulan praised him repeatedly. Sun Yuwei congratulated her father as well and suggested celebrating on the weekend at the new dessert shop on Green Lake North Road. Her father smiled and agreed, saying he was already planning a self-driving route so he could take more good photos. The dinner atmosphere was especially cheerful.

events.name: Organized workshop notes and practiced floral pattern drafts.
events.description: After the meal, Sun Yuwei went to the floral arrangement practice area. Using the available materials on the table (several areca palm fronds), she practiced the oblique insertion technique learned that day and sketched structural diagrams of three flower types in her journal, marking the key angles. She decided to buy more inexpensive flowers to practice with after completing the course.

events.name: Night stretching and skincare
events.description: Before bed, she did 10 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching, cleaned the wound on her finger with an iodophor cotton swab, applied a fresh band-aid, and then put on a hydrating mask (as a warm-up for the day-after-tomorrow skin care routine). Lying in bed, she recalled the lively beauty of today's inspired writing and soon fell asleep.

end_state.mood: Content and joyful

state.daily_exercise: Standing flower arranging all day, with 60 minutes of yoga in the evening.

2025-06.daily_overview: The flower arrangement workshop ended perfectly. With the certificate in hand, my confidence soared. In the evening, I signed up for an illustration course, starting a new creative journey with great momentum.

events.name: Attended the third day of the ikebana workshop: free-style arrangement and completion piece
events.description: On the last day of the flower arrangement workshop, the morning was spent learning the basic compositional principles of free-style arrangement, which emphasize individual expression and the use of empty space. Sun Yuwei boldly used palm leaves in curved shapes. In the afternoon, she worked on her graduation piece, choosing summer elements: two green pomegranate branches twisted into an arc, a half-open pink lotus, paired with three lotus leaves and a few foxtail grasses, arranged at varied heights and depths in a shallow water dish. She named the work “Sounds of Summer,” meaning that the stillness and bustle of high summer coexist. When Su Man critiqued it, she praised it: “Bold yet harmonious, with a musical quality.” The needle frog left two new cuts on her fingers, but she paid them no mind. At 4 p.m., Su Man presented the Ikenobo flower arrangement completion certificates to the ten students. Sun Yuwei took hers with both hands, feeling a surge of accomplishment.

events.name: Took photos with Su Man and classmates and exchanged contact information
events.description: After the completion ceremony, Sun Yuwei, Su Man, and several classmates took a group photo in front of their works. Su Man held her hand, said they should keep in touch, and recommended the registration time for the intermediate course (September). Several classmates added each other on WeChat and formed a “2025 Ikenobo Workshop” group, agreeing to share their works.

events.name: Organizing certificates at home and recording reflections.
events.description: In the evening, after returning home, Sun Yuwei carefully pasted the completion certificate into her journal with clear tape and wrote a three-day learning summary next to it: 'Flower arrangement is the art of subtraction. From the discipline of rikka to the exuberance of free-style arrangements, I have learned to have a dialogue with plants.' She sent a photo of her work 'Sound of Summer' to her best friends' group chat and her college roommates' group chat, and received great praise.

events.name: Signed up for an online basic digital illustration course
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei sat at her computer and, based on the information she had searched the day before, chose a "Beginner Digital Illustration (8 Weeks)" course launched by a well-known design platform, priced at 599 yuan. She filled out the registration form and paid. The course starts on July 1, with live sessions every Wednesday at 8 p.m., and includes drawing software tutorials as a bonus. She downloaded the trial drawing software, registered an account, and noted the required equipment: a drawing tablet. So she decided to go to the digital mall tomorrow to buy one in person.

events.name: Evening walk to sort out thoughts.
events.description: After registering, Sun Yuwei went out and took a 40-minute walk on the nearby streets, organizing her gains from these three days and her plans for the illustration course. The evening breeze was gentle, and she felt at ease.

events.name: Plan tomorrow's itinerary before bed
events.description: Before going to bed, Sun Yuwei listed tomorrow’s plan in her journal: go to the Digital Plaza in the morning to buy a graphics tablet, and go to the beauty salon in the afternoon for a skin care treatment (because the salon appointment could be adjusted). She called and changed the salon appointment to 2 p.m. She also looked at graphics tablet reviews and initially selected a few entry-level models, with a budget of about 500 yuan.

end_state.mood: Proud and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Standing flower arrangement all day; 40-minute evening walk

2025-06.daily_overview: Self-care and skill investment went hand in hand: I had my first professional facial, bought a drawing tablet, but hit a snag on my first illustration attempt. It refreshed the quality of life from the inside out and made me realize the challenges of mastering a skill.

events.name: Bought an entry-level drawing tablet in the morning
events.description: At 8 a.m., Sun Yuwei left home and walked to the drawing tablet specialty area on the third floor of Baiteng Digital Plaza. She compared several stores and tried out the target model 'Huaying Pro' and a pressure-sensitive pen from another imported brand. Feeling that the former was sensitive enough, she ultimately bought it for 498 yuan, with a basic version of drawing software included. She felt a little upset at the payment, but full of expectation.

events.name: Go to the beauty salon for a skincare treatment
events.description: After buying the drawing tablet in the morning, she went home and rested briefly. At 1:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei took the bus two stops from home to the Yueji Beauty & Wellness Club. After drinking a cup of rose tea in the waiting area, she was led by the beautician into the treatment room. The treatment lasted about 1.5 hours, from deep cleansing and exfoliation to hydrating massage and a face mask; her skin felt clear, hydrated, and smooth. When it was over, she bought a moisturizing lotion recommended by the salon. During the treatment, the beautician noticed the scratches on her fingers and thoughtfully applied healing ointment to them.

events.name: Record the care experience in the journal and set a quarterly reminder.
events.description: At 4 p.m. she returned home. Sun Yuwei recorded the care steps and her feelings in detail in her journal, rating the comfort 9 out of 10. Then she set a reminder in her phone calendar for quarterly care sessions (September 28, December 28, March 28), took a screenshot and sent it to her mother, joking to herself, 'I need to be a bit more refined too.'

events.name: Installing drivers and testing in the evening
events.description: At 5 p.m., Sun Yuwei eagerly unpacked the graphics tablet. Following the manual, she connected it to her laptop with a USB cable, downloaded the driver from the official website, and installed it. After restarting the computer, she opened the bundled drawing software and tried the pressure-sensitive pen, drawing a few lines of different thicknesses—responsive and smooth. Everything worked normally.

events.name: Evening walk and observation at Green Lake
events.description: Before dinner, Sun Yuwei deliberately went for a 45-minute walk around Green Lake, observing the crowd and taking photos to gather material for next week's column. The wound on her finger had scabbed over, and new skin was growing.

events.name: First attempt at digital tablet creative work (ran into difficulties)
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei tried to sketch the seagull photos she had taken earlier at Cuihu Lake using a graphics tablet. However, the feel of the pressure-sensitive pen on the screen was completely different from what she had expected; the lines always failed to capture the curve of the seagull's wings. After undoing and redrawing more than a dozen times, she finally completed only a somewhat stiff seagull outline and a lotus leaf in the background. Looking at the crude result, she laughed at herself wryly, saved the practice draft as a JPEG, and sent it to her close friends' group chat (Zhang Jing, Chen Sisi) with the caption: “A digital newcomer just getting started, my first abstract seagull…” Zhang Jing replied, “It has soul,” which comforted her a little. Then she wrote in her journal: “The path of illustration is long and difficult, requiring great patience.”

events.name: Organizing flower materials and workshop keepsakes.
events.description: Before going to bed, Sun Yuwei sorted the remaining flowers from the workshop over the past few days: intact lotus leaves and palm leaves were kept for making dried flowers, while withered ones were discarded. She pasted her completion certificate and the 'Sounds of Summer' photos into a dedicated journal page and wrote: 'The way of flowers is subtraction, and also the pruning of the heart.' She then took a photo and sent it separately to Su Man to express her gratitude.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to a fresh start

end_state.mood: Excited and content

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 8,000 steps; took a 45-minute evening stroll.

2025-06.daily_overview: Sunday focused on creative work, from gathering material at a teahouse to writing it up, capturing the pulse of Kunming in slow living. Mentally fulfilled, emotionally stable.

events.name: Early morning visit to an old teahouse on Wenming Street for inspiration
events.description: On Sunday morning, Sun Yuwei brought her notebook and camera and took a bus to "Sanyi Teahouse" on Wenming Street. The old teahouse had been open for forty years. In the early morning, regular tea drinkers gathered around octagonal tables, brewing coarse tea in enamel mugs, playing Chinese chess, and chatting. She ordered a pot of Pu'er tea and sat in a corner, carefully observing the customers' clothing, speech, and movements. She wrote down several memorable lines: "When the tea weakens, life slows down." "No one is in a hurry here." She also took some photos of old architectural details and the texture of the dark brown tabletop. Two hours later, she went home full of inspiration.

events.name: Write the first draft of the column in the afternoon
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei turned on her computer and turned the morning's observations into words. Using "Sanyi Teahouse" as the vehicle, she depicted the slow life and intergenerational blend of Kunming's old town, interweaving historical background. Within four hours, she completed a 2,000-character first draft, tentatively titled "The Old Teahouse: A Pot of Pu-erh Watching Clouds Roll By". After rereading it, she felt the ending was slightly weak and marked it "Revise Tomorrow".

events.name: In the evening, she sorted through photos and posted on Xiaohongshu.
events.description: In the evening, she selected 9 photos from the teahouse, adjusted them to a nostalgic tone with a phone app, and posted on Xiaohongshu: "Kunming's slowness is hidden in the enamel mugs of an old teahouse. Next column, stay tuned." She added the location, and soon a local follower commented, "When I was little, my grandpa often took me there."

events.name: Online chat with close friend Zhang Jing
events.description: In the evening, Zhang Jing sent a WeChat message inviting her to visit the newly opened cultural and creative bookstore next week. The two talked on a video call for half an hour. Zhang Jing shared funny stories about the children in her class, and Sun Yuwei talked about her flower arrangement class and drawing tablet. They agreed to meet next Saturday (July 5) at 2 p.m.

events.name: Reading and meditation
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei continued reading *From the Soil* for 40 minutes, then did a 10-minute bedtime meditation to relax her eyes. She deliberately turned off her phone and computer at 21:30, leaving only the desk lamp on to enjoy the quiet that paper books bring.

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Went out to gather creative material and walked about 10,000 steps.

2025-06.daily_overview: Month-end review, bridging into July. Professional writing, a flower arrangement side business, and illustration study run on three parallel tracks, making life orderly and full of hope.

events.name: Revise the column draft and submit it.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei revised the ending of the manuscript “The Old Teahouse” based on yesterday’s marks, adding a passage describing young tea drinkers to make the article more layered. At 11 a.m., she emailed the manuscript to Xu Mingyuan with the note: “Here is the third column of this month; I tried some non-fiction observational writing.”

events.name: Finalizing the yoga studio's floral design and purchase list
events.description: In the afternoon, she opened the yoga studio's floral design document and finalized the details of the "Summer Breeze" plan: the main flowers were white calla lilies and light green lisianthus, complemented by areca palm leaves and jasmine, with a total budget of 250 yuan. She made a shopping list and decided to go to Dounan Flower Market the next morning (July 1) to buy supplies, and arrange the flowers at the yoga studio in the afternoon.

events.name: Discuss the flower arrangement execution time with He Lu.
events.description: She contacted He Lu on WeChat, telling her that the first floral design session would take place on the afternoon of July 1 and would take about 2 hours. He Lu expressed anticipation and said the yoga studio would provide some of the flower vessels.

events.name: Organize June income and expenses and July budget
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei opened her expense-tracking app and tallied up June expenses: drawing tablet 498 yuan, flower arrangement tools 300 yuan, beauty and skincare 188 yuan, daily expenses about 800 yuan, totaling about 1,800 yuan. Her writing fee was expected to arrive next month. She made a July budget and set aside 2,000 yuan as a travel fund (savings for the month), with a savings target of 1,500 yuan. Her first flower arrangement payment of 800 yuan would be recorded. In the bookkeeping notebook, she wrote: “The investment in illustration courses and tools has already exceeded 1,000 yuan; I need to keep learning to make it worth the cost,” and she was slightly worried about her own laziness.

events.name: Watching the pre-class preview video for the digital illustration course
events.description: Before bed, she logged in to the illustration course platform, watched the orientation video, learned about the course structure and required software basics, and familiarized herself with the pressure-sensitive pen settings panel, preparing for the first lesson.

events.name: Complete daily stretching and develop new habits
events.description: At 9 p.m., Sun Yuwei conscientiously completed 3 sets of today's neck and shoulder stretches in the study, holding each movement for 30 seconds, and used a foam roller to relax her back. She felt her shoulders and neck were unprecedentedly relaxed, and the wound on her finger had completely healed.

events.name: Reading physical books and journaling before bed.
events.description: At 21:30, she turned off all electronic devices on time, leaving only a warm desk lamp on. She sat on the bed and read the paper book 'River Town' for 45 minutes. Then she drew a June calendar in her journal and marked important events (graduation, contract signing, flower arrangement, graphics tablet), writing: "June is a month of farewells and rebirth, and I am breaking out of my cocoon. I have achieved something in flower arrangement, a stable column, and consistent yoga. Only my first attempt at digital painting is not quite satisfactory; I'll explore it again in July." After that, she completed 10 minutes of meditation and turned off the light at 23:30 to go to sleep.

end_state.mood: Grateful and steadfast

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretching, 3 sets; evening walk, 30 minutes.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with strong UV in the afternoon

2025-07.daily_overview: Sun Yuwei started her first day as a freelancer with morning yoga, but on her way to the studio she was accidentally bitten by a stray dog. After emergency wound treatment and vaccination, she adjusted at home, completed photography course registration and camera purchase online, and replanned her daily routine in her journal, re-anchoring the rhythm of a start disrupted by the unexpected.

events.name: Morning yoga practice
events.description: Sun Yuwei got up at 7:00 in the morning in her bedroom at home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming. She laid out her yoga mat and followed an online course to complete about 40 minutes of stretching and meditation, focusing on spinal twists and breath control to ease the anxiety of graduation season and start her first day as a freelancer.

events.name: Bitten by a stray dog and seeking medical treatment
events.description: Around 8:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei was riding a shared bike to her planned workplace, Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street, when a stray dog suddenly darted out near Renmin Middle Road and bit her calf. She immediately stopped the bike and pressed on the wound with her handkerchief to stop the bleeding, then went to the emergency department of Kunming Third People's Hospital. The doctor cleaned and disinfected the wound, stopped the bleeding and bandaged it, and prescribed the rabies vaccine. Sun Yuwei received her first vaccination dose in the inoculation room and was told the schedule for the following doses (days 3, 7, 14, and 28). The whole process took about two hours, after which she took a taxi home to recover.

events.name: Registered for a photography course online and bought a camera online.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei, who needed to rest due to a leg wound, completed online enrollment for a basic photography course at a local photography training institution from home using her laptop, paid the tuition, and confirmed the schedule with classes starting July 5. Then, she placed an order on an e-commerce platform for an entry-level Sony α6000 mirrorless camera as new equipment for her freelance career, with delivery expected the next day.

events.name: Plan a freelance daily routine in a journal
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei opened her journal at her bedroom desk. Given that her wound needed rest, she adjusted her original plan, shifting the focus of the early freelance period from going to work at the bookstore immediately to working from home while recuperating. She planned her daily routine for the coming week in detail: 7:00-7:40 yoga and meditation, 8:00-9:00 breakfast and chores, 9:00-12:00 writing at home, 14:00-17:00 bookstore desk (to be used after the wound improves) or reading at home, with yoga and flower arranging classes interspersed. She pinned the new schedule to the corkboard, setting the tone for a self-disciplined life.

events.name: Mother's care and lunch.
events.description: After learning that her daughter was injured, mother Li Xiulan made a point of buying groceries early and coming home. She prepared a light lunch for Sun Yuwei (tomato and egg noodles, and chicken soup) and comforted her not to rush work and to recover first. Sun Yuwei felt the warmth of family, and her anxiety calmed slightly.

events.name: Browsing Xiaohongshu for inspiration.
events.description: After the lunch break, Sun Yuwei browsed Xiaohongshu on her phone, followed several freelance bloggers, and collected posts about working-from-home efficiency and time management as references for her new life.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home, Wuhua District, Kunming City
start_state.mood: Full of anticipation yet slightly anxious, with vivid imagination about the new life.

end_state.mood: Calm but slightly tired; had to replan after disruption, but family care eased the unease.

state.daily_exercise: 40 minutes of yoga; no exercise afterward due to injury.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with a brief shower in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: Despite leg discomfort, Sun Yuwei went to Mingyuan Book House, finished renting and setting up a workspace, and cleared out a tidy creative corner. In the afternoon, she wrote the framework for her first column article at the book house; in the evening, she sorted through prose manuscripts at home. At the same time, due to a vaccination reaction, she canceled yoga and replaced it with meditation. The arrival of her new camera added a little anticipation to life.

events.name: Communication about renting a workspace at Mingyuan Book House.
events.description: In the morning, despite the soreness in her legs, Sun Yuwei insisted on going out and walked to Mingyuan Bookstore at 45 Wenlin Street. In the bookstore's reading area, she discussed with the owner, Qin Mingyuan, the details of renting a long-term fixed seat, including a monthly rent of 500 yuan, daily usage from 14:00 to 17:00 (except Mondays), a window-side seat, and access to the store's Wi-Fi and power outlets. The two had a pleasant conversation. Appreciating her creative passion, Owner Qin additionally offered her a free coffee.

events.name: Sign the lease agreement and set up the workstation
events.description: Afterwards, Sun Yuwei signed a written lease agreement with Qin Mingyuan and paid the first month's rent. She placed her laptop, journal, stationery, water bottle, and other belongings she had brought on the work desk, arranged it simply, and put up a sticky note reading 'Always stay true to my original aspiration,' marking that she now had a fixed creative space at Mingyuan Bookstore.

events.name: Noticed the workstation was messy
events.description: As soon as she settled in, Sun Yuwei noticed that her workstation was cluttered with piles of old books, tangled cables, and scattered draft paper. The visual mess made her somewhat distracted. She realized that being a freelancer requires a clean and orderly physical space to stay focused.

events.name: Evaluate the sorting plan
events.description: Sun Yuwei quickly assessed the types and quantity of items on the desktop and decided to organize them by area into three categories: books, cables, and scratch paper. She planned to use the existing bookshelf and storage boxes to optimize the space.

events.name: Started tidying up the workstation.
events.description: Starting at 1 p.m., she began tidying her workstation: first she threw away expired scrap paper and clutter, then sorted the scattered books into frequently used and infrequently used ones and placed them on the bookshelf, used cable ties to organize charging cables and network cables, and finally filed loose drafts by project into file boxes. The whole process took about 1.5 hours. During that time, Boss Qin helped move books, and the two briefly exchanged thoughts on organizing.

events.name: First writing session after tidying up the workstation.
events.description: After her workstation was restored to tidiness, Sun Yuwei felt refreshed and sat down to begin her first formal writing as a freelancer. She opened her laptop and focused on writing a column for 'Cultural Vision' magazine about the culture of independent bookstores in Kunming. Surrounded by the scent of books, she worked continuously for about three hours and completed the framework of the first draft (about 1,000 words), with the tentative title 'Paper and Ink Vigil on Wenlin Street'.

events.name: In the evening, select essay manuscripts.
events.description: Back home in the evening, Sun Yuwei went through the prose manuscripts she had written over the past six months one by one in her study, selected 18 pieces of higher quality, and made an initial classification into three thematic categories—'City,' 'Distance,' and 'Whispers'—to prepare for later arrangement. She sketched a simple table of contents in her journal, noting each piece's title and word count.

events.name: Cancel yoga practice and meditate.
events.description: Because her legs were noticeably sore after the vaccination the previous day, and she had a slight fever (37.5°C), Sun Yuwei canceled her scheduled yoga class. She chose to do a 15-minute gentle meditation at home, focusing on her breathing to ease the physical discomfort and the anxiety of having her plans disrupted. In her journal she recorded her body's response and wrote: 'Nursing an injury is also a form of practice.'

events.name: New camera arrived
events.description: In the afternoon, the courier delivered the Sony mirrorless camera and accessories ordered the day before, and her mother signed for them. Sun Yuwei unboxed and played with the new camera after returning home, full of anticipation for the upcoming photography course.

events.name: Discuss wound care with her mother.
events.description: During dinner, her mother, Li Xiulan, reminded her not to get the wound wet and suggested she wrap it in plastic wrap the next day before showering. Sun Yuwei nodded and made a mental note, feeling her mother's thoughtfulness.

start_state.mood: Slightly achy but mentally energized; looking forward to having my own workstation.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and slightly tired, because setting up the workstation and writing for three hours consumed a lot of energy, but the essay classification brought a sense of direction.

state.daily_exercise: Walk about 2 kilometers to the book house, meditate for 15 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: In the morning, Sun Yuwei bought storage supplies. In the afternoon, she turned the study in her home into a second writing base and completed the first systematic sorting of her essay collection. In the evening, the visit from her best friend He Lu, along with a bowl of caring soup, let her feel the warmth of friendship amid the pain of her injury. In a corner of the study, the fresh aroma of eucalyptus lingered.

events.name: Buy storage supplies.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei walked from home to the MUJI store in the nearby shopping mall. She carefully selected storage items such as an acrylic file rack, a wooden pen holder, and a small desktop bookshelf, planning to upgrade her home study into a comfortable creative space. At the checkout, she paid with her own royalty bank card and felt a little spark of independence and small happiness.

events.name: Set up a workstation in the home study.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei returned to the study at home, assembled the newly purchased storage items one by one, and arranged frequently used books, journaling tools, and her mirrorless camera in separate areas. On an empty spot on the wall, she stuck up a decorative paper with a quote from Kant: 'Beauty is a symbol of morality,' and placed a small sprig of eucalyptus leaves on one corner of the desk. After finishing the arrangement, she took a photo with her phone and sent it to her mother Li Xiulan via WeChat with the message: 'My second secret base.' Her mother replied with a smiley face and a cheering emoji.

events.name: Systematically sort the essay collection.
events.description: Sun Yuwei sat at her tidy desk and carefully ordered the 18 essays she had preliminarily selected the night before, according to the three themed sections: “City,” “Distance,” and “Whispers.” She adjusted the order of the pieces to show emotional progression and reading rhythm—from city sketches to travel observations to inner monologues. She also wrote brief section notes for each section, initially structuring the framework of the essay collection “Slow Travel Notes.” The whole process was focused and enjoyable, lasting about 2 hours.

events.name: Contact the yoga studio to request leave.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei remembered that today was Thursday and she had a yoga class, but because of the wound on her leg and the vaccine reaction, she decided not to go. She contacted He Lu at the yoga studio through WeChat, told her what had happened, and asked for leave. He Lu asked about her wound and encouraged her to do gentle stretching at home. The two agreed to take a class together again next week.

events.name: Close friend He Lu pays a visit
events.description: In the evening, He Lu, Sun Yuwei's yoga partner and close friend, learned that Sun Yuwei had been bitten by a dog. She specially brought a pot of homemade yam and pork rib soup from home to visit her. He Lu chatted with her for over an hour, comforted her to relax and focus on recovering, and shared tips on nutrition during recovery. Sun Yuwei was deeply moved. After seeing He Lu off, she wrote in her diary: "When we are vulnerable, we see warmth more clearly; friendship is the medicine for pain."

start_state.mood: Calm, the wound has improved, eager to decorate a new space

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilled, finished organizing and sorting, and received care from friends.

state.daily_exercise: Light walking for shopping; no dedicated exercise.

2025-07.daily_overview: Sun Yuwei further optimized the study environment at home and completed the first full layout of the essay collection "Slow Travel Notes" at the clean desk. In the afternoon she felt slightly tired after receiving the second vaccine shot, but the sense of accomplishment from having a draft take shape filled her heart, and a call with her elder sister added family warmth.

events.name: Morning yoga and desk beautification
events.description: After getting up at 7:15 a.m., Sun Yuwei did 40 minutes of gentle yoga, focusing on upper-body stretching. Then she further beautified the desk in her home study: she stuck up newly purchased sticky notes with essay excerpts (bearing Wang Zengqi’s words, “The flavor of everyday life is what best comforts the human heart”), put up the dried flower bouquet she had made two weeks ago, and cleared away the accumulated drafts and clutter. She moved a pot of mint from the corner of the desk to the balcony outside the window, making the desk cleaner and fresher, and used this as a starting point for maintaining her flow state.

events.name: Completed the first full compilation of the prose collection.
events.description: At 10 a.m., she sat at her tidy desk, turned on the computer, and integrated the three essay sections she had sorted the night before into one Word document, officially completing the first full compilation of the essay collection Slow Travel Notes. She checked the formatting of all titles, added a short epigraph to each section (for example, the epigraph for the 'City' section: 'At familiar street corners, salvage the whispers of time'), unified the page numbers, and saved it as version V1.0. After finishing, she let out a light sigh of relief, took a screenshot, and sent a pre-review message to her editor Xu Mingyuan. At this point, she officially named the collection Slow Travel Notes, replacing the provisional title Breathing at the Edge of the City from January—she believed this name was closer to her original intention of walking slowly through the city and listening to the footsteps of time.

events.name: Received the second dose of the vaccine.
events.description: According to the doctor's advice, at 15:00 in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went alone to the vaccination room of the Third People's Hospital of Kunming and completed the second rabies vaccination (second dose). After the injection, she stayed under observation for 30 minutes and had no abnormal reactions. After returning home, she felt slight soreness in her arm (at the injection site), but the wound on her leg had begun to heal and the pain had noticeably decreased. Following the doctor's advice, she drank plenty of water and recorded her physical condition for the day: normal body temperature, slight fatigue.

events.name: Share the first draft and call my older sister
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei shared the draft document of "Slow Travel Notes" with her mentor Wu Mingyuan and book friend Yang Xiao via WeChat, inviting them to offer feedback when they had time. She then had a 15-minute video call with her elder sister Sun Yutong. Her sister congratulated her on taking the first step, and they agreed to visit the flower market together when she returned to Kunming in August.

events.name: An attempt to rest early due to fatigue.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei felt more tired than usual and planned to go to bed early, so she turned off her computer half an hour earlier than usual. But once in bed, she tossed and turned thinking about the details of the prose collection and did not fall asleep until 23:00.

start_state.mood: Fresh and clean; looking forward to an efficient creative environment after tidying up

end_state.mood: Slightly expectant; the essay collection has begun to take shape and is awaiting feedback, and the mild vaccine reaction did not affect her mood.

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga, 40 minutes (avoiding legs)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, cool in the morning, hot in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: Saturday was the start day of Sun Yuwei's photography course. She happily used her new camera to capture the morning light and everyday bustle of the old street. In the afternoon, she continued writing at the bookstore and confirmed the next day's revision meeting with her editor. Though her attempt at digital painting was unpracticed, it planted the seed of a new skill.

events.name: Morning yoga and first digital painting attempt
events.description: On Saturday morning, after practicing yoga at home for 40 minutes, Sun Yuwei opened the digital painting basics course saved in her Bilibili collection on the computer in her bedroom after breakfast. Following the tutorial, she familiarized herself with the Procreate interface and tried to draw simple lines with her newly purchased drawing tablet. Since it was her first time doing digital painting, her operations were clumsy. After half an hour, she decided to pause and save her energy for the morning photography class.

events.name: Photography class outdoor practice (Old Street)
events.description: At 8 a.m., Sun Yuwei arrived on time at the meeting point on Wenming Street in the Kunming old street area, carrying a Sony mirrorless camera, to attend the first outdoor practice of the basic photography course. Under the teacher's guidance, she learned the basics of composition and exposure, focusing on capturing the light and shadows of the old street's arcade buildings and the lively scenes of the morning market stalls. During the three-hour practice, she gradually mastered focusing techniques, and dozens of practice photos were saved on the camera's memory card. After class, she treated herself to a flower cake at Jiahua Bakery near the old street.

events.name: Write a column for the bookstore and contact the editor
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei, at her desk in Mingyuan Bookstore, organized photos and began to conceive the first part of her column article. She imported the old-street photos she had taken in the morning into her computer and, using them as inspiration, continued writing her unfinished column article from Tuesday, 'The Paper-and-Ink Vigil of Wenlin Street,' adding a passage describing the early-morning atmosphere of Wenming Street. At the same time, she contacted editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat to discuss the progress of compiling the prose collection. Editor Xu suggested holding an online revision meeting right away. They agreed to meet the next day (July 6) at 3 p.m. for an in-depth revision session via Tencent Meeting, and Sun Yuwei sent the preliminary layout document to Xu Mingyuan in advance.

events.name: Shared photography works with Zhang Jing.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei picked a few satisfying photos of the old streets and sent them to her close friend Zhang Jing via WeChat. Zhang Jing praised her sense of composition and suggested she could try submitting to a photography magazine. The two chatted for half an hour, and Sun Yuwei felt that photography could bring her a new sense of accomplishment.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation, the first photography practice brings excitement.

end_state.mood: Excited and slightly tired; a fulfilling day with visual gains, writing progress, and editor interactions.

state.daily_exercise: 40 minutes of yoga, about 1.5 hours of walking for the photography class

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday, Sun Yuwei received the good news of the manuscript fee advance. She then went through a rigorous revision session with the editor. After reluctantly cutting some of her pieces, she made a clear revision plan and took a short evening break with reading and flower tea, ready for the new week of revisions.

events.name: Received notice of the advance payment for the manuscript
events.description: On Sunday morning, Sun Yuwei received a message on WeChat on her phone at home from the editor Xu Mingyuan, notifying her that the 3,000 yuan advance payment for the manuscript of her essay collection 'Slow Travel Notes' would be transferred via bank on Tuesday next week. This was the first substantial income she would receive since becoming a freelancer. She felt a surge of joy, immediately recorded the amount on the dream savings page of her journal, and planned to deposit it into a dedicated travel fund card.

events.name: Video manuscript-revision meeting with the editor
events.description: At 3 p.m., Sun Yuwei held a manuscript revision meeting with editor Xu Mingyuan via Tencent Meeting from her home study. Xu Mingyuan gave piece-by-piece feedback, affirming the warmth and observational power of her writing, but pointed out that three of the essays were structurally weak or had overlapping themes, and suggested deleting them. He also strongly recommended adding a preface to clarify her original creative intent and strengthen the collection's overall coherence. The meeting lasted about an hour. Sun Yuwei listened carefully and took notes, occasionally asking questions and discussing.

events.name: Decided to adopt the suggested revisions
events.description: After the meeting, Sun Yuwei sat alone at her desk, lost in thought. Deleting the work she had poured her heart into was hard to let go of, but she recalled Editor Xu mentioning how other young authors had gone through cutting and revising, and finally realized this was an inevitable step in professional growth. In the evening, she wrote a revision list in her notebook: delete three pieces, including “Night Visit to the Old Bookstall at the University of Finance and Economics,” write a new preface of about 1,500 characters, and adjust some wording to make it more precise. She posted the list beside her computer and resolved to start the next day.

events.name: Evening reading and relaxation
events.description: In the evening, to relieve the pressure of revision, Sun Yuwei took Haruki Murakami's What I Talk About When I Talk About Running off the bookshelf and reread it. She also brewed a cup of rose tea given by a friend and enjoyed the tranquility of Sunday in the evening breeze on the balcony.

events.name: Journaling emotional fluctuations
events.description: Before going to bed, Sun Yuwei recorded the day's emotional ups and downs in her journal. She wrote: "When I heard the manuscript was cut, my heart tightened, but I know this is a road I must take. I have to trust professional judgment."

start_state.mood: Relaxed and carefree, a leisurely Sunday morning.

end_state.mood: Firm, though reluctant, she accepted the professional advice and prepared to throw herself into revision.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of gentle morning yoga stretching

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy to sunny, with a light breeze.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Monday, Sun Yuwei finished the task of trimming her essay collection, then spent an afternoon filled with the fragrance of books with her mother. At Mingyuan Bookstore, she shared her creative progress and received her mother's warm encouragement and specific suggestions. The mother-daughter bond quietly deepened through their written exchange.

events.name: Delete three essays and adjust the structure.
events.description: On Monday morning, according to the revision list, Sun Yuwei deleted three essays from the initial layout document of Slow Travel Notes that were suggested for removal, and readjusted the structure and order of the relevant sections, ensuring that the pacing of the 'City' section was not affected. After updating the table of contents, the whole collection looked more compact, and the page count was reduced from 65 to 58 pages.

events.name: Invite mother to come along to the bookstore
events.description: At noon, her mother, Li Xiulan, made Sun Yuwei's favorite mushroom rice noodles, and the mother and daughter had lunch together. During the meal, Sun Yuwei invited her mother to accompany her to Mingyuan Bookstore in the afternoon to share her recent writing progress. Li Xiulan readily agreed, thinking it was also a good chance for a walk.

events.name: Mother and daughter go to Mingyuan Bookstore together.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the mother and daughter set off from home, strolled slowly along Renmin Middle Road and turned onto Wenlin Street, chatting all the way about the latest news from Aunt Xie next door and the balcony plants. About 15 minutes later they arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore. Sun Yuwei's leg injury was no longer a concern, and her steps were brisk.

events.name: Showing the progress of the prose collection at the bookstore
events.description: In a corner of the bookstore's reading area, Sun Yuwei took the edited manuscript of her essay collection and her journal out of her canvas bag, showed her mother the three-part structure of "Slow Travel Notes" in detail, and told her about the professional suggestions from yesterday's revision meeting. Li Xiulan put on her reading glasses and looked through it carefully, especially appreciating the piece "An Afternoon at Cuihu Lake", and also suggested adding more childhood memories to the author's preface. The bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan brought over a pot of jasmine tea and exchanged a few pleasantries with Li Xiulan, saying that her daughter had a gift for writing.

events.name: Mother and daughter selecting and buying books
events.description: At 4 p.m., the mother and daughter were choosing books in the new-book section of the bookstore. Sun Yuwei chose a new translation of Essays in Idleness by Japanese essayist Yoshida Kenko and a local photography collection, Old Photos of Kunming, while Li Xiulan picked out two books on teacher psychology. At checkout, Qin Mingyuan gave a discount for regular customers, and Sun Yuwei paid with her writing fee. Then the two strolled home carrying their new books, the setting sun stretching their shadows long.

events.name: Exchanging insights on manuscript revisions with Yang Xiao
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat message from her book friend Yang Xiao. Yang Xiao made a few suggestions about the essay collection, such as adding an essay about longing to the 'Whispers' section. Sun Yuwei thought it made sense and decided to consider it during later revisions.

start_state.mood: A little reluctant about the cut draft, but determined to keep moving forward

end_state.mood: Warm and motivated. Her mother's support and the book purchase provided spiritual nourishment.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 4 kilometers; no other exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with thundershowers in the afternoon

2025-07.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Sun Yuwei received two pieces of good news: her royalty payment arrived and her third dose of the vaccine was successfully administered. In the afternoon, after adjusting, she returned to the yoga studio and did restorative practice with He Lu. The combination of physical recovery and the feeling of financial independence filled her with motivation. She focused on writing the preface to her essay collection, tracing her creative origins in the text, and her sister's long-distance cheers brought the day to a warm close.

events.name: Receive the advance payment for the manuscript and transfer it.
events.description: On Tuesday morning, the mobile banking app showed a notification that the 3,000 yuan advance payment for her manuscript from editor Xu Mingyuan had arrived. Sun Yuwei immediately transferred the money through the mobile banking app to her dedicated "Dream Travel Fund" card, and solemnly wrote in her journal: "July 8: the first money of freedom, deposited into my dream account. One step closer to the trip to Dali." She also checked the fund's total balance, which had reached 4,000 yuan (there was already 1,000 yuan in savings before).

events.name: Get the third dose of rabies vaccine
events.description: At 9 a.m., as scheduled, she went to the vaccination room at Kunming Third People's Hospital and completed her third rabies vaccination injection. During the injection, she asked the doctor about the recovery of the wound on her leg. The doctor said it was healing well and she could resume light exercise. After the vaccination, she stayed for observation for half an hour, felt no obvious discomfort, and walked home.

events.name: Afternoon restorative practice at the yoga studio.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei arrived at Jingxin Yoga Studio for her yoga class. Since the wound on her leg still needed care, she explained the situation to the instructor, who guided her to focus on upper-body stretching, core activation, and meditation, avoiding weight-bearing movements on her leg. She practiced with He Lu, who assisted her with spinal twists, and the two exchanged tips on wound recovery and dietary adjustments. After class she felt stretched and relaxed, and in a good mood.

events.name: Wrote the first part of the draft preface.
events.description: After returning home at 10:30 in the morning to rest, during the period before and after the afternoon yoga class, Sun Yuwei changed into a comfortable set of loungewear and sat down in her study to write the first draft of her preface. She recalled her journey from entering university in 2018 to publishing her first column, and then to her current freelance life, detailing the inspiration for the book title "Slow Travel Notes"—which came from a slow moment watching elderly people playing chess by Green Lake—and her original intention of recording the city's breathing with words. As she wrote, she organized the structure of the essay collection, and by evening she had completed the first part of the preface, about 1,000 characters, with rich emotion and focus.

events.name: Share writing progress with older sister
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei sent a screenshot of her preface draft to her elder sister Sun Yutong, and left a WeChat message: “Sis, this is the opening of the book. See if it feels warm and familiar?” Her sister replied with several thumbs-up emojis, saying it was as if she could see her younger sister in a school uniform sitting by Green Lake, lost in thought. The two sisters chatted in the group for a while and agreed to video call on the weekend.

start_state.mood: Delighted; the arrival of the manuscript fee brought a first experience of financial independence.

end_state.mood: Content and tired, a full day of writing was very rewarding, and the interaction with her elder sister added warmth.

state.daily_exercise: A walk to the hospital and back in the morning; a 60-minute yoga class (restorative poses) in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Sun Yuwei was absorbed in revising the ending of the author's preface, and from her conversation with Boss Qin at the bookshop she gained advice on sincere writing. In the evening, she prepared for the next day's yoga challenge. Although her body was resting, her mind was already yearning for the inverted scenery.

events.name: Revise the preface at the bookstore and receive suggestions
events.description: After finishing a draft of the preface in the morning, Sun Yuwei walked to her workstation at Mingyuan Bookstore in the afternoon, printed out the preface draft, revised some sentences with a red pen, and briefly discussed with Qin Mingyuan how to write a book preface. Boss Qin shared some prefaces he had read and suggested that “sincerity matters more than elegance.” Sun Yuwei was deeply inspired.

events.name: Completed the full first draft of the preface and did initial polishing
events.description: After returning home from the bookstore, Sun Yuwei continued writing the rest of the preface in her study. She added tributes to her literary idols Wang Zengqi and Shen Congwen, as well as reflections on how Yunnan culture had permeated her writing. At 4 p.m., she completed the first draft of the full preface, about 1,500 characters, then read through the whole piece, connected and integrated the two sections, and adjusted the tone of the beginning and ending to make it more natural. She also revised some wording and punctuation, and saved the file as “Slow Travel Notes_With Preface_V2.0”. At the moment of completion, she breathed a sigh of relief, looking out the window, feeling that the book finally had a voice of “I” in it.

events.name: Prepare for the next morning's headstand practice.
events.description: In the evening, she decided to prepare for advancing her yoga practice. Her previous yoga sessions had made her body more flexible, and she remembered the headstand challenge He Lu had mentioned. So in the living room, she set out her yoga mat and arranged the yoga blocks and cushions against the wall for support. In her phone's memo, she noted the practice steps for the next morning: warm-up, transition through Downward-Facing Dog, attempting to lift her legs against the wall, and coordinating breath. She deliberately unfolded the yoga mat against the wall in advance so she could start early in the morning. That night, she watched a video about the key points of headstands and went to sleep with anticipation.

events.name: A short digital painting practice
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei turned on her drawing tablet and practiced digital painting brushstrokes for 20 minutes. She drew a simple eucalyptus leaf. Though rough, it gave her a sense of fun. She noted her learning progress in her journal.

start_state.mood: Focused, in a writing state, slightly eager to finish the author's preface.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to it, eager to take on tomorrow's challenge

state.daily_exercise: Walked to the bookstore; no dedicated exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, cool in the morning, warm during the day

2025-07.daily_overview: Thursday was a milestone for Sun Yuwei: in the early morning, she successfully mastered the headstand and experienced the joy of turning her body and mind upside down; during the day, she turned the experience of being bitten into a prose creation; in the afternoon, she tried a wall-assisted headstand in yoga class and gained her coach's approval; in the evening, during the family dinner, she seriously considered future security, taking an important step in independent planning. Multiple dimensions of growth intertwined into a fulfilling day.

events.name: Morning headstand breakthrough
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Sun Yuwei laid out her yoga mat in the living room and began with a 10-minute full-body warm-up, focusing on neck and core activation. Then she walked to the wall, recalled the key points from the video, interlaced her fingers and placed them on the floor, lightly touched her head to the mat, slowly lifted her knees to her chest, and then tried to straighten her legs upward. After several adjustments, she suddenly felt a sense of lightness; her legs left the wall and she held the inverted position for about a minute. In the inverted view, the room was upside down and blood flowed to her head, and she experienced a strange stillness and feeling of power. A sentence surfaced in her heart: “Growth is not about conquering, but about persisting gently.” This became the imagery of her headstand.

events.name: Record the headstand experience and share it
events.description: After breakfast that morning, Sun Yuwei was still emotional. She sat at her desk and recorded the morning breakthrough experience in detail in her journal, including the practice steps, physical sensations, and psychological changes, and added a simple sketch. Then she organized the text on her laptop, paired it with a photo of a yoga mat taken earlier, and published it on her personal WeChat official account "Yuwei Manlu" with the title "The World Seen in a One-Minute Handstand," sharing it as a milestone on her spiritual path. After the article was published, she received encouraging comments from friends.

events.name: Wrote the essay "After Being Bitten."
events.description: During the day, Sun Yuwei used her time at home to write a short essay of about 1,500 words, 'After the Bite,' based on her experience of being bitten by a stray dog and receiving vaccinations. She recorded in detail the fear at the moment it happened, the calmness of handling the situation, and the kindness from family, friends, and strangers she felt during the vaccination period. The writing is delicate and restrained, continuing her sensitive observation of everyday life. When she finished the first draft in the evening, she decided to keep it for now and planned to add it to the 'Whispers' section of a future essay collection.

events.name: Headstand practice in the afternoon yoga class
events.description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei arrived at the yoga studio for class. Under the instructor's guidance, she tried a wall-supported headstand and successfully held it for 10 seconds. The instructor praised her improvement in core strength but reminded her to avoid compressing her neck. He Lu recorded this precious moment with her phone from the side. After class, the two discussed how the headstand changed their awareness of the body.

events.name: Family dinner discussion about social security.
events.description: At 7 p.m., the whole family had dinner together (mother made a mushroom hot pot). During the meal, mother Li Xiulan mentioned that after Sun Yuwei graduated, no employer would contribute to social insurance for her, so in the future she would need to plan her own medical and pension arrangements. Father Sun Mingyuan said he supported his daughter's freelance career, but also reminded her to think long-term. Sun Yuwei nodded in agreement and said she would pay social insurance as a flexibly employed person and had already done some research on the policy. The three discussed the contribution base and the application process, and her parents promised to provide assistance with documents if needed. After dinner, Sun Yuwei searched for Kunming's social insurance application guide on her phone and planned to visit the social insurance center soon.

start_state.mood: Full of determination, ready to challenge myself.

end_state.mood: An overwhelming sense of accomplishment—headstand breakthrough, completed creative work, and family planning brought overall satisfaction.

state.daily_exercise: Morning headstand practice and warm-up for 40 minutes; afternoon yoga class for 60 minutes (including headstand).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, windy in the evening

2025-07.daily_overview: On Friday, Sun Yuwei turned her attention to social security preparations and being a floral design teaching assistant. In the morning she researched policies online, in the afternoon she organized materials, and in the evening she went deeper into the flower market and the studio, fully preparing for Saturday's workshop. In the night, she went home with a bunch of daisies, and her life sparkled with the interweaving of work and interests.

events.name: Check social insurance policies for flexible employment.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei used her laptop in the study to log in to the official website and WeChat official account of the Kunming Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau. She looked up in detail the application conditions, contribution base, and required document list for flexible employees to participate in the basic pension insurance and medical insurance for urban workers. She recorded the key information in her journal: minimum contribution base of 3,100 yuan, monthly contribution of about 600-plus yuan, and the need to bring an ID card and household registration booklet, among others. She also took screenshots of the key pages for future reference.

events.name: Organize social insurance application materials
events.description: In the afternoon, based on the checklist from the morning, she organized at home the materials needed for applying for social insurance. She found the original and a copy of her ID card, the original and a copy of her household registration booklet, a recent one-inch ID photo with a white background and no hat (the one used for her graduation certificate), and went to a nearby bank to print the last three months' bank statement for the debit card used for social insurance deductions. She put all the materials into a transparent document folder, stuck a label listing the materials on it, and placed it in her backpack, planning to go to the social insurance center next Monday.

events.name: Communicated with flower arrangement master Su Man and purchased flower materials
events.description: After sorting out the materials, Sun Yuwei communicated with flower arrangement master Su Man via WeChat about her assistant task for the next day's flower arrangement workshop: the activity was making bouquets with the theme 'Summer Evening Breeze', with 8 students, and she would help demonstrate material selection and guide styling. After confirming the process, she went to Dounan Flower Market and, according to the list, bought sunflowers, lisianthus, eucalyptus leaves, daisies and other floral materials, as well as several rolls of floral tape. In the evening, she went to Su Man's flower arrangement studio, where the two trimmed branches and leaves together, matched vases, prepared tools, and rehearsed the teaching process. Su Man also gave her a bunch of leftover daisies to take home.

events.name: Evening chat with best friend Zhang Jing
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei put the daisies into a vase in her study and, under the lamplight, sent a WeChat message to her close friend Zhang Jing, sharing her excitement about preparing to be a teaching assistant. Zhang Jing replied with a cheering emoji, and the two chatted about their recent lives for half an hour and agreed to find time for coffee next week.

events.name: Watched floral design videos to relax late at night
events.description: Before bed, a little nervous about being a teaching assistant the next day, she opened Bilibili and watched a 20-minute bouquet wrapping tutorial, writing down key points as she watched until her eyelids were heavy and she fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Methodically handling administrative matters and interest plans.

end_state.mood: Excited, looking forward to being a flower-arranging teaching assistant tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: Walk to the flower market and the studio, light activity

date_attribute.weather: Clear, with a brief shower in the afternoon.

2025-07.daily_overview: Saturday was a day of both vitality and warmth. In the morning, she carried her camera through the old streets chasing light and shadow. In the afternoon, she reunited with her close college friend, and they exchanged handmade photo albums and essay collections—proof that their friendship had successfully turned into mutual support in the city after graduation season. The evening's digital painting practice was difficult but full of small sparks of creativity.

events.name: Second photography class practice (Guanghua Street)
events.description: On Saturday at 8 a.m., Sun Yuwei came to Kunming Old Street again. This time the practice area was Guanghua Street. Under the teacher's guidance, she used the focusing and depth-of-field control techniques learned last week to photograph the steam from kettles in an old tea shop, close-ups of a craftsman making silverware, and the bokeh effect of pedestrians strolling. The teacher acknowledged her progress and suggested she could appropriately increase ISO in dim light. After shooting, she stopped at an old teahouse, quickly picked a few satisfying photos on her phone and posted them to her Moments with the caption "Time on Guanghua Street." Her friends gave many likes.

events.name: Prepare for the afternoon gathering
events.description: At 11 a.m., after photography class ended, she hurried home to prepare for her first reunion with Zhao Xiaowen since graduation that afternoon. She carefully chose a light blue dress and put on light makeup. She then took a sample copy of her essay collection, which she had printed and bound herself, from the bookshelf and wrote on the title page in pen: For Xiaowen: forever melancholy, forever June days - Yuwei. She put it in a canvas bag as a return gift for her roommate. She confirmed with Zhao Xiaowen via WeChat to meet at 3 p.m. at the Old Place Cafe on Nanqiang Street.

events.name: Walking to the café
events.description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei walked out with a gift and headed along the familiar streets toward Nanqiang Street. Her leg injury was almost fully healed, her steps were light, and she was looking forward to seeing Zhao Xiaowen.

events.name: Reunited with Zhao Xiaowen at the café
events.description: At 3 p.m., the two sat down on time in a corner of the Old Place Café. They ordered Zhao Xiaowen's favorite matcha latte and Sun Yuwei's Earl Grey tea. Zhao Xiaowen took a thick, handmade photo album out of her large bag. It was filled with photos, tickets, class schedules, and handwritten blessings from their four years of college, and the last page read: Every June, we must meet. Sun Yuwei took it and turned each page, her eyes slightly moist. She returned the gesture with a sample copy of her essay collection and told the story behind the title Slow Travel Notes. Zhao Xiaowen shared the funny moments and worries from her internship at a publishing house, while Sun Yuwei talked about the ups and downs of freelance life. They encouraged each other and agreed to meet at least once every two months, and to video call even if they were in different cities. Amid laughter and memories, their friendship grew stronger. Zhao Xiaowen also suggested that Sun Yuwei try designing the cover for her essay collection, since she had a friend in the art department who could help. Sun Yuwei excitedly wrote down the suggestion.

events.name: Farewell and homecoming record.
events.description: At 6 p.m., the two hugged and said goodbye with reluctance outside the café. Sun Yuwei walked home holding the heavy hand-drawn photo album, savoring the shadow of graduation days along the way. After arriving home, she carefully placed the album in the most prominent spot on the bookshelf and set aside a page in her journal to paste today's café receipt, recording this reunion: 'Some people need not be seen often, yet they are always warm.'

events.name: Evening session learning layer management for digital painting
events.description: At 8 p.m., Sun Yuwei returned to the study, imported the photos from the daytime photography class into her computer, and began selecting them. Afterward, she opened the digital painting course on Bilibili and continued learning about layer management. Following the video, she practiced creating new layers, merging layers, using masks, and drawing simple geometric shapes on the graphics tablet with color applied on separate layers. After about 2 hours of practice, she had a basic grasp of using layers. When she finished, she massaged her wrist and looked forward to making her own journal stickers.

start_state.mood: Rushed but excited, looking forward to the photography class and the afternoon gathering.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and tired, a full day brought many kinds of happiness.

state.daily_exercise: Photography class: about 2 hours of walking, low-to-moderate intensity.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday, Sun Yuwei took part deeply in the workshop as a teaching assistant for flower arrangement. Through the interaction of teaching and learning, she gained new insights into floral art. The students' gratitude and Su Man's invitation to collaborate showed her more possibilities for monetizing her passion. That night, a light Japanese film brought a gentle close to her fulfilling weekend.

events.name: Serve as teaching assistant for the ikebana workshop
events.description: On Sunday, Sun Yuwei devoted herself to the flower arrangement workshop all day. At 9 a.m. she arrived early at Su Man's studio and helped make a final check of the flowers and tools. After all the students had arrived, she assisted Su Man in explaining the design concept of the Summer Evening Breeze theme, then distributed the flower materials and demonstrated how to select and secure sunflowers and lisianthus. As the students worked, she moved among the eight students, patiently correcting problems with bouquet proportions and layering and sharing her insights on color combinations. She noticed that one student always inserted the eucalyptus leaves too densely, so she quietly demonstrated how to leave negative space. Throughout the process, she felt the joy of sharing knowledge and developed a strong interest in flower arranging instruction. At 5 p.m., when the workshop ended, one student gave Sun Yuwei a bouquet she had made by hand as a token of thanks.

events.name: Wrap-up and reflections log for the workshop
events.description: After it ended, Sun Yuwei helped Su Man clean up the flower and leaf debris, wash the flower vessels, and put the tools back in place. The two chatted in the rest corner of the studio. Su Man thanked her for her help, praised her for her detailed explanation, and suggested they could collaborate on a community flower arrangement experience class in the autumn. Sun Yuwei happily agreed. After returning home, she recorded in detail her experience and reflections as a teaching assistant in her journal, and pasted in a few photos of the workshop works. Later, she shared the photos with her best friend Zhang Jing and roommate Liu Jia on WeChat. Liu Jia replied: "Xiaowei, you seem to be glowing."

events.name: Evening relaxation: watching a movie.
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei felt physically tired but mentally joyful. She made a cup of rose tea her mother had given her, and in the bedroom watched the Japanese film After the Flowers on her tablet, relaxing in the quiet, understated Japanese aesthetics and bringing a serene close to the weekend.

events.name: Received a new follower notification on Xiaohongshu
events.description: During the workshop, her phone vibrated. Sun Yuwei glanced at Xiaohongshu and saw that “Yuwei Slow Record” had gained a dozen or so new followers. Later, when she looked through it, she found that a student had recommended her account in a note today, praising the teaching assistant's professionalism and gentleness. A hint of surprise rose in her heart, and she decided to put more effort into managing her social media in the future.

start_state.mood: Nervous and serious; the first time as a teaching assistant brought a sense of responsibility

end_state.mood: Full of achievement and tranquility; success as a teaching assistant brought confidence, and the movie brought peace.

state.daily_exercise: The workshop involved a lot of standing and walking; light activity.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, slightly hot during the day, cool by the lake at night

2025-07.daily_overview: On Monday, Sun Yuwei urgently adjusted her plans for her heartbroken best friend Zhang Jing, and the two escaped to Fuxian Lake. Accompanied by the lake water and the sunset, she used patient listening and a short-short story written overnight to apply a soft word-poultice to her friend's wounds. That day, writing became the most tender healing.

events.name: Received a call from Zhang Jing and decided to accompany her.
events.description: On Monday morning, Sun Yuwei had planned to start the new week's writing at Mingyuan Bookstore as scheduled. A little after 9, her phone rang — it was her best friend Zhang Jing, calling in a tearful voice. Zhang Jing haltingly said over the phone that her boyfriend had suddenly broken up with her last week, and she had been up all night and was emotionally devastated. Sun Yuwei immediately put down her work, gently comforted her, and then decisively suggested going to Fuxian Lake together to take her mind off things. She called her mother to explain the situation, packed a few simple changes of clothes, her journal, and her laptop as quickly as she could, and took a taxi to the entrance of Zhang Jing's building.

events.name: Heading to Fuxian Lake
events.description: At noon, the two met downstairs at Zhang Jing's home. Zhang Jing's eyes were red and swollen. Sun Yuwei gave her a deep hug, then booked a ride-hailing car on her phone, with the destination set to a guesthouse by the shores of Fuxian Lake. In the car, Zhang Jing leaned on Sun Yuwei's shoulder, intermittently pouring out the details of the breakup, her grievances, and her self-doubt. Sun Yuwei listened quietly, occasionally using a tissue to wipe her tears, and whispered, “The pain will pass. I'm here.”

events.name: Lakeside walk and listening to words of comfort
events.description: At 2 p.m., they arrived at the shore of Fuxian Lake and checked into a lake-view guesthouse that had been booked in advance from the car. After a short rest, the two walked slowly along the wooden boardwalk by the lake. As Zhang Jing walked, she reminisced about her past romance. Sun Yuwei stayed by her side the whole time, sharing prose passages she had read about acceptance and time, and suggesting that Zhang Jing write down her feelings. In the evening, they sat on a stone bench by the lake, silently watching the sunset dye the lake surface gold. Zhang Jing finally showed a faint smile: “The wind here is so healing.” Seeing an elderly couple supporting each other by the lake, Sun Yuwei had a flash of inspiration and decided to use that image to write a short story to console Zhang Jing.

events.name: Writing the Flash Fiction The Star at the Bottom of the Lake Overnight
events.description: At night, Zhang Jing, exhausted from days of emotional ups and downs, soon fell into a deep sleep on the bed in the guesthouse. Sun Yuwei, however, was restless with thoughts. Sitting at the desk by the window, she opened her laptop and, by the warm light of the desk lamp, wrote a flash fiction piece overnight titled "The Star at the Bottom of the Lake." The story tells of a little star that sank to the bottom of a lake and, comforted by moonlight, slowly shone again. It incorporated fragments of their daytime conversation, the metaphor used when Zhang Jing shed tears, and echoes of the old couple by the lakeside. At 1 a.m., having written about 2,000 characters, she let out a soft sigh of relief, sent the manuscript to Zhang Jing's phone, and wrote in the message: "Every star has had its days at the bottom of the lake, but the moonlight has always been there."

start_state.mood: Calm, ready to start the new work week

end_state.mood: Moved and fulfilled, creation turns sadness into strength.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 5 km along the lake; moderate exercise.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Sun Yuwei accompanied Zhang Jing on the return trip from Fuxian Lake; her friend's mood had clearly recovered. In the afternoon, after receiving the fourth vaccine dose, she felt a bit tired and took a nap. In the evening, she went to her desk at the bookstore to continue revising the manuscript. For the first time, she recorded her weight data, laying the groundwork for health management. At night, she shared the Fuxian Lake story on Xiaohongshu, and the ripples of written healing continued to spread.

events.name: Breakfast at the guesthouse and the return trip
events.description: On Tuesday morning, Sun Yuwei and Zhang Jing shared breakfast in the small courtyard of the homestay. After a night's rest and reading "The Star at the Bottom of the Lake," Zhang Jing was clearly in better shape; her eyes were still slightly swollen, but her smile had returned. She thanked Sun Yuwei for her company, read the short-short story over and over, and said she would save the electronic manuscript. After breakfast, the two checked out, took a few photos of the lake view as souvenirs, and then took a reserved ride-hailing car back to Kunming. In the car, Zhang Jing began planning her next week's work and lesson preparation, her mood much more stable. They arrived downtown at 11 o'clock. Zhang Jing got out at the entrance of her residential community and agreed with Sun Yuwei to visit a bookstore together on Friday.

events.name: Received the fourth dose of rabies vaccine.
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei arrived on time at the Third People's Hospital of Kunming for the fourth dose of rabies vaccine. By then the wound on her leg had basically healed, with only a small bruise and slight pain remaining, not affecting walking. The vaccination took three minutes, and the nurse reminded her that the final dose would be two weeks later (July 29). After staying for 30 minutes of observation, she walked home, buying mangoes and yogurt at a roadside fruit shop on the way.

events.name: Took a short nap due to fatigue.
events.description: After returning home, Sun Yuwei felt a wave of fatigue, perhaps due to a normal reaction to the vaccine or to the busy days. She took a short nap of about 40 minutes in her bedroom and felt much more refreshed when she woke up.

events.name: Revising manuscript at a bookstore desk in the evening
events.description: After getting vaccinated in the afternoon, she went home and rested for a while. Sun Yuwei felt she still had some energy. Taking advantage of the cool evening, she walked to her workstation at Mingyuan Book House. She turned on her computer and began to self-review the preface and adjust some wording according to Xu Mingyuan's suggestions from last week. After about two hours of work, the essay collection was getting closer to being finalized. During a break, she chatted with Qin Mingyuan about publishing plans for the collection. Boss Qin suggested she could contact some small cultural publishing studios. Sun Yuwei was deeply encouraged and decided to research it later.

events.name: Record weight and extra meals
events.description: In the restroom of Mingyuan Bookstore, she saw a public scale, stepped on it, and weighed herself; it showed 43.6 kg. She was a little surprised at her weight and realized that her recent rushing around and irregular eating habits might have caused the weight loss. She wrote the number in her journal and decided to track her weight changes from today onward, collecting data for a possible weight-gain plan. After returning home, she had a glass of milk prepared by her mother and two biscuits as a snack.

events.name: Update Xiaohongshu content
events.description: Before bed, Sun Yuwei updated "Yuwei Slow Record" on Xiaohongshu on her phone, sharing a set of photos of Fuxian Lake and an excerpt from the flash fiction "The Star at the Bottom of the Lake," with the caption "What we may need is just an escape and a listener." She soon received likes and comments comforting Zhang Jing. Late at night, she received a private message on Xiaohongshu from an editor at a local Yunnan publishing house, expressing interest in the prose excerpt she had posted and hoping to have a detailed discussion. This made her too excited to sleep, and she lay in bed scrolling through her phone until 00:15 before putting it down.

start_state.mood: Relieved—seeing Zhang Jing improve was a huge weight off my shoulders

end_state.mood: Stable and slightly excited; completed the fourth vaccine dose, started weight management, the book manuscript progressed smoothly, and unexpectedly received attention from a publisher.

state.daily_exercise: Morning: a short walk around the guesthouse. Afternoon: walked about 3 km to the bookstore (the leg injury is basically fine, but I deliberately controlled the distance to avoid overusing my leg).

2025-07.daily_overview: On my twenty-third birthday, my best friends carefully planned a surprise, my parents prepared a warm dinner, and my sister sent a gift from afar. Wrapped in love all day, I felt even more determined to walk the path of creative writing.

events.name: Morning gentle stretching and wound observation.
events.description: Got up at 7:30 and did 15 minutes of gentle stretching by the bedroom window, focusing on breathing and relaxing the legs. Then she used a cotton swab dipped in povidone-iodine to clean the scabbed area on her left calf, and noted, “The area around the wound is dry, with no redness or swelling and only slight tenderness.”

events.name: Surprise visit for her best friend's birthday.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi arrived at the house with a homemade osmanthus cream cake, colorful balloons, and handwritten blessing cards. The three of them stuck the balloons on the bookshelves and window frames, and the room was instantly filled with a festive atmosphere. Sun Yuwei unwrapped the introductory Ikenobo ikebana book Sisi had given her.
