When she opened the title page, she saw the encouraging words her best friends had secretly written, and her eyes welled up.

events.name: Journal albums and reminiscing about the past
events.description: In the afternoon, the three of them snuggled on the padded mats in the bedroom, flipping through college journals and photo albums, chatting from embarrassing photos of freshman-year military training to the tension of final thesis defense, laughter and emotion interwoven. Sisi pointed to the group photo at Fuxian Lake and said, "Weiwei always shines in places like this."

events.name: Family longevity noodles and mushroom dinner
events.description: In the evening, her father Sun Mingyuan cooked longevity noodles topped with poached eggs, and her mother Li Xiulan added a dish of fresh porcini mushrooms stir-fried with ham. The whole family sat together. Her parents raised their glasses to wish her "may your words shine, and may you have peace and joy." Her father rarely mentioned the story of having his submission rejected when he was young, encouraging her to persevere.

events.name: Opening Sister's Gift and Diary Reflections
events.description: After the meal, she opened the hardcover edition of "Selected Modern Chinese Prose" that her elder sister Sun Yutong had sent from Shenzhen. Inside the book was a handwritten note: "To my most artistic sister, may your pen always be free." Sun Yuwei wrote in her journal: "A year wrapped in love, walking more firmly toward where my heart leads. The wound has scabbed over, like a special birthday badge."

events.name: Thank her sister via WeChat.

2025-07.daily_overview: Dragged by my best friend to attend the 500 Miles Music Festival. In the noise, I found a corner of the lawn to doodle in my journal, but was instantly shaken by the wave of the audience singing along with Miserable Faith. After returning, I honestly recorded it in my diary and felt even more grateful for my usually quiet world.

events.name: Unexpected invitation
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei was rereading an old column article when she received a stream of WeChat calls from Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi. Citing "graduation madness," they earnestly invited her to the 500 Miles Music Festival that afternoon. After hesitating, she reluctantly agreed. She slung on a small bag, put in noise-cancelling headphones, a journal, and a pen, and thought to herself, "I'll just treat it as field observation."

events.name: Going to the music festival
events.description: At 1 p.m., Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi arrived downstairs. The three of them called a ride-hailing car to the music festival venue by Dianchi Lake. In the car, the two best friends excitedly discussed the band lineup, while Sun Yuwei, wearing earphones, looked out the window at the roadside trees receding behind, her mood as complicated as the clouds gathering in the sky.

events.name: The Bystander on the Lawn
events.description: After entering, the booming rock music and the jostling crowd made her dizzy. She gestured to her best friend and retreated alone to a gently sloping lawn in the distance, spread out her sun-protection jacket and sat down, put on noise-canceling headphones, and used her journal to sketch the leaping colors and exaggerated hairstyles before her, occasionally looking up at the stage lights.

events.name: Moved by the power of the choir.
events.description: In the evening, when Miserable Faith went on stage, the roar of the whole crowd singing along pierced through her earphones. Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi ran over, pulled her to the edge of the crowd, and the voices of thousands of people surged like a tide. Sun Yuwei felt her chest vibrate with it and, for a moment, understood this collective fervor, but deep down she still knew it did not belong to her.

events.name: Honest diary entries and late-night journaling.
events.description: Returned home in the early morning, washed off the sweat and dust, and at the desk opened her diary and wrote: 'This is the edge of my world, but it truly exists. That chorus of shouting was real, and I am even more grateful for the present — returning to the quiet desk, hearing the pen tip scratch across the paper.' She also pasted in the music festival ticket stub and a sketch of the lawn, and only after finishing did she go to sleep.

She also sought professional nutritional consultation for the first time, looking for a scientific way to improve her thin and weak constitution. In one day, family affection and self-care were intertwined.

events.name: Initial nutrition consultation
events.description: At 9 a.m., Sun Yuwei arrived at a professional nutrition consultation center in Wuhua District by appointment and told the nutritionist that she was underweight and occasionally fatigued. After measuring baseline data, the nutritionist gave initial suggestions for dietary adjustments and recommended using a body fat scale for monitoring. Sun Yuwei took careful notes and decided to go to the hospital's nutrition department for a comprehensive assessment.

events.name: Selecting the Four Treasures of the Study
events.description: After consulting, I went to a time-honored calligraphy supply store to choose a retirement gift for my father. With the clerk's recommendation, I repeatedly compared the fineness of the Duan inkstone and the sharp tips of the Huzhou brushes, and finally chose a square inkstone, pairing it with ink sticks, rice paper, and a calligraphy copybook, and wrapping it carefully in a brocade box.

events.name: Buy ingredients for mushroom hotpot
events.description: Then, on the way, she went to the farmers' market, found the mushroom stall she knew well, picked fresh termite mushrooms, porcini mushrooms, and bamboo fungus, and also bought a free-range chicken, ham, and vegetables. The vendor kindly reminded her that porcini mushrooms must be thoroughly stir-fried; she smiled and took note.

events.description: At 3 p.m., she tied on an apron and got busy in the kitchen: carefully scrubbing the mushrooms, blanching the free-range chicken before putting it in a clay pot to simmer, slicing ham to enhance the flavor, and adding the mushrooms in batches. She occasionally called her mother to confirm the heat level. After two hours, the soup was golden and fragrant.

events.name: Gift-giving and dinner
events.description: At dinnertime, Sun Yuwei held out the brocade box to her father with both hands and said, “Thank you, Mom and Dad, for always supporting my writing.” Her father opened it in surprise, rubbed the inkstone, and kept saying, “You have good taste.” The hot pot was bubbling; the family ate and chatted about the column plans and the August trip, and her father was full of praise for the soup base.

events.name: Polished the column draft late into the night
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei returned to her study, opened the topic document for "Cultural Vision," and based on her interview notes from the old street, began writing a draft column about the changes of Ma's Grand Courtyard in Kunming. Because she had been active during the day, she didn't finish the framework until the early morning, and her sleep time was delayed.

2025-01.daily_overview: During the New Year holiday, Sun Yuwei spent a warm holiday at home with her parents. In the morning, she organized her annual writing topics; at noon, she enjoyed a family mushroom hotpot; in the afternoon, she drew a vision board in her journal and caught up on her yoga practice. Her plans for the new year officially began.

events.name: Organized the year’s writing topics.
events.description: In the morning, at her study at home in Kunming, Sun Yuwei reviewed her writing experience over the past year and sorted out potential topic directions for 2025 Kunming cultural essays, including memories of old streets, the four seasons of Cuihu Lake, and the past and present of Dianchi Lake. She drafted a brief writing outline and a reference list, making full preparations for the next day's discussion with editor Xu Mingyuan.

events.name: New Year's Day family dinner to set the annual keyword
events.description: At noon, she had a New Year's Day lunch at home with her parents, Sun Mingyuan and Li Xiulan, enjoying the mushroom hotpot carefully prepared by her mother. Her father talked about his year-end summary at work, and Sun Yuwei shared her annual plan. In a warm atmosphere, they set the annual keyword 'deep cultivation,' symbolizing her focus on creation and growth.

events.name: Drawing a vision board in the journal
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei took out her beloved journal in the study and used colored markers and stickers to create a New Year vision board: with Cuihu Lake and books as the core elements, she wrote annual goals around them, such as the first draft of her essay collection, cultural travel, and sticking with yoga, and marked important time milestones, turning abstract wishes into a visualized action guide.

events.name: New Year's Day yoga practice
events.description: In the evening, because the yoga studio was closed for New Year's Day, Sun Yuwei unrolled her yoga mat in her bedroom at home and followed a yoga app on her phone for a basic Hatha yoga sequence, including Mountain Pose, Triangle Pose, Cat-Cow Pose, and others, for 30 minutes, to keep her flexibility practice uninterrupted.

She then carefully organized the key points, made a writing plan, and relaxed in the evening with flower arranging practice, laying a solid foundation for the year of writing.

events.name: Annual commissioning discussion with editor Xu Mingyuan
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei was in her study at home in Kunming, using WeChat to talk with Xu Mingyuan, editor of Cultural Vision, for a 45-minute annual commissioned-piece discussion. She presented her carefully prepared proposals for essays on Kunming culture. Editor Xu fully affirmed her direction and suggested combining her essay collection with her column submissions—submitting one in-depth essay every month—and they settled on “The Cycle of Four Seasons at Green Lake” as the theme for the first piece, with a deadline of January 25. During the conversation, Sun Yuwei gradually shifted from nervousness to confidence and gained a clear path forward.

events.name: Organize communication points and create a writing plan.
events.description: After the communication ended, Sun Yuwei immediately organized the talking points on her laptop, entered the confirmed topic direction, the monthly submission date (setting a reminder for the 15th of each month), and the manuscript style requirements into her writing schedule, and detailed the writing steps for the first piece, 'The Changing Seasons of Green Lake,' planning to complete the first draft before January 10 to ensure she could calmly meet the deadline.

events.name: Ikenobo flower arrangement practice
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei remembered that the flower materials she had bought at Dounan Flower Market before New Year's Day had not been used yet, so she set up a simple ikebana corner in the living room and practiced Japanese Ikenobo flower arrangement. She selected wintersweet, bird-of-paradise, and a few green branches, focused on trimming and fixing them, and completed a small tatehana arrangement. She placed it in the center of the dining table to add color, then took a photo and sent it to her flower-arranging friend Su Man to exchange ideas.

events.name: Video call with my older sister.
events.description: After finishing sorting out the manuscripts in the evening, Sun Yuwei received a WeChat video call invitation from her older sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen. The two sisters chatted for half an hour. Sun Yuwei excitedly shared her writing plans for the new year, and her sister encouraged her to keep creating, also revealing that she would bring gifts when she came home for the Spring Festival.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, Sun Yuwei went to Mingyuan Bookstore in the morning to hold a kickoff meeting for her essay collection, finalizing the working title and creative framework with the owner Qin Mingyuan and online book friend Yang Xiao. Afterward, she designed a progress bar for her journal, did a make-up yoga session at home in the evening, and ordered her desired mirrorless camera at night, advancing both her creation and equipment tracks.

events.name: Essay collection kickoff meeting
events.description: At ten in the morning, Sun Yuwei took her journal and topic outline to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenlin Street in Wuhua District, met face-to-face with the owner Qin Mingyuan, and also connected via WeChat video call with fellow book lover Yang Xiao in Chengdu. The three had a lively discussion around the theme of the essay collection: Qin Mingyuan suggested that the title should reflect Kunming's edge and its sense of breathing, while Yang Xiao, from an editor's perspective, proposed arranging the chapters along spatial clues. They finally settled on the tentative title 'Breathing at the City's Edge' and planned to complete one core essay per month, with the first one focusing on Cuihu. Qin Mingyuan also gave Sun Yuwei an old edition of 'Kunming Scenery and Customs' as a reference. The meeting lasted about two hours, and Sun Yuwei took detailed notes of the key points in the bookstore's reading area. Qin Mingyuan pondered for a moment and added: 'Breathing at the City's Edge is a good direction, as if capturing the pulse of a city. However, as a work that needs long polishing, its final form may gradually become clear through walking. When you walk farther and see more, perhaps a more fitting title will emerge.' Sun Yuwei wrote this down on the flyleaf of her journal, marked as 'Title to be determined, to be confirmed through walking.'

events.name: Design a progress bar for the essay collection journal
events.description: After the talk ended, Sun Yuwei stayed in the reading area of Mingyuan Bookstore, took out her beloved journal, and designed a progress bar called "Tentative: Breathing at the Edge of the City" with colored markers and stickers. She divided the progress bar into 12 cells, corresponding to 12 months, with one core essay to be completed each month. The first cell was marked "January · Green Lake", and she wrote down keywords such as observing seagulls, while also noting the plan reminder for the Green Lake field trip on January 18 in her journal.

events.name: Evening yoga practice
events.description: Because the morning meeting made her miss the afternoon yoga class, Sun Yuwei returned home in the evening, spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom, and did a 45-minute self-practice session, including Sun Salutations, the Warrior series, and Pigeon Pose. She focused on stretching the shoulders, neck, and hips that had become tense from prolonged sitting, making up for the missed class.

events.description: In the evening, based on her research over the previous two days, Sun Yuwei ordered a Fujifilm X-T30 II mirrorless camera with the kit lens on JD.com and paid with a bank card. She hoped this camera would become a powerful tool for recording the details of Kunming and materials for her journal. After placing the order, she immediately received a payment confirmation text message, and the delivery was expected to arrive in 2-3 days.

events.name: Organize the research direction for the final paper and the academic plan for next semester.

events.name: Visit my advisor at the School of Literature
events.description: At 13:50, Sun Yuwei carried her outline and printed draft and walked from the dormitory to the teaching building of the School of Humanities, Yunnan University. Along the way, she silently reviewed the core questions to be discussed and adjusted her breathing to ease the slight nervousness of meeting her advisor. The campus was sunny and warm, the ginkgo leaves had all fallen, and the winter campus had a quiet serenity.

events.name: Discussing research direction and academic planning for next semester with her advisor
events.description: In the afternoon from 14:00 to 15:30, Sun Yuwei had an academic discussion in the office of Professor Wu Mingyuan at the School of Literature, Yunnan University. After listening carefully to her research plan, Professor Wu affirmed her idea of combining prose collection writing with academic research, offered several directional suggestions, and recommended a reading list for the next semester. Sun Yuwei took detailed notes of her advisor's opinions and asked in depth about the concrete implementation of the research plan. Professor Wu's gentle and profound guidance made her feel enlightened.

events.name: Organize academic notes and update next semester's research plan
events.description: After the discussion ended and she returned to the dormitory, Sun Yuwei immediately opened her laptop, organized her advisor's suggestions and the reading list into clear digital notes, and updated the reading plan and preliminary framework for next semester's research direction. She set the next stage goals as: read the recommended books as planned, refine the research framework, and set deadlines. Then, she wrote down the day's academic reflections in her journal, feeling that her research thinking had become clearer.

events.name: Ran into high school classmate Li Haoran.
events.description: On the way back to the dormitory, Sun Yuwei unexpectedly ran into her high school classmate Li Haoran at the library entrance. It turned out he had come back to Kunming early during the winter break to visit family. The two briefly chatted about recent news. Li Haoran shared his work experience in the internet industry in Shenzhen and invited Sun Yuwei to meet up with a few old classmates after the exam. Sun Yuwei happily agreed, and they arranged to meet on January 16.

events.name: Reviewing ancient literature at home

She used handwritten cards to strengthen her memory, and her desk was piled with textbooks and notebooks. Her mother, Li Xiulan, brought her a cup of warm rose tea midway, gently reminding her to rest. Sun Yuwei rubbed her eyes and continued to bury herself in review.

events.name: Research the newly arrived mirrorless camera.
events.description: In the afternoon, the doorbell rang, and a courier delivered the Fujifilm X-T30 II mirrorless camera. Sun Yuwei excitedly opened the packaging and carefully studied the camera body buttons and menu system against the manual. She attached the lens and a memory card, took a few still-life shots in the study, and was very satisfied with the camera's color performance, deciding to go to Green Lake on the weekend for real practice. With her eyes tired from exam review during this period, playing with the camera had become the best relaxation.

events.name: Capturing essay inspiration and taking quick notes
events.description: While fiddling with her camera, Sun Yuwei had a sudden inspiration: she could write about Green Lake from the perspective of a camera lens. She immediately opened her journal and jotted down a fragment in shorthand: “The lens is another kind of gaze — the lake’s shattered gold, a bird flashing past, an old man’s retreating figure — these moments deserve to be frozen.”

Her mother was very supportive of her starting to exercise and mentioned that she had also practiced qigong for a while when she was young. The two of them laughed a lot. events.name: Finalize the time and place for the bestie gathering.
events.description: Before getting up in the morning, Sun Yuwei chatted with her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi on WeChat and finally finalized the plan to meet at Zhiyu Coffee, an independent café in Wuhua District, Kunming, at 2 p.m. on January 11. The three exchanged sticker packs and looked forward to the first get-together of the new year.

events.name: Wrote the first morning journal entry.
events.description: At 6:50 in the morning, Sun Yuwei sat at the desk in her study and, according to the template designed the night before, wrote her first morning journal entry in ten minutes. She recorded the weather as cloudy turning sunny, rated her emotional temperature at 7/10, and wrote down today's creative intention—“from the perspective of the elderly morning runners at Green Lake Park, capture the tranquility of the city awakening.” Then she free-wrote about her expectations and nervousness about building a new habit. She took a sip of hot rose tea as the start of the ritual.

events.name: Start diet management and adjust the family menu
events.description: At noon, Sun Yuwei discussed adjusting the family dinner menu with her mother Li Xiulan in the living room. She suggested reducing braised and deep-fried dishes and adding more steamed or boiled dishes such as steamed fish and blanched choy sum, and planned to record the nutritional intake of each meal. Her mother readily agreed, and that evening's dinner included steamed sea bass and garlic broccoli. Sun Yuwei took photos of the dishes with her phone to paste into her journal, while also recording in detail the eggs from breakfast and the lean meat and vegetable intake from lunch in her diary, officially starting her healthy eating tracker.

events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei focused on reviewing modern prose studies in her home study, concentrating on memorizing the characteristics of prose and representative writers and works. As she memorized, she mentally connected the material to the Green Lake essay she was about to write, feeling that theory and practice reinforced each other. During breaks, she stood up and paced the room to re-center herself.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday, Sun Yuwei fine-tuned her morning diary routine in the morning and went to Zhuanxin Farmers Market to buy healthy ingredients. In the afternoon, she gathered with close friends at a café, and a friend from Shenzhen joined via video call. In the evening, she made up for yoga stretching, balancing friendship and life management.

events.name: Fine-tune the morning journal routine
events.description: In the early morning, Sun Yuwei drew on the first day's experience to fine-tune her morning diary routine in the study. She changed the writing time from pure free writing to spending the first 5 minutes setting a creative intention and the next 5 minutes doing diary-style recording; she also replaced the flower tea with brown sugar pearl milk tea as a pick-me-up and placed the journal on the bedside table so that she could grab it as soon as she woke up. She noted this small optimization in her planner to meet her personal needs.

events.name: Purchasing healthy ingredients at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei made a shopping list based on the menu plan agreed with her mother that week, then took the bus alone to the famous Zhuanxin Farmers' Market in Wuhua District, Kunming. At the market, she carefully selected live fish for steamed fish, seasonal leafy greens for blanched vegetables, and brown rice, oats, and other grains for mixed-grain rice. She also used her new mirrorless camera to take close-up shots of the fresh ingredients, recording the colorful scenes and accumulating material for her journal. After shopping, she carried large bags of ingredients back home with satisfaction and stored them by category.

events.name: Go to Zhiyu Coffee to meet up with close friends
events.description: At 13:50, Sun Yuwei walked to Zhiyu Coffee, an independent café near her home, and sat down early in a seat by the window to wait. She ordered a hot latte, took out her essay collection notes and leafed through them casually; the soft music in the shop made her feel comfortable.

events.name: New Year's first gathering with close friends for a hearty chat
events.description: Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi arrived one after another. The three of them sat together and each ordered coffee and dessert. Zhang Jing shared her plan to switch to a cultural and creative company after the Chinese New Year, while Chen Sisi talked about an Ikenobo flower arrangement she had just completed. During the gathering, Wang Xinran, a close friend far away in Shenzhen, sent a WeChat video call. The three connected and chatted warmly. Wang Xinran shared amusing stories from her big tech company job and teased Sun Yuwei about her new journal. The conversation drifted from career planning to recently read books and TV series, and their friendship grew deeper through the exchange.

events.name: Evening yoga stretching and reflection
events.description: After the gathering ended, Sun Yuwei walked home. In the evening, she did a 20-minute yoga stretching session in her bedroom, focusing on relaxing her hips and neck-shoulder area from prolonged sitting, and reviewed the day's rich socializing and shopping, adding supplementary entries to her journal.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming
start_state.mood: Energized, looking forward to the shopping and the gathering.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming
end_state.mood: Socially fulfilled, life feels full, and I have rich journaling material

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Sun Yuwei studied at home all day, making a final push for the upcoming exams in ancient literature and modern prose studies. In the evening, feeling discomfort in her shoulders and neck, she massaged herself and did some simple stretches. At night she relaxed a little to stay in good shape for the exams.

events.name: Organize research notes on ancient literature and modern prose
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei combined her key notes on ancient literature and modern prose studies in the study, using different colored highlighters to mark core exam points. She made a simple mind map and hung it in front of her desk to help build a knowledge framework. Her mother Li Xiulan occasionally came in to bring fruit and reminded her to balance work and rest.

events.name: Focused memorization and mock practice
events.description: In the afternoon, she did intensive memorization for poetry dictation in ancient literature and essay questions in modern prose studies, and simulated exam scenarios by asking and answering questions herself. When tired, she stood up to look out the window, or used her mirrorless camera to photograph a corner of her desk to refresh her mood. After about three hours, she felt obvious stiffness in her shoulders and neck, so she paused her review.

events.name: Shoulder and neck relaxation and simple stretching.
events.description: Because of long periods of desk work, Sun Yuwei had discomfort in her shoulders and neck. She dimmed the study light, sat on a chair, and did simple neck circles and shoulder stretches, using a massage ball to self-massage her trapezius muscles. After the discomfort eased, she decided to pay more attention to her posture after the exam.

events.name: Evening relaxation and mindset adjustment
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei stopped forcing herself to memorize, and instead looked through the travel photos and Green Lake field trip plan in her journal, listened to a few songs by the band Accusefive, and let her mind drift away from the books. She recorded her exam-prep mood in her morning diary and encouraged herself to perform normally the next day. She went to bed at 11 o'clock sharp to ensure adequate sleep.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming
start_state.mood: A little stressed, but I believe I'm well prepared.

end_state.location: Home bedroom, 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming
end_state.mood: Steady and calm, poised to act.

state.daily_exercise: Neck and shoulder stretching for 10 minutes

2025-01.daily_overview: On Monday, Sun Yuwei took her ancient literature final exam in the morning, prepared for modern prose research in the afternoon, received a clue to a surprise gift sent by her elder sister from Shenzhen in the evening, and ended the day with yoga stretching — fulfilling and heartwarming.

events.name: Older sister Sun Yutong is preparing a gift in Shenzhen.
events.description: Her older sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, used her lunch break to pick out a set of premium stationery and a fountain pen for her younger sister at a boutique stationery store near her company, and wrote on a greeting card, "For a future writer." She carefully wrapped the gift and sent it to Kunming by express delivery. Sun Yutong told her sister on WeChat, "There is a little surprise on the way," but did not reveal what it was.

events.name: Elder sister sent the package
events.description: In the afternoon, the courier picked up the package. Sun Yutong received the shipping receipt, took a screenshot, and sent it to her mother, asking her to keep an eye out for delivery. Sun Yuwei knew nothing about all this; she was absorbed in an exam.

events.name: Took the final exam for Ancient Literature
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei took the final exam in ancient literature in the Literature and History Building at Yunnan University. She arrived at the exam area half an hour early and took turns quizzing each other on key points with her roommates Liu Jia and Zhao Xiaowen. During the exam, she worked from poetry dictation to essay questions and felt she performed normally overall, especially on the Wei-Jin literature section. After handing in the paper, she breathed a long sigh of relief.

events.name: In the afternoon, review modern prose studies.
events.description: After a simple meal with her roommate at the cafeteria at noon, Sun Yuwei went to the library study area to focus on reviewing Modern Prose Studies. She went through her class notes and textbooks, focusing on memorizing the language styles of different essayists, and practiced using past exam questions. The library had ample heating; she occasionally felt drowsy, so she got up and walked around for a bit.

events.name: In the evening, wrote a morning diary and did yoga stretching
events.description: Back in the dormitory in the evening, Sun Yuwei finished writing today's morning diary (recording her feelings about the daytime exam), then rolled out her yoga mat and did 10 minutes of simple stretches: Cat-Cow Pose, preparatory Downward-Facing Dog, and Child's Pose. The campus outside the window was quiet, and she felt her mind and body gradually release from the tension of the exam. Afterwards, she chatted with her elder sister on WeChat and learned that the gift had been sent, filling her with anticipation.

end_state.mood: Relieved, warmed by older sister's care

state.daily_exercise: Yoga stretching for 10 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, cloudy in the afternoon, temperature 11°C-18°C

2025-01.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Sun Yuwei finished the Modern Prose Studies exam in the morning, celebrated the end of exams and rested with her roommates in the afternoon, took an evening walk with them to reminisce about campus, and ended the day with yoga and journaling, bringing the exam week to a satisfying close.

events.name: Took the Modern Prose Studies exam.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei took the final exam for Modern Essay Studies in a teaching building at Yunnan University. The questions involved analyzing the stylistic features of essays by Lu Xun, Zhou Zuoren, Zhu Ziqing, and others. She answered based on her own creative experience and felt the flow of ideas was smooth. After handing in the paper, she briefly exchanged views with classmates, who generally felt the difficulty was moderate.

events.name: Celebrated with roommates over an afternoon meal.
events.description: At noon, Sun Yuwei and her roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin had a meal together at a small restaurant near the school to celebrate the end of exams. The four ordered Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles and a few side dishes. While eating, they talked about their holiday plans: Liu Jia was going to prepare for the postgraduate entrance exam, Zhao Xiaowen was going to intern at a publishing house, and Zhou Lin planned to return to Hunan. They agreed to stay in touch online. Sun Yuwei shared her upcoming plan to go on a creative field trip to Green Lake, and her roommates said they envied her. The four agreed that this would be their farewell dinner after the exams, saying goodbye ahead of time.

events.name: Watched a documentary in the afternoon to relax.
events.description: After returning to the dorm, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop and watched an episode of the documentary 'The Inspired Island' about urban literature. The writers' perspectives on cities in the film inspired her. She relaxed her mind along with the footage, pausing now and then to jot down memorable lines.

events.name: Evening campus walk with roommates
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and Zhao Xiaowen strolled around campus, passing the ginkgo avenue, the library, and the teaching buildings. They talked about the changes over the past four years, feeling nostalgic ahead of the upcoming graduation season, and took photos to remember the moment.

events.name: In the evening, wrote a morning diary and did yoga stretching
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei finished today's morning diary in the dorm, marking her emotional temperature as 8/10 and writing about the relief after the exam and her longing for creative work. Afterward, she did 15 minutes of stretching on her yoga mat, trying the extended side stretch pose and feeling tightness in the back of her legs. Before bed, she sent her sister a WeChat message to ask about the delivery and looked forward to tomorrow's gift.

start_state.mood: Calmly taking the exam, looking forward to relief.

end_state.mood: Light and cheerful, relieved of the burden of exams.

state.daily_exercise: Yoga stretching for 15 minutes, campus walk for 40 minutes

2025-01.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Sun Yuwei completed a professional exam in the morning. In the afternoon, she received a surprise package from her elder sister and was moved as she tried it out, signed up for an online creative workshop, caught up with old classmate Li Haoran, who had returned to school, and friends in Kunming. While tidying the dorm, she found enrollment photos and shared memories with her roommates. In the evening, she ended the day with journaling and yoga. The end of the semester and the gift brought double happiness.

events.name: Take a professional exam.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei took a final exam for a professional course (Literary Theory) at Yunnan University. Being well prepared, she answered calmly. After handing in the exam, she took group photos with several classmates outside the teaching building to mark the end of the first semester of her junior year.

events.name: Signing for the package sent by my sister
events.description: When she got back to the dormitory building, Sun Yuwei received a call from the courier and, puzzled, signed for a package from Shenzhen. Seeing that the sender was her older sister Sun Yutong, she was overjoyed and quickly went upstairs.

events.name: Opened the package, tried the gift, and expressed thanks.
events.description: At the dormitory desk, Sun Yuwei carefully opened the package. Inside was a set of premium paper products, a high-quality fountain pen, and a greeting card that read, 'To the future writer, may you breathe on paper - Sister.' Her eyes welled up slightly. She immediately dipped the new pen in ink and tried it out, writing a few lines on the paper to feel the smoothness of the nib. Then she sent voice messages and photos to her older sister via WeChat, excitedly expressing her gratitude, and the sisters agreed to talk more when they went home for the Spring Festival.

events.name: Registered for the online prose writing workshop
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei submitted her personal information through the registration link from Prose magazine in her dormitory and confirmed her participation in the online writing workshop “Capturing Details in Urban Prose” on the evening of January 16. She downloaded Tencent Meeting in advance, tested the equipment, and reserved a section for notes in her notebook, looking forward to learning from the masters.

events.name: Gathering with Li Haoran and old classmates
events.description: From 16:00 to 18:00 in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei had a small gathering near the school with Li Haoran, who had returned to campus, and other old classmates in Kunming, fulfilling the appointment made on January 5. Everyone talked about their recent news in a lively atmosphere, and they also took a group photo as a memento.

events.name: Tidying up the dormitory and finding old photos.
events.description: After the gathering, Sun Yuwei returned to the dorm and started tidying her belongings. Deep in a drawer, she found a group photo with her roommates taken when she first entered college. The four of them looked young and inexperienced, which moved her. She immediately took a photo and sent it to the dorm group chat. The four of them began warmly recalling funny freshman-year memories and agreed to meet once more before leaving school.

events.name: Evening diary and yoga stretching
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei used her new fountain pen in the dormitory to write today's morning journal, recording how touched she was by the gift and how relieved she was that the exam was over. Then she unrolled her yoga mat and did 15 minutes of gentle stretching, plus meditation breathing exercises. She sent her mother a WeChat message to confirm the approximate time for going home tomorrow, her heart full of anticipation for the winter vacation.

start_state.mood: Lighthearted, looking forward to everything after the exam.

end_state.mood: Happy, moved, and full of creative passion, ready to embrace a new chapter of the winter break

2025-01.daily_overview: The day of returning home after final exams ended. In the morning I packed up and left school, in the afternoon I attended an online creative writing workshop at home, and in the evening I exchanged writing insights with my mother, spending a fulfilling day.

events.name: Pack up dorm belongings and leave school to go home
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei packed her personal belongings, including books and clothes, in her dormitory at Yunnan University, said goodbye to her roommates Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin one by one, then took a bus back to her home at No. 123 Renmin Middle Road, Wuhua District, Kunming. After arriving home, she tidied up her room a bit and prepared for the afternoon activities.

events.name: Attend an online essay writing workshop
events.description: At 7 p.m., Sun Yuwei attended the 'Capturing Details in Urban Prose' creative writing workshop organized by Prose magazine in her home study via Tencent Meeting. The guest speaker, writer Chen Si'an, shared how to capture details from everyday city life and turn them into literary material. Sun Yuwei listened attentively throughout and took detailed notes on key points and writing techniques.

events.name: Discussing creative struggles with writer Chen Si'an
events.description: After the workshop ended, Sun Yuwei stayed in the meeting on her own initiative and had a brief exchange of about five minutes with writer Chen Si'an by raising her hand to ask questions. She asked how to transform personal emotional experience into public text. Chen Si'an gave specific suggestions and encouraged her to observe more and practice writing more. This exchange gave Sun Yuwei valuable creative inspiration.

events.name: Simple evening relaxation at home.
events.description: After the workshop ended, Sun Yuwei washed up briefly at home, then sat on the bed and wrote a few lines in her diary for the day, recording what she had gained from the workshop, and did a 10-minute yoga stretch (Cat-Cow pose and Child's pose). Afterward, she briefly exchanged thoughts with her mother Li Xiulan about the workshop's takeaways and creative insights, then turned off the light and rested at 23:00.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day of winter vacation, Sun Yuwei stayed home with her mother tidying the house and preparing Spring Festival decorations. In the morning, she organized workshop notes and wrote reflections; in the afternoon, she tidied the study to prepare for winter vacation creative work. She felt relaxed and fulfilled.

events.name: Household tidying and Spring Festival decoration preparation
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei helped her mother tidy up the living room and storage room at home, taking out previous years' Spring Festival decorations (such as Spring Festival couplets, window paper-cuts, and Chinese knots), and initially planned the home's Spring Festival decoration scheme, deciding to buy some new decorations to supplement.

events.name: Organized the workshop notes and wrote reflections.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei reorganized and integrated the notes from the previous day's workshop in her study, adding her own thoughts and associations, and wrote a personal reflection of about 800 words titled 'The Capillaries of Detail'. She saved the sorted notes and reflections in the writing material folder on her laptop, planning to try applying the techniques learned in the workshop to her future writing.

events.name: Tidied up the study and writing area
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei carefully cleaned her desk, sorted this semester's textbooks and notes into boxes, and placed them on the bookshelf, setting aside space for winter break writing materials and journaling tools. She also wiped the desk to ensure a tidy creative environment.

2025-01.daily_overview: The first full rest day of winter vacation, full of creativity and the richness of life. In the morning, a trip to Cuihu Park for inspiration began the first essay in the collection. In the afternoon, shopping continued the healthy eating plan. In the evening, she carefully prepared for the book-sharing gathering and unexpectedly received a message from an editor asking for a piece.

events.name: Gathering inspiration at Green Lake Park and writing a prose piece
events.description: On the morning of January 18, Sun Yuwei went alone to Green Lake Park in Wuhua District, Kunming, carrying her newly bought mirrorless camera to photograph the seagulls circling over the lake. While listening to an album by the band Accusefive, she sketched and recorded inspiration on a lakeside bench. She paid special attention to elderly people doing morning exercises, children feeding the seagulls, and the reflection of the pavilion at the lake’s center, accumulating details for her essay. At noon, she had a bowl of tofu pudding rice noodles at a small eatery near the park.

events.name: Healthy shopping at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market
events.description: After visiting Cuihu Lake in the morning, Sun Yuwei walked along the way to Kunming Zhuanxin Farmers' Market for her second major grocery shopping trip of the week. Based on her diet records from the past two weeks, she adjusted her shopping list, adding kale, baby mustard greens, and a fresh mushroom called qingtoujun. She picked carefully through the market, chatted with a familiar vegetable-selling auntie for cooking advice, and used her mirrorless camera to photograph the ingredients, documenting the highlights of this shopping trip. After shopping, she carried the ingredients home and shared them with her mother, who was preparing lunch.

events.name: Organize prose drafts and journal decorations
events.description: When she got home in the evening, Sun Yuwei imported the notes and photo materials she had recorded at Green Lake in the morning into her computer and selected the most satisfying seagull photos. Seizing the good mood, she wrote a draft essay of about 2000 words in one go, titled "Farewell, Seagulls." It was the first finished piece in her essay collection. At the end, she noted a tentative title for the collection, "Breath at the Edge of the City," but she always felt that title sounded too much like a grand manifesto and not quite suited to her state of mind as she observed ripples on the lake and human shadows up close. Perhaps its true name would surface naturally during a walk, just as a seagull cuts across the water. She pasted a seagull photo she took that day into her journal as a memento and marked the wonderful sentences in the text with colored pens.

events.name: Preparing for the Mingyuan Bookstore sharing event and receiving an article invitation from an editor
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei continued refining her speech for tomorrow's "2025 Reading Plan" sharing session at Mingyuan Bookstore. She revisited selected passages from her essay collection "Breath at the City's Edge" and her previous reading notes, especially the core insights from "The Writer's Notebook," and distilled three key points for sharing. As she was practicing her speech, she received a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking if she was interested in writing a short article about the changes in Kunming's food markets around the Spring Festival. She excitedly said she would definitely give it a try if she had the chance, and added this inspiration to tomorrow's sharing outline.

start_state.mood: Energetic and full of creative drive

2025-01.daily_overview: Making friends through books, I had in-depth exchanges with fellow enthusiasts at the sharing session about creative ideals, expanded my network in the local cultural circle, and infused the essay collection with fresh perspectives and momentum.

events.name: Sleeping in and organizing diaries and journals
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei woke up naturally for the first time after the exam (around 8:30). When she got up, her mother had already prepared rice noodles. After breakfast, she organized in her room the diary and journal materials she had recorded during exam week, recopied a few loose pages of exam-room thoughts into her new journal, and added the food logs she had missed in the previous days.

events.name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore for a book lovers' sharing session.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei set off from home with her journal and the draft of her essay collection, walking to Mingyuan Bookstore on Wenhua Lane. When she arrived, the bookstore owner Qin Mingyuan was already adjusting the projector, and more than a dozen book lovers arrived one after another, exchanging New Year reading plans. The sharing session was themed "2025 Reading Plan," and Qin Mingyuan gave a brief opening first.

events.name: Share the essay collection 'Breathing at the City's Edge'.
events.description: When it was Sun Yuwei's turn to speak, she first shared her reflections on reading A Writer's Notebook, then introduced the theme of the essay collection she was working on (working title: Breathing at the City's Edge) — using words to capture the breathing pulse at the edge of Kunming. She explained that this was just a starting point, and she hoped readers could see Kunming's breath from the details of these edges. Qin Mingyuan then suggested that the title might be closer to a walker's perspective, more like an invitation than a definition. She also read a brilliant passage from Farewell, Seagull, which sparked a lively discussion. Qin Mingyuan praised her topic and suggested she pay more attention to street-level details such as Zhuanxin Wet Market and the teahouses in old neighborhoods, to give the essays more of the flavor of everyday life.

events.name: Post-meeting socializing and building new connections
events.description: After the sharing session, Sun Yuwei and several book lovers who were especially interested (including a Ms. Chen who works at a museum and a freelance painter, Xiao Meng) added each other on WeChat and agreed to visit Green Lake together later to find writing inspiration. She also briefly discussed future creative plans with Qin Mingyuan, who said he was willing to help her connect with some old Kunming locals for oral history collection.

events.name: Going home to record the takeaways and send thanks, and making plans to meet up with my best friend
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei opened her journal at her desk and wrote in detail about the takeaways and inspirations from the sharing session (such as new story ideas like 'Sound Map of the Wet Market' and 'Line Sketches of Teahouse Characters'). She organized the information of the new reading friends she had met and saved them to her phone contacts. She sent Qin Mingyuan a thank-you WeChat message with the photos she had taken at the sharing session. Later, she and her best friend Zhang Jing agreed on WeChat to find time next week to go check out some new places and share about their recent lives.

end_state.mood: Greatly encouraged, looking forward to creating

2025-01.daily_overview: Officially launched the meditation and yoga plan, laying a foundation for physical and mental balance in the new year, while refining the outline for the essay collection and trying healthy new recipes with my mother.

events.name: Morning diary and writing practice
events.description: After getting up at 8 in the morning, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and completed the day's morning diary, recording the new ideas and mindset changes after the sharing session. Then she tried the 'detail capture' technique learned at the workshop and wrote a 200-character practice essay about the pothos on her balcony.

events.name: Prepare a meditation environment and download the app.
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei downloaded and familiarized herself with the Tide app on her phone, browsed its meditation courses, and finally chose the "Sleep Meditation" beginner program. In her bedroom, she tidied the bed, dimmed the lights, and put out a lavender sachet to create a quiet, comfortable meditation space. She then set a daily meditation reminder on her phone for 22:30.

events.name: Contact the yoga instructor to confirm the class
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei contacted yoga instructor He Lu via WeChat to confirm the flow yoga class schedule from this week on, every Tuesday and Friday from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM, and agreed that the first formal class would be at 2:00 PM on January 21. He Lu reminded her to wear comfortable sportswear and arrive 15 minutes early.

events.name: Researching weight-gain recipes with her mother
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan tried making a new nutritious dish in the kitchen—avocado egg salad and pan-seared salmon. Knowing from last month's checkup that she was underweight, she now wanted to consciously gain weight. Her mother was very supportive. As they chatted while preparing dinner, Sun Yuwei also wrote down the ingredients and the cooking method.

events.name: First bedtime meditation experience.
events.description: At 10:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei used the guided meditation feature of the Tide App in her bedroom and did her first 10-minute bedtime meditation. She focused on her breathing and body relaxation. Although her mind wandered a few times in the middle, she felt good overall. After it ended, she briefly recorded her first impression in her personal journal: "My body was more tense than I imagined, but the last few minutes were very calm." This effectively relieved the fatigue after the final exams and the anxiety about prose writing.

2025-01.daily_overview: I officially started regular yoga practice and felt obvious improvements in both body and mind. Although there were a few wandering thoughts during the evening meditation, I persisted and completed it. I also shared my first yoga experience with my best friend.

events.name: Morning free writing and planning
events.description: At 8 a.m., Sun Yuwei wrote in her morning diary her expectations for today's yoga class and some small creative goals. She also drew a simple 'yoga check-in' table in her journal, ready to record her feelings after each class. After breakfast, she helped her mother water the flowers and plants on the balcony.

events.name: First vinyasa yoga class experience.
events.description: At 2 p.m. on January 21, 2025, Sun Yuwei arrived on time at Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Center in Kunming for a vinyasa yoga class instructed by He Lu. The class lasted 90 minutes and included Sun Salutations, warrior sequences, and balancing postures. He Lu gave special guidance on her downward-facing dog posture and emphasized the coordination of breath and movement. After class, Sun Yuwei tried a simple five-minute meditation and felt an unprecedented sense of physical and mental relaxation; her steps were even light on the way home.

events.name: Had a phone call with best friend Zhang Jing to share her yoga experience
events.description: After yoga class, Sun Yuwei, still in high spirits, called her best friend Zhang Jing on WeChat and excitedly described how the class felt, inviting Zhang Jing to try it sometime. Zhang Jing was home on break, so the two chatted for half an hour and agreed to meet on Wednesday afternoon to explore a new place.

events.name: Evening reading and relaxation
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei leafed through the collection of Yunnan local essays she had bought on the 3rd. When she came across a passage describing a sunset over Dianchi Lake, she thought of her own draft about Green Lake and jotted down a few associative words in the margin of the page. She also chatted in the family group with her sister Sun Yutong about her first yoga experience, and her sister encouraged her to keep it up.

events.name: Pre-sleep breathing meditation

events.name: Morning journal and thought organization
events.description: At 8 a.m. on January 22, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and finished her morning journal for the day. She reviewed the physical and mental changes after yesterday’s yoga class and wrote in her journal: “After the body relaxes, the mind seems clearer.” Then she spent 10 minutes browsing “The Writer’s Notebook” and copied a passage about “daily rituals.”

events.name: A shop-hopping date with best friend Zhang Jing
events.description: After finishing her morning diary, Sun Yuwei met her best friend Zhang Jing at the entrance of Wenhua Lane as promised. They first went to the newly opened Eraser Bookstore and leisurely browsed the literature and art bookshelves. In the section for Yunnan local writers, Sun Yuwei found an essay collection about Kunming city life written in the 1990s and was overjoyed. Then they went to a nearby handmade milk tea shop, each ordered a cup of milk tea, and sat by the window sharing what had been going on in their lives. Zhang Jing talked about interesting things from her elementary school internship, and Sun Yuwei talked about her new plans for the essay collection and yoga. They also showed each other their recent journals and didn’t part until 2 p.m.

events.name: Organizing the outline for the essay collection.
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei opened her laptop in the study and used mind-mapping software to organize a detailed outline for her essay collection, Breathing at the Edge of the City. With the central theme at the center, she expanded branches for the 12 core essays one by one. The title of the central node was still 'Tentative: Breathing at the Edge of the City,' but as planning went deeper, she increasingly felt that the current title was a static observation, while she wanted her writing to be dynamic—a slow passage weaving through the texture of the city. This vague dissatisfaction filled her with a desire to explore. For each essay, she planned a topic name (such as 'Sound Map of the Vegetable Market,' 'Teahouse Narratives,' 'The Four Seasons of Cuihu Lake'), an estimated length (about 2,000–3,000 words each), and main source material (such as visits to local bookstores, street observation notes, and childhood memories).

events.name: Journal progress tracker and decoration
events.description: After completing the outline, Sun Yuwei hand-wrote the creation progress schedule into her journal, including milestones such as completing one piece per month and finishing the first draft during the summer vacation (July). On the journal page, she marked the motivational phrase 'Finish the draft in July' in colored pen and drew tiny book pages and seagull stickers as decoration, keeping the plan clearly visible and full of motivation.

events.name: Bedtime body scan meditation
events.description: At 10 p.m., Sun Yuwei opened the Tide app in her bedroom, selected the “Body Scan” theme, and did a 10-minute bedtime meditation. Following the guide, she gradually relaxed each part of her body and noticed some tension in her right shoulder and neck (possibly a reaction after yoga). After finishing, she wrote in her journal: “The body scan made me notice the tension in my shoulders; tomorrow during yoga I’ll pay more attention to stretching.”

2025-01.daily_overview: Immersed in the Spring Festival creative work of the Ikenobo school of flower arrangement, using wintersweet and narcissus to weave New Year blessings, and experiencing the ceremonial beauty of traditional aesthetics in the fragrance of flowers.

events.name: Planning the flower market route and preparing tools
events.description: In the morning, Sun Yuwei used a mobile map app in her home study to plan the fastest route to Dounan Flower Market (subway + walking), then took out scissors, floral foam, serrated vases, and other flower arranging tools from the storage room, wiped them clean with a damp cloth, and prepared an eco-friendly cloth bag for the flower materials to ensure a smooth afternoon of creation.

events.name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to Select Floral Materials
events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei left home and took the subway to Dounan Flower Market in Kunming. In the run-up to the Spring Festival, the market was especially lively, with bright red pussy willows and kumquats everywhere. Following the Ikenobo school of flower arrangement, she carefully selected wintersweet flowers symbolizing good fortune, pine branches symbolizing resilience, and narcissus bulbs symbolizing purity, along with a few silver willow branches and green leaves for accents. After bargaining with the florist, she returned home loaded with purchases.

events.name: Create an Ikenobo-style New Year flower arrangement.
events.description: Returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei spread old newspapers on the living room coffee table and took out the flower materials and tools. She first built the basic framework with floral foam and branches, then applied the basic Ikenobo style (rikka style) technique, using wintersweet as the main branch, pine branches as the secondary branches, and daffodils and silver willow as accents. After about an hour of trimming, fixing, and repeated adjustments, she carefully created a Chinese New Year flower arrangement with varied heights and an elegant artistic conception.

events.name: Showcasing works and sharing joy
events.description: After finishing the arrangement, Sun Yuwei placed it in a prominent spot beside the TV cabinet in the living room, adjusting the angle so it matched the indoor lighting. She took photos of the flower arrangement from several angles with her phone and immediately shared them with her best friend Zhang Jing and her older sister Sun Yutong. Zhang Jing replied, “Beautiful as a painting.” Her mother Li Xiulan came home from work and was full of praise; the two of them took a few more photos together.

events.name: Mindfulness meditation before bed.
events.description: At 10 p.m., Sun Yuwei opened the Tide app in the bedroom, selected the 'Mindful Meditation' theme, and did a 10-minute pre-sleep meditation. She focused her attention on the faint traffic sounds outside the window and her breathing, and for a few minutes entered a completely blank state. After it ended, she wrote in her journal: 'During mindful meditation, I briefly experienced a clear mind; it was very comfortable.'

events.name: Short afternoon break and a call with her elder sister.

events.name: Pre-sleep meditation and weekly review

She found that she was falling asleep noticeably faster—the time from lying down to falling asleep had shortened from 30 minutes to 15 minutes—and she felt more peaceful. She noted this observation in her journal and wrote down next week's meditation plan: 'Keep it up, and try to bring the focus from meditation into writing.'

After her morning yoga and meditation, she rented a car and went to Xundian Grassland to photograph wildflowers and collect materials for flower arrangement. After a picnic in the early evening, she returned to the city. In the evening, she wrote the first draft of her column and published a recruitment post for the bookstore event, full of natural inspiration and creative energy.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation.

She met Su Man at the rental spot, drove with Su Man along the Hangrui Expressway and county roads for about 2 hours, and arrived at Fenglongshan Grassland in Xundian County. On the way, the two chatted and listened to soothing music, confirming their shooting and collection plan.

As they collected, the two exchanged botanical knowledge and flower arranging insights for about three hours. Sun Yuwei sketched the forms of several flowers in her journal.

In the sunset afterglow, they enjoyed a picnic while talking freely about life and art. Su Man shared interesting stories from the botanical garden, and Sun Yuwei talked about the ideas for her recent essay collection.

Su Man organized the shot footage in the passenger seat, and the two agreed to use the collected material together next time to plan flower arrangement works. After returning to the city, Sun Yuwei dropped Su Man off at her residence, then went to the car rental company to return the car. The procedures went smoothly.

She focused on describing the colors and smells of winter seasonal ingredients and the atmosphere of the market, completing a draft of about 2,000 characters. While writing, she incorporated details of visiting the market with her mother, adding warmth of family affection.
