2025-11.daily_overview: On Monday, Sun Yuwei returned to quiet personal writing. She spent the whole day at home organizing the manuscript of 'Slow Travel Notes', brainstorming cover design slogans, and, inspired by meditation, created ten short poems. In the evening, she transcribed and compiled them into a booklet, feeling fulfilled and at peace.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei did a 30-minute yoga and meditation session in her bedroom, including a 10-minute standing sequence (prayer pose, spinal twist) and 20 minutes of sitting meditation. After consistent practice, the stiffness in her shoulders and neck had noticeably eased.

events.name: Organize the manuscript for the essay collection Slow Travel Notes
events.description: At nine in the morning, in her study, Sun Yuwei organized all the manuscripts of Slow Travel Notes (the author's preface, fifteen essays, and the afterword) in order, checked page numbers and formatting, and wrote a short revision memo for each piece. She listed the key points for the cover design, hoping to use hand-drawn willow branches from Green Lake on a plain, elegant background, and wrote a preliminary tagline: 'In Kunming's breath, discover life's slow journey.' She was preparing for her upcoming communication with the editor.

events.name: Go to the workspace at Mingyuan Bookstore to write the short poetry collection “Meditation Notes.”
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei arrived at her workstation on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore. She distilled the images and insights that had emerged during recent yoga and meditation sessions into ten short poems. Each poem was four to eight lines, with themes covering breath, bodily sensations, emotional flow, and natural imagery. With a fountain pen, she neatly copied the poems into her journal and designed a simple watercolor cover, compiling them into a collection titled "Meditation Notes." She revised the wording repeatedly until she was satisfied in the evening.

events.name: Evening walk and reading
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei accompanied her father for a walk in the community and exchanged thoughts on the day's creative work. Before bed, she read the sections about Kunming in Wang Zengqi's "The Plants and Trees of the Human World" and copied beautiful passages.

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Yoga and meditation for 30 minutes, and an evening walk for 40 minutes.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Sun Yuwei published her poetry collection Meditation Notes on Xiaohongshu, which resonated with readers. Meanwhile, she had a video call with Fang Qing to refine the Dali travel plan with clear division of tasks. After her morning run and yoga class, she went to the bookstore to handle manuscripts, and in the evening enjoyed a documentary with her mother—everyday life never short of poetry.

events.name: Morning yoga meditation and morning run.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei did 30 minutes of yoga and meditation in her bedroom, starting with Sun Salutations and reviewing the poetry collection during meditation. At 6:45, she went for a 5 km morning run along the Panlong River at a pace of about 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, and stretched after the run.

events.name: Publish the poetry collection 'Meditation Notes'.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei logged into Xiaohongshu using her secondary account 'Yuwei Slow Record' and published all ten short poems from Meditation Notes as illustrated posts. She photographed the pages of the poems in her journal, added soft filters and text titles, and included a note of about 200 characters about her creative inspiration, mentioning that it was the result of her sustained yoga and meditation practice. After publishing, she actively replied to comments and shared the post to WeChat Moments and her writers' group. That day she received hundreds of likes and dozens of comments.

events.name: Afternoon yoga class
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went to the yoga studio for class and continued working on her headstand; she could now stably hold the slow-rising headstand for over 15 seconds. After class, she talked with the instructor and He Lu.

events.name: Refine the Dali travel plan with Fang Qing
events.description: At 3:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei had a WeChat video call with her travel partner Fang Qing to discuss in detail the plan for a volunteer trip to Dali in March 2026. The two confirmed the travel dates (March 7-21) and route (Dali Old Town - Weishan - Shaxi), and divided the work: Fang Qing was responsible for booking hostels and contacting cultural experience programs; Sun Yuwei was responsible for finding distinctive guesthouses and putting together a list of independent bookstores and cafés. The call lasted about an hour, and they created a travel planning sheet in a shared document.

events.name: Handling manuscripts at the workstation at Mingyuan Bookstore
events.description: After the video call, Sun Yuwei went to her workstation on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore, dealt with the backlog of writing emails, and reviewed the draft of a short essay she had prepared for Youth Literature. During this time, she chatted with Qin Mingyuan and shared her joy that Meditation Notes had been well received.

events.name: Watch a documentary with mother in the evening.
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei watched an episode of the documentary Once Upon a Bite with her mother, Li Xiulan. The mother and daughter discussed Yunnan ingredients, and her mother mentioned that she planned to make a mushroom hotpot on the weekend, which made Sun Yuwei very excited.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

state.daily_exercise: Yoga meditation for 30 minutes, morning run of 5 kilometers, yoga class for 1.5 hours

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 7°C to 16°C, a noticeable drop in temperature

2025-11.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Sun Yuwei spent the morning at home sorting out her publishing ideas, and in the afternoon she had a WeChat voice call with the editor Xu Mingyuan. They reached an initial consensus on the publication plan for the essay collection Slow Travel Notes, preparing for the upcoming editorial meeting and taking an important step toward publication.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei did 30 minutes of yoga and meditation in her bedroom. As the temperature had dropped, she did a few extra rounds of Sun Salutations to warm up, then sat in meditation, feeling calm at heart.

events.name: Preparing key points for publication communication.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei organized the cover concept and promotional copy drafts she had previously written in her study, and based on the publishing process mentioned in Xu Mingyuan's email, she made a communication checklist including key questions such as cover design style, direction of the promotional copy, and expected publication time, along with alternative options. She particularly marked 'Final title: Slow Travel Notes' on the checklist to avoid name confusion during communication.

events.name: Phone discussion with editor Xu Mingyuan about publication matters.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei had an in-depth conversation with Xu Mingyuan over a WeChat voice call. She first confirmed that the essay collection titled 'Slow Travel Notes' had been approved by the editorial department. Xu Mingyuan said the name was very distinctive. The two reached an initial consensus on the cover design direction, promotional copy, and expected publication date. Xu Mingyuan also encouraged her to prepare an author photo and an interview draft. After hanging up, Sun Yuwei excitedly sent a WeChat message to her mother to tell her the news.

events.name: Organize publication notes in the evening
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei recorded the communication results in detail in her creative notebook, listing the next tasks: polishing the author bio, taking promotional photos, and writing the creation statement. She drew a small star in her journal to mark the milestone.

events.name: Evening walk
events.description: The temperature dropped noticeably. Sun Yuwei put on a thick coat and accompanied her parents for a walk around Green Lake, sharing the good news of her communication with the editor. Her parents were proud of her.

end_state.mood: Energized

state.daily_exercise: Yoga and meditation for 30 minutes, walk for 40 minutes.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Thursday, Sun Yuwei felt a slight sore throat after her morning run, but she still managed to complete the first draft of the cover design and send it to the editor. In the afternoon, after yoga class, she went to Dounan Flower Market to buy floral materials. In the evening, she practiced watercolor, maintaining her creative pace despite the mild discomfort.

events.name: Morning yoga meditation and morning run.
events.description: At 6:00 a.m., Sun Yuwei did 30 minutes of yoga and meditation in the bedroom, using yin yoga to stretch the muscle groups that tend to become tense in winter. At 6:45 she went for a 5-kilometer morning run around Green Lake, but after the run she felt some dryness and itching in her throat, so after returning home she drank more warm water.

events.name: Write the cover design proposal and promotional slogan.
events.description: At nine in the morning, despite a slightly sore throat, Sun Yuwei sat at her computer in the study and formally wrote the draft cover design plan and tagline for her essay collection "Between Breaths." She described the visual elements in detail and set the tagline as: "Every act of writing is a deep breath for this city." Before noon, she emailed it to Xu Mingyuan for review.

events.name: Afternoon yoga class (adjusted)
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei went to the yoga studio for class. Due to a sore throat, she reduced high-intensity poses and focused more on breathing exercises and restorative poses. She felt a little better after class.

events.name: Go to Dounan Flower Market to purchase floral materials
events.description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei took the subway to Dounan Flower Market to choose flowers for the weekend yoga studio floral arrangement and the Winter Solstice flower arrangement workshop. She bought winter flowers such as eucalyptus leaves, Australian wax flower, and white ranunculus, and chatted with a familiar flower vendor. After returning home, she kept them in a bucket of clean water and planned to trim them the next day.

events.name: Evening journal and watercolor practice.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Sun Yuwei recorded the publishing progress in her journal and casually painted a wintersweet in watercolor as a cover reference. She photographed the process and sent it to Zhou Lin to discuss the possibility of turning it into stickers. Before bed, she drank plenty of water and also made some honey water.

events.name: Evening walk canceled.
events.description: Because of throat discomfort, Sun Yuwei told her parents she would not go out for a walk this evening. They asked with concern, and her mother told her to rest well.

start_state.mood: Focused but with a mild throat discomfort.

end_state.mood: Slight discomfort but satisfaction

state.daily_exercise: Yoga meditation 30 minutes (gentle), morning run 5 km (easy), yoga class 1 hour (restorative), flower market walk 1 hour

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, Sun Yuwei's throat had basically recovered. In the morning, she did the monthly bookkeeping and budget planning, and after finding that expenses were rather high, she decided to optimize. In the afternoon, she wrote a recommendation blurb for her friend Yang Xiao's novel. In the evening, she went supermarket shopping with her mother to buy healthy ingredients. At night, she attended an online sharing session for the writing group, balancing personal finance and literary support.

events.name: Morning yoga and meditation (primarily breathing exercises)
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei did 30 minutes of yoga and meditation in her bedroom, focusing on breathing exercises to care for her throat, and seated meditation; she felt her throat had improved.

events.name: Monthly bookkeeping and budget planning
events.description: At ten in the morning, Sun Yuwei sat at her desk and took out her November journal and mobile banking app to check this month's income and expenses item by item. She tallied the amounts in each category and found that food and transportation expenses were relatively high, analyzing that the reason was more dining out and taking taxis in the first half of the month. In her journal, she wrote down the December budget: set a monthly fixed savings target of 1500 yuan, set limits for dining, transportation, shopping, and other categories, and noted reducing the number of takeout orders to cut food expenses by 20%.

events.name: Friend Yang Xiao's novel was accepted, and I was invited to write a recommendation.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, her good friend Yang Xiao sent a WeChat message saying that her novel 'The Alleyway' had passed the final review and was scheduled to be published in the January 2026 issue of Dianchi literary magazine, and she invited Sun Yuwei to write a recommendation blurb. Sun Yuwei gladly agreed. After reading the final draft, she was moved by the fantastical quality of the old Kunming alleyways in the story. Before evening, she wrote a recommendation of about 300 characters and sent it to Yang Xiao via WeChat, who was deeply moved.

events.name: In the evening, went to the supermarket with mother to buy healthy ingredients.
events.description: At 5:30 in the evening, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan went to the fresh food supermarket near their residential community and bought ingredients for the coming week according to their healthy eating plan: chicken breast, tofu, broccoli, tomatoes, and more. They also bought whole wheat bread and Greek yogurt. Her mother shared tips on choosing vegetables, and the mother and daughter chatted and laughed happily. After returning home, Sun Yuwei washed, cut, and portioned some of the vegetables into containers and refrigerated them.

events.name: Evening writing group online sharing
events.description: At 8 p.m., Sun Yuwei attended the online sharing session of the “Ink and Breath” writing group via Tencent Meeting. She shared her reflections on writing “Meditation Notes” and received positive feedback from the group. Someone suggested she turn her experience of combining meditation and writing into a series of articles. She took careful notes and agreed to write a short piece for the group's next newsletter.

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes of yoga and meditation (breathing practice), and 40 minutes of walking around the supermarket.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday, Sun Yuwei completed her pottery course, opened the kiln to retrieve seven pieces, and gave her favorite small bowl to the instructor. After a morning run and cross-training, she attended an offline writing group event and read an essay aloud, receiving warm feedback. In the evening, she organized her pottery pieces and journaled her feelings, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Morning yoga meditation, jogging, and cross-training.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei did a 30-minute yoga meditation in her bedroom, welcoming the weekend with gentle flow yoga. At 6:45, she went for a 5-kilometer morning run along the Panlong River. After the easy run, she did a 20-minute brisk walk as cross-training.

events.name: Pottery workshop: opening the kiln and retrieving pieces
events.description: At ten in the morning, Sun Yuwei took the bus to Taoran Pottery Studio in Guandu District for the final pottery class of the session. As the instructor Wu Mingyuan and the other students waited, the kiln was opened. She carefully took out her seven pieces: a speckled-glaze small bowl, an unfired clay teacup, and several irregular small plates. The glaze was warmer and more delicate than she had expected. She wiped and examined each piece one by one, and took photos to remember the occasion.

events.name: Present the mentor with a small bowl and share insights
events.description: After the kiln was opened, Sun Yuwei selected a small speckled-glaze bowl from the works, handed it to her advisor Wu Mingyuan with both hands, and said sincerely: “Pottery has made me understand that writing is also a process of clay and fire.” The advisor took the bowl, greatly appreciated her insight, and encouraged her to integrate this creative philosophy into her writing. The other students also gathered around to share the stories of their works, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

events.name: Read prose at the writing group's in-person event
events.description: At three in the afternoon, the "Ink and Breath" writing group held its fourth Saturday in-person activity in the activity area on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore, and it was also the last one of this phase. Sun Yuwei arrived early to help the group leader set up the venue and briefly served as host at the start of the event. She read aloud a complete essay she had finished revising (about a walk by Cuihu Lake with her father) and received warm applause from the whole group. After the event, she exchanged manuscripts with other members and agreed to continue online peer review.

events.name: Evening: reflecting and tidying notes.
events.description: At eight in the evening, Sun Yuwei recorded in her journal her reflections on completing the pottery class and the writing group, and pasted photos of her pottery works. She felt that she had grown another small step in the clay and fire of art.

end_state.mood: Moved and satisfied.

state.daily_exercise: Yoga meditation for 30 minutes, morning run of 5 km, cross-training (20 minutes of brisk walking), and moving around during pottery class.

2025-11.daily_overview: On the last day of November, Sun Yuwei completed a long-distance running breakthrough in the morning, then made her annual journal summary, reviewing the year's achievements and recording her first regular fund investment; at noon, she settled the remaining payment from the postcard consignment with Qin Mingyuan and brainstormed new cultural products; in the afternoon, she summarized the changes brought by yoga, meditation, and healthy eating; in the evening, she celebrated with a family dinner, bringing the month to a perfect close.

events.name: Morning yoga meditation and long-distance run
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei completed her last yoga meditation of the month in the bedroom, doing a 30-minute gratitude meditation to thank her physical and mental growth. She then changed into her gear and went for a long-distance jog along the Panlong River, successfully completing 8 kilometers at a pace of about 7 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. After the run, she stretched thoroughly and felt her endurance steadily improving, laying the foundation for her 10-kilometer goal.

events.name: Annual journal summary
events.description: At nine in the morning, Sun Yuwei took down the 2025 planner, colored pens, stickers, and other items from the bookshelf in her study, and also found materials such as spreadsheets and check-in screenshots. She tallied them in order: 27 submissions for the year, 19 published; total royalties of 86,000 yuan; 168 yoga practices; 2 trips; 57 books read. She wrote these figures on the summary page, and under the Finance subsection wrote First regular fund investment in CSI 300, drawing a small sapling icon. At the bottom of the page she pasted a falling-leaves tree sticker, symbolizing settling and renewal.

events.name: Postcard consignment settlement and cultural-creative ideas
events.description: At 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei arrived at Mingyuan Bookstore and settled the final accounts for the consignment of the "Four Seasons of Green Lake" postcards with Qin Mingyuan. About 30 cards had been sold, and she received the remaining payment. She gave the few leftover postcards to the bookstore as decoration. Qin Mingyuan encouraged her to turn the series into a complete watercolor album, and Sun Yuwei wrote down her initial ideas for developing hand-painted cultural and creative products in her notebook.

events.name: Summarize and share the effects of yoga and meditation.
events.description: At four in the afternoon, Sun Yuwei sat by the window and reviewed her practice and creative work from late November. She flipped through her journal entries on meditation and the original manuscript of "Meditation Notes," noting that stiffness in her shoulders and neck had clearly eased, time to fall asleep had shortened, and anxiety had almost disappeared. She wrote a summary in her phone notes, then shared the changes with her mother, who was gratified and praised her daughter for appearing completely refreshed.

events.name: Healthy eating monthly summary and future planning
events.description: At six in the evening, Sun Yuwei reviewed her healthy eating progress from November 10 to 30 in her journal, recording that her weight had slowly risen from 46.5 kg to 47 kg, her energy had improved, and her skin looked better. Although she still occasionally ordered takeout, she cooked more often overall. She planned to keep the weekend meal-prep, workday-simplified routine in December and try to learn new healthy Chinese dishes.

events.name: Evening family dinner
events.description: At seven in the evening, mother Li Xiulan made a mushroom hot pot, and father Sun Mingyuan also came home early. The family of three sat around the table and enjoyed dinner. During the meal, Sun Yuwei shared her annual summary achievements and the publication progress of her essay collection; her parents praised her endlessly, and the family atmosphere was warm. Before going to bed, Sun Yuwei did a 10-minute body scan meditation and fell asleep peacefully.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Yoga meditation for 30 minutes, long-distance run of 8 kilometers, evening meditation for 10 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, slightly cool in the morning, temperature 15–22°C

2025-10.daily_overview: On the first day of National Day, Sun Yuwei started a fulfilling day with a morning run and ginkgo street photography, completed a comprehensive watercolor technique practice, tidied her workspace, and prepared her marathon gear, feeling excited about tomorrow's race.

events.name: Morning photos of ginkgo trees on Wenlin Street
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei walked to Wenlin Street carrying her mirrorless camera. The morning light slanted across the ginkgo leaves, turning them golden. She walked along the street looking for the best angle, capturing the moments when light penetrated the leaves. She shot for about 1.5 hours and produced more than 40 frames.

events.name: Running training along the Panlong River
events.description: In the morning, she changed into sportswear and went to the bank of the Panlong River for a 4.5 km running training session, keeping an average pace of 7 minutes 5 seconds per kilometer. The riverbank was quiet on the holiday morning. After the run, she completed a full set of stretches, took photos to record the data, and wrote her running reflections in her journal after returning home.

events.name: Decorating my workstation and organizing manuscripts.
events.description: In the afternoon, at her regular workstation in Mingyuan Bookstore, she did National Day decorations: posted handwritten encouraging slogans and red maple leaf bookmarks on the wall, replaced the dried flowers with warm-colored daisies, then organized the scattered manuscripts and notes, restored the desk to tidiness, and prepared for focused writing for the holiday column commission.

events.name: Comprehensive watercolor technique practice
events.description: In the evening at home, she tried combining wet-on-wet, dry layering, and masking fluid to paint a mixed bouquet. She first laid down the base color with the wet method, then added details with dry layering, completing a fairly finished watercolor piece. She pasted it into her journal and noted her creative insights.

events.name: Pre-race preparation for the marathon.
events.description: Before bed, took out the race gear and organized it: washed the running shoes, prepared the quick-dry sportswear, pinned the race bib onto the T-shirt, filled the water bottle and put in energy gels, confirmed the next day's meeting time and place with yoga partner He Lu via WeChat, discussed the aid stations on the course, and went to bed early to ensure enough sleep.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and calm

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 4.5 km, stretching 15 minutes

2025-10.daily_overview: Successfully completed the 5K fun run in the marathon, and planning a volunteer trip to Dali with Fang Qing made the future feel full of anticipation. A busy and joyful day.

events.name: Ginkgo photos on Wenlin Street, Part 2
events.description: At 6 a.m., Sun Yuwei went to Wenlin Street again to try low-angle upward shots of ginkgo tree canopies, close-ups of leaf textures, and to capture scenes of elderly morning exercisers interacting with ginkgo trees. She shot for about 1.5 hours and accumulated more than 50 shots.

events.name: Participated in the Highland Half Marathon 5K health run.
events.description: In the morning, she arrived at the marathon start with He Lu and ran steadily along the Panlong River course at their training pace. She hydrated twice along the way and finally finished in 35:08. At the finish line, she took a photo with He Lu and received a medal, filled with a sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Reserve a family portrait photo shoot.
events.description: After running, she called the 'Time Memory' Photo Studio by Cuihu Lake to book the family photo shoot for the morning of October 3, confirmed the Republican-era clothing package and price, provided her father's size for a dark long gown and her mother's size for a student outfit, then notified her parents in the family group chat of the time and dress code.

events.name: Planning a volunteer trip to Dali with Fang Qing
events.description: In the afternoon, met up with good friend Fang Qing at a teahouse near Green Lake Park. Over Pu'er tea, we looked through a Dali travel guide and planned a volunteer trip for next spring, discussing in detail a route covering Weishan Ancient Town and Shaxi Old Town, and decided to make Bai tie-dye and jiama paper culture our research topics. The discussion lasted three hours.

events.name: Reconfirm the photo studio and check the outfit.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, she called the photo studio to confirm tomorrow's time and address again, checked the whole family's outfits and accessories one by one, and backed up her sister Sun Yutong's clothing measurements in case additional printing was needed later.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and joyful

state.daily_exercise: 5-kilometer run (race)

2025-10.daily_overview: Continued ginkgo photography in the early morning; the family portrait shoot in the morning was full of warmth, and the Mid-Autumn Festival atmosphere grew stronger.

events.name: Wenlin Street Ginkgo Photography No. 3
events.description: At 6 a.m., went to Wenlin Street again. The weather was clear and sunny. I focused on capturing the backlit translucency of ginkgo leaves and the moving moments of falling leaves. I shot for about 1.5 hours and accumulated more than 50 shots.

events.name: Family portrait shooting: changing clothes and doing makeup.
events.description: At 8 a.m., she walked to the photo studio with her parents. The family of three changed into Republican-era outfits: Sun Yuwei wore a blue student-style cheongsam with twin braids, her mother wore the same student outfit with light makeup, and her father wore a gray long gown and round-framed sunglasses. Laughter broke out constantly as they changed, and her mother kept taking selfies.

events.name: Family portrait photo shoot: studio session
events.description: At 9:30, in the Republican-era style studio set, the photographer guided the family of three into warm poses, with a gramophone, rattan chairs, and a rickshaw in the background. They took formal group photos, mother-daughter arm-in-arm photos, and several other sets, lasting 40 minutes and producing about 50 shots.

events.name: Selecting photos for the family portrait.
events.description: After the shoot, the whole family browsed the proofs and selected 15 satisfactory photos together. They decided to enlarge a group photo of three people sitting on a rattan chair to 40 inches and frame it. The mother immediately ordered two extra 6-inch prints to give to relatives. The studio promised to complete the fine retouching within 7 working days.

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-10.daily_overview: Sorted ginkgo photos, studied jiama paper culture, and gained new friendships through evening writing group exchanges.

events.name: Organizing ginkgo photographs.
events.description: In the morning at home, she imported more than a hundred ginkgo photos taken over the previous three days into her computer for selection. She selected 20 for color adjustment, printed a few, pasted them into her journal, and added marginal notes with the shooting parameters, planning to make postcards in the future.

events.name: Researching Dali's jiama paper culture.
events.description: Spent the whole day searching materials and papers online, gaining a systematic understanding of the origins, folk uses, and contemporary artistic value of jiama paper. Took notes while reading and organized key information into the travel handbook to prepare for next year's field research.

events.name: Second session of the writing group.
events.description: On Saturday evening, she went to Mingyuan Bookstore to attend the writing group. The theme was "Mastering Narrative Rhythm." She brought the essay outline she had shared last time to the discussion, raising the problem that the writing pace was slow. Fellow member Chen Chen offered suggestions, and during the break the two exchanged reading preferences and added each other on WeChat. After the activity, she shared notes and takeaways in the group and received responses.

end_state.mood: Fulfillment after the exchange

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-10.daily_overview: Completed the ginkgo-themed shoot, carefully prepared the book manuscript for submission, and is full of anticipation for the publisher's feedback.

events.name: Final ginkgo photo shoot on Wenlin Street
events.description: At 6 a.m., made the final trip to Wenlin Street to photograph ginkgo trees, focusing on color changes under different light and slow-shutter effects of falling leaves. After shooting, organized the camera gear; accumulated about 265 frames of film, readying for later selection for the photo collection.

events.name: Preparing the manuscript of 'Slow Travel Notes' for submission.
events.description: In the morning, at the study at home, she pulled up the final manuscript of 'Slow Travel Notes,' proofread it carefully, and printed three bound copies. She wrote personalized submission letters tailored to the styles of the three publishers—Spring City Literature and Art Publishing House, Dianchi Book Society, and Yunling Culture—introducing the theme and background and attaching a personal profile. After checking that everything was correct, she put each into a large envelope and affixed stamps.

events.name: Video-called Fang Qing to finalize the travel framework
events.description: In the evening, she had a WeChat video call with Fang Qing, sharing the travel materials they had each compiled, confirming the preliminary route, time frame, and the accommodations and volunteer positions to be booked, and agreed to discuss again in detail in a month.

events.name: Family gathering
events.description: At noon, the whole family went out to eat and tasted mushroom hot pot. Sun Yuwei had a few extra pieces of flower cake and mushrooms and felt slightly bloated.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to the fate of the manuscript

state.daily_exercise: None

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with thin clouds at night, temperature 16–22°C.

2025-10.daily_overview: Mid-Autumn Festival: photographed the remaining lotus at Green Lake in the early morning, and the family gathered to admire the moon in the evening. A warm record.

events.name: Morning photography of withered lotus at Green Lake
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, she took her camera and tripod to Cuihu Lake. In the swirling morning mist, she walked along the lake looking for unique withered lotus and reflections, adjusted the aperture and shutter speed to capture the hazy beauty of the remaining lotus, and returned about an hour later.

events.name: Arrange the balcony for Mid-Autumn moon viewing
events.description: In the evening, set up a small wooden table and cushions with mother on the balcony, prepared Yunnan ham mooncakes, pomegranates, pomelos, grapes and other seasonal fruits, plus tea. Lit small lanterns to create a warm moon-viewing atmosphere.

events.name: The whole family watched the moon and chatted on the balcony.
events.description: After nightfall, the family sat together admiring the moon and tasting mooncakes. Mother told amusing stories of celebrating Mid-Autumn Festival in Qujing when she was young, and Father shared Mid-Autumn memories from Kunming's old streets, creating a cheerful and harmonious atmosphere.

events.name: Journal entry: Mid-Autumn reflections.
events.description: After moon viewing, returned to the room, wrote the moon is brighter in one's hometown in the journal, recorded feelings about the reunion, printed out the photos of the full moon and pasted them into the journal, keeping them as writing material.

end_state.mood: Warm and happy

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-10.daily_overview: On the last day of the holiday, I found a great English book, researched tie-dye culture, started a new habit of reading English aloud every day, and made a light meal plan for after the holiday.

events.name: Start the daily English read-aloud.
events.description: At 7 a.m. at home, I started a new habit: reading aloud from the first chapter of the English original of Walden, copying new words and great lines into my journal with small illustrations, and deciding to keep it up for half an hour each morning.

events.name: Research Dali's Bai tie-dye.
events.description: Stayed at home all day researching the history, craftsmanship, and modern inheritance of Dali Bai tie-dye through the internet and borrowed materials, recording key points in detail and organizing them into travel notes to prepare material for next year's volunteer trip.

events.name: Hunting for books at a used bookstore on Wenlin Street
events.description: While browsing a second-hand bookstore on Wenlin Street in the afternoon, I came across an English original of Walden and bought it immediately; this was the catalyst for starting English reading aloud.

events.name: Develop a post-holiday intermittent fasting plan.

2025-10.daily_overview: Mailed out the manuscript, successfully completed the watercolor course, and went for an evening walk and conversation with her mother; life is moving toward a new stage.

events.name: A light morning walk in the park
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, take a light 30-minute walk in Green Lake Park to relieve the bloated feeling from days of rich food and breathe fresh air.

events.name: Send out the submission for 'Slow Travel Notes'.
events.description: In the morning, she took three large envelopes containing manuscript drafts and submission letters to the Renmin Middle Road Post Office and sent them to three publishing houses by registered mail. She recorded the mailing date and tracking number for each publisher, and felt a sense of relief when it was done.

events.name: Final session and completion of the watercolor course
events.description: In the final session of the evening watercolor class, I chose a corner of Green Lake as the graduation project. Using the wet-on-wet technique, dry layering, masking fluid, and line-drawing combination techniques learned over eight weeks, I completed an A5 watercolor landscape. I pasted the work into my journal with a summary, marking the official completion of the course.

events.name: Evening walk and conversation with her mother
events.description: In the evening, she accompanied her mother on a walk around the neighborhood, sharing the sense of accomplishment from completing the watercolor class. Her mother talked about amusing stories from learning to paint in her youth, and the two agreed to go watercolor sketching together on weekends from then on.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the manuscript submission.

end_state.mood: Relaxed, sense of accomplishment

state.daily_exercise: Take a 30-minute walk

2025-10.daily_overview: Daily English reading aloud started the new day. In the morning, I handled the follow-up on my submission; in the evening, I took a walk with my father around Green Lake and had a heart-to-heart talk, feeling the warmth and support of my family.

events.name: Morning English reading aloud
events.description: At 7:00 a.m., continued reading 'Walden' aloud and created a new vocabulary page in the journal.

events.name: Updating the submission tracking table and sending emails.
events.description: In the morning, at my workstation in Mingyuan Book House, I opened the submission tracking sheet, recorded the information of the three publishers I sent submissions to yesterday, and also emailed my advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, to report the progress on the manuscript, attaching the finalized table of contents and asking for guidance.

events.name: Evening walk and heart-to-heart talk with father at Green Lake
events.description: At 6 p.m., she walked with her father from home to Green Lake Park, strolling slowly along the path. Her father shared amusing stories from his days at the Cultural Bureau, then on a bench asked in detail about her recent submission progress and writing blocks, encouraging her to keep writing. The nearly hour-long heart-to-heart talk warmed Yuwei's heart.

end_state.mood: Warm and touching

2025-10.daily_overview: Overjoyed to learn that she passed the flower arrangement assessment and received the paper certificate. She photographed withered lotus leaves in the rain, began writing the essay 'Wrinkles Under the Shutter,' and in the evening posted on Xiaohongshu to share her joy. Life is full of small blessings.

events.name: Photographing Withered Lotuses at Green Lake in the Rain
events.description: In the morning, while the rain had lightened, Sun Yuwei took her macro lens and phone to Green Lake. In the pavilion, she took close-up shots of rain beating against withered lotus leaves, and used her phone's slow-motion mode to record the raindrops falling. After about 50 minutes of shooting, she returned.

events.name: Received the paper certificate of qualification for flower arrangement
events.description: When she returned home in the morning, she received at the door the paper certificate of qualification from the Ikenobo Ikebana branch, delivered by courier. After reading it carefully, she confirmed that she had passed the assessment and felt delighted.

events.name: Share the joy with Su Man
events.description: At noon, she sent a photo of her certificate to Su Man, her flower-arranging companion, via WeChat, sharing her joy in a voice message. Su Man congratulated her and they agreed to celebrate at their next practice session.

events.name: Brainstorming the essay "Wrinkles Under the Shutter"
events.description: In the afternoon, she went through the emotional notes from the family photo session and the old stories her parents had told, and settled on the essay theme: using family images as a thread to explore time and memory. She then listed an outline for the essay.

events.name: Organize watercolor class works and post a recap.
events.description: In the evening, she organized all the practice works and journal records from the eight-week watercolor course, used page protectors for the most satisfying pieces, added annotations to the journal, wrote an 800-character study review, and posted it with photos of the works on Xiaohongshu under the account “Yuwei’s Slow Notes” to commemorate the learning journey.

events.name: Posted an update on Xiaohongshu to share the joy of the certificate
events.description: In the evening, after finishing the review of her watercolor class, Sun Yuwei took a few photos of her physical ikebana certificate and posted them on Xiaohongshu, on her account 'Yuwei Slow Notes,' with the short caption 'Little joy: passed the ikebana assessment, certificate in hand!' as an immediate share after receiving the certificate.

events.name: A new watercolor attempt: Rainy Lotus
events.description: In the evening, inspiration surged, so I quickly completed a small painting of lotus in the rain using the wet-on-wet technique. The colors were fresh and elegant, and I felt I had improved.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired, but looking forward to the day's schedule

end_state.mood: Joyful and fulfilled

2025-10.daily_overview: Picked up the newly framed family portrait, wrote the first draft of the essay in one go, and the evening writing group's peer review was fruitful.

events.name: Morning English reading aloud
events.description: At 7:00 a.m., continued the daily English reading of Walden and recorded newly learned expressions.

events.name: Writing the first draft of the essay 'Wrinkles Under the Shutter'
events.description: In the morning, I worked on my writing in the study following the outline, focusing on the atmosphere at the family portrait photo session, the details of my parents' old photos from their youth, and the emotions involved, completing a first draft of about 2,000 words.

events.name: Watercolor Creation: Green Lake · Spring
events.description: During a break in creation, referring to the spring photos of Cuihu on her phone, she painted the fresh green weeping willows and the first blooming cherry blossoms in watercolor, trying to blend the reflections on the lake and the outline of the Western Hills. She inscribed the poem "Willow mist lightly veils the Cuihu embankment, spring water newborn mirrors the flowering branches" as the first piece in the "Four Seasons of Cuihu" series.

events.name: Pick up the family portrait and hang it
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to the photo studio to pick up the finely retouched enlarged family portrait and the additional small prints. After returning home, she and her father hung the 40-inch framed photo on the wall behind the sofa in the living room. Her mother was very pleased and studied it for a long time. Sun Yuwei took photos of the small prints and sent them to her older sister, Sun Yutong.

events.name: Peer review of works in the writing group
events.description: On Saturday evening, she attended the third writing group activity at Mingyuan Book House, submitted a new prose excerpt. Group members Lin Lu and Zhang Fan gave pertinent suggestions, and she took careful notes. After the activity, she chatted privately with Lin Lu about poetic techniques in prose language, and felt integrated into the group.

events.name: Eating a late-night snack after the group session
events.description: After the activity, she went with a few group members to a nearby snack shop for grilled tofu and rice noodles. They chatted happily, and she got home a little late.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and encouraged

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-10.daily_overview: Received recognition at the editor meeting; finalized and sent the essay; started a new field of financial learning; advanced the watercolor series.

events.name: Revise the essay and send it to the editor.
events.description: In the morning, she revised the first draft of "Wrinkles Under the Shutter" multiple times, adjusted the rhythm and emotional expression, and produced the final version. She sent it via WeChat to Xu Mingyuan, editor of "Cultural Horizon", along with a note on the creative process, and discussed whether it could be included in the supplement to "Slow Travel Notes".

events.name: Meet with publishing house editor Zhou Mingyuan
events.description: At 2 p.m., met with Zhou Mingyuan, an editor at Yunling Culture Press, at Slow Time Café on Wenlin Street. Zhou flipped through the manuscript, praised the text for its spark, explained that the topic selection meetings are held quarterly, and suggested submitting it to next spring's topic selection meeting. Sun Yuwei understood and agreed, and they discussed the manuscript idea for nearly an hour.

events.name: Creating the watercolor 'Green Lake · Summer'.
events.description: After the meeting, she went home and continued the watercolor series, depicting the summer lotus pond at Cuihu Lake: layered lotus leaves with lotus flowers standing tall, accented by a few red dragonflies. She inscribed a poem: “Green lotus sways as a gentle breeze rises; a dragonfly alights on the lotus blossom's head.”

events.name: Video chat with cousin Shen Wei to discuss financial management.
events.description: At 8 p.m., I had a video call with my cousin Shen Wei in Hangzhou. She suggested using some of the idle manuscript fee money to try regular investing in index funds and recommended “The Index Fund Investment Guide.” Yuwei listened carefully, noted key points, and decided to start learning.

events.name: Search for personal finance books and take notes.
events.description: Right after the call, she searched for "The Index Fund Investment Guide" in her mobile reading app. After browsing the description and reviews, she thought it was suitable for beginners and decided to buy it the next day. She wrote down the key points of her cousin's advice in her journal.

events.name: Nervous stomachache before the meeting
events.description: Before leaving in the morning, she felt slightly nervous about meeting the publishing house editor for the first time and had mild stomach discomfort. Warm honey water relieved it a bit, and she joked to herself that her mindset still needed training.

end_state.mood: Excited and full of new ideas

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-10.daily_overview: Start systematic financial learning, complete the Green Lake photo shoot, and celebrate the smooth manuscript submission with my family in the evening. Life feels joyful and fulfilling.

events.name: Completed the final photo shoot of the withered lotus at Green Lake.
events.description: In the morning, she went to Green Lake for the last photo session of withered lotus. She captured close-ups of lotus seed pods and broken lotus stems, used the reflections on the water to create mirror effects, and recorded compositions of withered lotus, weeping willows, and a stone bridge near the Nine-Bend Bridge. After shooting for one hour, she used a voice recorder to capture ambient sounds as source material.

events.name: Make a personal finance study plan
events.description: In the morning, she took out the purchased “The Index Fund Investment Guide” in the study and, after browsing the table of contents, made a daily study plan of two chapters a day: read every day and make one page of journal notes. She also planned to consult her neighbor Auntie Xie about the details of opening a fund account.

events.name: Send an email to advisor Wu Mingyuan
events.description: Compiled the editorial feedback and revision ideas for “Slow Travel Notes” into an email and sent it to her advisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, hoping for his guidance.

events.name: Read one to two chapters of a personal finance book
events.description: In the afternoon, systematically read the first two chapters of The Index Fund Investment Guide, learning the basic concepts, common types, and characteristics of index funds, taking excerpts and drawing a mind map while reading, and completing the first page of study notes.

events.name: Reading Chapters 7 to 9 of the personal finance book.
events.description: In the afternoon, she continued reading chapters 7 to 9 of 'The Index Fund Investment Guide', studying in depth the valuation methods of index funds, regular investment strategies, and the characteristics of industry indices. She took notes while reading and completed the second page of study notes.

events.name: Posted an update on Xiaohongshu.
events.description: In the evening, I photographed today's Green Lake photos and personal finance study notes, and posted an update on my Xiaohongshu account "Yuwei's Slow Notes" with the caption "Autumn, Books and Nature."

events.name: Family celebration dinner
events.description: To celebrate the smooth submission of the manuscript and her recent creative breakthrough, in the evening Sun Yuwei invited her parents to the mushroom hot pot restaurant she often goes to. She ordered a few extra kinds of mushrooms and flower cakes. The three chatted enthusiastically in a lively atmosphere, and Sun Yuwei ate quite a lot.

events.name: Tidying the desk and painting the watercolor 'Green Lake · Autumn'
events.description: Before bed, quickly tidy the scattered stationery on the desk, then complete the watercolor Cuihu Lake · Autumn, depicting the ginkgo path and plane-tree leaves in warm golden tones, with the poem: "Ginkgo leaves fall, the ground is gold; autumn Cuihu Lake reflects the clear sky."

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied

2025-10.daily_overview: Completed the 'Four Seasons of Green Lake' watercolor series, deepened practical financial learning, learned from neighbor Aunt Xie's investment experience, and actively increased physical activity to control weight.

events.name: Completed the watercolor “Green Lake · Winter” and the series.
events.description: In the morning, I created the last watercolor: Green Lake in winter, withered branches, rime ice, thin ice on the lake surface, and a few black-headed gulls resting. I inscribed the poem 'The winter lake is quiet, jackdaws stand; rime ice glitters in the morning light.' I placed the four postcard-size paintings in small white frames, arranged them on the bookshelf in spring, summer, autumn, and winter order, took a photo, and posted it on Moments to get likes.

events.name: Read three to four chapters of a personal finance book
events.description: In the afternoon, I studied chapters 3 and 4 of "The Index Fund Investment Guide," focusing on regular investment strategies and fund selection methods, and made the second page of notes.

events.name: Consulted neighbor Xie Xiulan about opening a fund account
events.description: After reading, she knocked on Aunt Xie Xiulan's door across the hallway to consult about bank selection, procedures, and considerations for opening a fund account. Based on her own experience, Aunt Xie suggested choosing a major bank and enabling online banking; Yuwei took careful notes.

events.name: Accompanying my mother to the wet market and walking.
events.description: In the evening, I voluntarily accompanied my mother to a farther vegetable market to buy groceries. We walked nearly one hour round trip, chatting about daily trivia along the way, increasing physical activity to burn off extra calories.

events.name: Preparation for floral design at the yoga studio.
events.description: In the evening, to fulfill her duties as the resident florist at Jingxin Yoga Lifestyle Studio, she conceived next week's floral design theme, drew a sketch, and sent it to He Lu for feedback.

2025-10.daily_overview: Milestone day: got driver's license, yoga headstand breakthrough, watercolor consignment confirmed, joy of multiple achievements at once.

events.name: Morning English reading aloud and light stretching.
events.description: Got up at 6:45 in the morning, first read aloud from Walden for 15 minutes, then did some simple stretching to prepare for the Subject 3 driving test.

events.name: Last morning photo shoot of the withered lotus at Green Lake.
events.description: Later in the morning after the exam, Sun Yuwei went to Green Lake for her final morning shoot of withered lotus. She photographed the crisp silhouettes of dried lotus in the sunlight, the dense lotus forest, and water birds skimming across the lake, and used a voice recorder to capture the ambient sounds. When she finished, she sat on a bench and reviewed the entire photography series.

events.name: Passed the Subject 3 driving test and received the driver's license.
events.description: In the morning, accompanied by the driving school instructor, I went to the Subject 3 exam site in Wuhua District and drew Route 1. Throughout the test, my operation was standard: a smooth start, seamless gear changes, and precise pull-over parking. The examiner announced I passed, and I received the electronic score report on the spot. After waiting an hour, I picked up the C1 manual transmission driver's license, took a photo, and posted to Moments: 'Only when the steering wheel is in your own hands do you understand what freedom means.' Then I immediately called my mother to share the good news.

events.name: Taking the watercolor work "Four Seasons of Cuihu" to Mingyuan Bookstore for consignment
events.description: In the afternoon, she brought the framed series of four watercolors, 'Four Seasons of Green Lake', to Mingyuan Bookstore, discussed consignment with the owner Qin Mingyuan, agreed to price each painting at 15 yuan, set up a dedicated display area on the bookstore's cultural creative shelf, and reached a cooperation.

events.name: Yoga class: headstand breakthrough
events.description: In the evening, she rode a shared bike to Jingxin Yoga Life Studio. During the class, under He Lu's guidance, she tried a headstand away from the wall. The first two attempts failed; on the third, she successfully held it for five seconds. After class, He Lu praised her and encouraged her to try a slow lift next time. Yuwei's confidence grew greatly.

events.name: Received and replied to the advisor's email
events.description: In the evening, she returned home and checked her email, and found a reply from her advisor Professor Wu Mingyuan, who affirmed the progress of the manuscript and offered suggestions for structural adjustments and a bibliography. Deeply inspired, she immediately replied with thanks, saying she now had a clearer direction.

end_state.mood: Extreme joy and contentment

She used the morning light to photograph the lake and autumn leaves, felt the quiet of the early morning, and gathered material for her photography series. She also looked for autumn color inspiration for the Xishan series.

events.name: Learning about index funds.

She organized the core concepts into charts, completed the third page of handwritten notes, and marked her personal understanding and questions.

events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei brought the finished 'Four Seasons of Cuihu' watercolor postcard series to Mingyuan Bookstore to discuss consignment with the owner, Qin Mingyuan. She handed the stack of postcards to Qin Mingyuan, and together they picked a display area beside the bookshelf. She arranged the postcards neatly and put price tags on them. Qin Mingyuan said he would recommend them to customers, and they agreed that Sun Yuwei could come by regularly to check on sales.

events.name: Evening photo sorting and journaling
events.description: At home in the evening, Sun Yuwei imported the photos taken in the early morning into her computer for preliminary sorting, marking ten photos with fairly good composition. Then she wrote in her journal about the day's photography reflections and drew a sketch to record the morning scene of Green Lake.

events.name: Green Lake walk and meditation before bed.
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei accompanied her parents for a 40-minute walk in Cuihu Park, exchanging news of the day. Before bed, she did a 10-minute body-scan meditation, finishing at 23:20 and falling asleep at 23:30.

start_state.mood: The quiet of the early morning

end_state.mood: Content and fulfilled.

In the evening, she had dinner with her parents to celebrate her recent achievements. After dinner, she went for a walk and asked for financial advice. At night, she organized her photographs and wrote in her journal. Before bed, she meditated in gratitude. It was a fulfilling and grateful day.

events.name: Photography at the Western Hills in the early morning.

events.name: Family celebration dinner

events.name: A walk around the neighborhood after a meal.

events.name: Ask Xie Xiulan for advice on managing finances.

events.name: Gratitude meditation before bed
events.description: Around 23:00, Sun Yuwei meditated in her bedroom for 10 minutes, feeling grateful for how smoothly the day had gone and for her family's support, and fell asleep at 23:20.

In the evening she organized her notes and took a meditative walk after dinner.

events.name: Morning cross-training and yoga stretching
events.description: After getting up at 7 a.m., I first did 30 minutes of interval brisk walking along the Panlong River (pace about 9 min/km). After returning home, I did a 20-minute gentle yoga stretching routine to wake up my body. Then I read English aloud for 30 minutes.

events.name: Studied Chapters 7 to 9 of index funds.
events.description: In the morning, in the study, I read Chapters 7 to 9 of The Index Fund Investment Guide and organized two pages of notes on the 'Four-Step Dollar-Cost Averaging Plan' and the 'Risk Control Checklist'.

events.name: Writing group regular gathering and theme sharing
events.description: At 2 p.m., she went to Mingyuan Bookstore for the 'Ink and Breath' writing group gathering. She shared the editor's feedback on 'Record of Slow Travel,' and the group members discussed structure and pacing for 90 minutes. Then came the themed sharing session on 'creative blocks and breakthroughs.' She candidly admitted that her perfectionism caused procrastination, and she was encouraged. New member Li Meng proactively added her on WeChat.

events.name: Organizing writing notes in the evening
events.description: After dinner, in the study, organized the day's key points into the journal, listing a revision checklist for Slow Travel Notes and three small methods for overcoming perfectionism.

events.name: Green Lake walk and meditation before bed.

In the morning, she completed her personal finance study and organized her handwritten notes. In the afternoon, she shopped for ingredients and cooked dinner for a get-together with her college roommate Liu Jia. In the evening, the four roommates had a video call and rekindled their friendship with endless laughter. Late at night, after seeing Liu Jia off, she meditated and went to sleep feeling fulfilled.

events.name: Half-marathon 5 km health run

Started running at 7:00, finished smoothly at a pace of about 7 minutes 48 seconds per kilometer, with a net time of 39 minutes. After crossing the finish line, collected the medal and took a commemorative photo with He Lu.

events.name: Posted a running update and recorded my reflections

events.name: English reading aloud

events.name: Prepare dinner for Liu Jia's visit

events.name: Liu Jia came over and they cooked together.

events.name: Four-person video reunion
events.description: Dinner together at 7:30 pm; at 8:30 pm video-called Zhao Xiaowen and Zhou Lin and chatted for nearly two hours.

events.name: Seeing Liu Jia Off
events.description: At 10:30 p.m., Liu Jia took a taxi back to school, and Sun Yuwei walked her downstairs.

She also finished archiving her financial notes, made progress on a new chapter of her essay collection, and finalized the flower arrangement class plan with the yoga studio. In the evening, she relaxed her body with yoga, and after dinner she went for a walk and meditated, bringing the fulfilling day to an end.

events.name: Second Western Hills Photography Trip

events.name: English reading aloud

events.name: Writing payment received and donation made.

events.name: Journal entry after the donation
events.description: In the journal, write: "What words have given me, I wish to flow back to the bookstore in small ways." Then decorate with bookmark stickers.

events.name: Archiving financial notes and sharing insights

events.name: Writing a prose collection titled "The Scent of Books on Campus."

events.name: Deciding on the flower arrangement trial class

events.name: Evening yoga and walking meditation

Her mother's movements were a bit stiff, and she kept forgetting to pull in her abdomen during Cat-Cow. Qin Mingyuan led her to the quiet staff lounge inside the bookstore and, following her outline, conducted an oral history interview of about 1.5 hours. Boss Qin recalled his original reasons for opening the bookstore, unforgettable stories from running it, and the challenges brick-and-mortar bookstores have faced in recent years, offering rich details. Sun Yuwei took careful notes and recorded the whole session.

events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei sorted and bound the notes from the first two pre-interviews, the key points from the recordings, and the secondhand materials brought back from Mingyuan Bookstore in the study. She opened her computer, created a folder named 'Thesis-Field Data', saved the scanned electronic copies and recording numbers into it, and drafted a preliminary framework PPT outline to report to her advisor.

events.name: Go to Yunnan University for a thesis discussion with advisor Wu Mingyuan.
events.description: At 2:30 p.m., Sun Yuwei took a bus to Professor Wu Mingyuan's office in the School of Literature at Yunnan University, carrying her laptop and notebook. She reported in detail to her supervisor the findings from the preliminary interviews for the Mingyuan Book House project and presented her initial analytical framework. Professor Wu affirmed her solid first-hand materials, but suggested adding interviews with two or three more different readers, and gave specific guidance on deepening the theoretical analysis. The discussion lasted about an hour.

events.name: Organize the advisor's suggestions immediately after returning home
events.description: Upon entering the house, Sun Yuwei went straight to the study, opened her notebook, and used a highlighter to write the two key tasks emphasized by her advisor—“reader perspective” and “theoretical deepening”—at the top of a blank page. She then broke them down into concrete action steps: contacting regular customers, designing reader interview questions, and reviewing literature on community culture theory. She stuck the list next to her computer screen.

events.name: Celebrating father's official retirement.
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., her father Sun Mingyuan came home from work with his retirement certificate and a commemorative fountain pen from his colleagues. Her mother Li Xiulan specially cooked a table of good dishes, including the mushroom hot pot and cold rice noodles that Sun Yuwei loved. Sun Yuwei had prepared flower cakes in advance as dessert. The three sat around the dining table, listening to her father recount more than thirty years of work stories, laughing from time to time. Her father said he would sign up for a calligraphy class at the senior citizens’ university next week.

2025-03.daily_overview: A day of turning my flower arrangement hobby into tangible value exchange. After morning yoga, I discussed floral design with the yoga studio owner in the morning, bought materials at noon, carefully arranged them in the afternoon, and received a quarterly yoga pass in the evening. Reviewing before bed, I felt a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: In mother-daughter yoga, the mother tried Tree Pose and made progress.
events.description: Early morning at 6:30, Sun Yuwei led her mother in practice. Today her mother challenged herself with the balancing pose “Tree Pose.” Although she wobbled at first, under guidance she learned to fix her gaze on a single point and ultimately held the pose independently for 15 seconds. When she finished, her mother was as happy as a child, and Sun Yuwei clapped and cheered her on.

events.name: Communicate flower arrangement design plan at yoga studio
events.description: At 10 a.m., Sun Yuwei arrived at Jingxin Yoga Life Studio as agreed and talked with the owner, He Lu, in the rest area. He Lu wanted to create a corner where people could find inner peace. Sun Yuwei showed her sketch for a "Wabi-sabi · Miniature Landscape" and proposed combining local succulents, deadwood, and old clay pots to create a natural Zen atmosphere. He Lu loved it, and the two agreed on a budget and decided to act that afternoon.

events.name: Purchase succulents and deadwood at Dounan Flower Market.
events.description: At noon, Sun Yuwei took the metro alone to Dounan Flower Market, wandered through the succulent section, and picked out cultivars with similar growing habits such as Fashi, Yulu, and Hongzhiyu. In the materials section, she found twisted dried azalea branches and a bag of pine cones, spending about 200 yuan in total.

events.name: Arranging a floral corner at the yoga studio
events.description: Starting at 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei used the venue's tools to place three old ceramic pots of different sizes on a wooden corner table. She filled them with nutrient soil to secure the succulents, then leaned dry branches diagonally to form a frame, wrapped jute twine around the joints between the branches and the pots, and finally added pinecones and dried moss as decoration. He Lu occasionally helped steady them or stepped back to observe the angle. Three hours later, a miniature landscape full of rustic charm was completed.

events.name: Received a yoga season pass and scheduled follow-up maintenance with He Lu.
events.description: He Lu was full of praise for the final effect and immediately handed over a quarterly yoga pass worth 1,500 yuan. Sun Yuwei happily accepted it and shared key points on flower material care. The two agreed that Sun Yuwei would update the flower arrangement once a month, with the studio covering the cost.

events.name: Attend evening Vinyasa yoga class
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei stayed at the yoga studio and took the Friday flow yoga class. She felt especially energetic after finishing the flower arrangements, and her asanas were performed to a high standard. After class, she did a 5-minute meditation.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and reflection
events.description: Before bed, I meditated for 10 minutes, reviewed the day's experiences, and fell asleep feeling content.

In the afternoon, she dropped by Mingyuan Bookstore and met book lover Yang Fan. In the evening, she made journal spreads at home to plan next week's tasks.

events.name: Mother-daughter yoga introduces Warrior I pose.
events.description: During morning yoga, Sun Yuwei introduced the new pose "Warrior I." Her mother felt soreness in her leg muscles but persisted to the end. Sun Yuwei played the light music "Morning Light" on her phone, and the two breathed in sync with the music. Although the movements were not perfect, a tacit understanding gradually grew.

events.name: Polish the prose draft 'The Vigil Behind the Glass'
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei sat down in the study, opened the document, and carefully revised the essay "Vigil Behind the Glass" paragraph by paragraph. She repeatedly adjusted the emotional tone of the opening and the metaphor at the end, and kept the length to around 2,500 characters. After reading it through once and confirming that it conveyed what she had in mind, she saved the final draft.

events.name: Go to Mingyuan Bookstore to relax and meet new book friends.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Sun Yuwei went to Mingyuan Bookstore to sit around, ordered a cup of Pu'er tea, and flipped through the newly arrived literary magazines. As it happened, a fellow book lover, Yang Fan, also came to browse for books. They had exchanged messages in an online community before, so they naturally sat down and had a deep conversation. Yang Fan shared his views on writing about local culture and recommended several books about urban memory.

events.name: Evening journal: planning next week's creative tasks
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei opened her journal and used colored pens to draw a timeline for the coming week: Monday as the day for designing reader interviews for her thesis, Tuesday as the day for column fieldwork, and Wednesday through Friday for writing the first chapter of the thesis. In the blank space next to it, she stuck the booklist sticky note that Yang Fan had mentioned.

events.description: Before bed, do a 15-minute meditation to let the swirling ideas and plans settle, and fall asleep peacefully.

In the afternoon she picked carnations, shared a Yunnan specialty dinner with her mother, and expressed gratitude in person. In the evening she shared the good news with her close friends' group chat.

events.name: The mother-daughter yoga practice went smoothly, and they developed a natural rapport.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, after a week of practice, the mother and daughter were able to coordinate their breathing smoothly without much communication. Today they practiced the full Sun Salutation A sequence, and the mother’s movements were noticeably smoother—at one point she even closed her eyes to feel the stretch in her body. When they finished, the two smiled at each other, and her mother said with feeling, “So persistence really does pay off.”

events.name: Submitted an essay to "Southwest Literature" and quickly received a reply from the editor.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Sun Yuwei emailed 'The Vigil Behind the Glass' to the submission address of Southwest Literature, along with a brief personal introduction. To her surprise, she received a short reply from the editor at noon: 'Manuscript read; it is delicate and sincere. It is planned for the next issue's column. Please do not submit elsewhere.' She gave a little cheer of surprise and immediately sent a screenshot of the good news to the family WeChat group.

events.name: Go to the flower shop to buy flowers for Women’s Day
events.description: At 4 p.m., Sun Yuwei walked to a flower shop near her home, chose a bouquet of pink carnations still in bud, and asked the shopkeeper to wrap them simply in light purple wrapping paper. She planned to give them to her mother at dinner.

events.name: Had a festive dinner with my mother at Shuncheng Shopping Center
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, mother and daughter sat down at a Yunnan restaurant in Shuncheng Shopping Center. Sun Yuwei ordered a pot of mushroom hotpot, two servings of crossing-the-bridge rice noodles, and two glasses of tamarind juice. As they cooked the mushrooms, they chatted about Sun Yuwei's childhood love of mushrooms, the conversation light and warm.

events.name: Giving flowers and expressing emotions during dinner
events.description: Midway through the meal, Sun Yuwei took out a bouquet from beside her and handed it to her mother with both hands, saying softly, "Mom, happy holiday, thank you for always supporting my writing." Li Xiulan's eyes reddened slightly; she held her daughter's hand and said, "You have always been my pride." Guests at nearby tables cast kind glances.

events.name: In the evening, shared the good news about the submission in the close friends' group chat
events.description: After returning home and washing up, Sun Yuwei curled up in bed and shared the news that her essay had been accepted in the WeChat group "Yuwei and Besties." Zhang Jing sent a string of amazed emojis, Chen Sisi said they must celebrate at the next gathering, and Wang Xinran joked that she would want a signed book in the future. They chatted for half an hour before she closed her eyes.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation
events.description: Did a 10-minute meditation before bed to release the excitement of the day and gradually settle into peaceful sleep.

events.description: At a little past 2 p.m., Sun Yuwei was surprised to find a private message in her Xiaohongshu inbox from "Shanghai Qingniao Publishing House – Zhang Qiming," who praised the street-level narrative perspective of her work and asked whether she was interested in expanding it into a book. She suppressed her excitement, replied politely, and gave her WeChat ID. After checking, Sun Yuwei decided to take the Mandarin Proficiency Test in May to systematically improve her pronunciation, and made a long-term plan of reading aloud for 20 minutes every morning until the exam. She then ordered the Mandarin Proficiency Test Guidebook and a voice recorder online.

events.name: Starting the first chapter of the thesis and going on a wet market field trip for the column
events.description: At 9 a.m., Sun Yuwei opened a document in her study and began writing the first section of the first chapter of her graduation thesis, 'The Spatial Formation and Community Embeddedness of Independent Bookstores in Kunming.' After writing about 800 characters, she felt slightly stuck and went out before noon to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market to gather material. She photographed spring vegetable stalls, a seasoning shop, and elderly people buying groceries, briefly talked with two stall owners, and collected vivid colloquial material.

events.name: Continue writing the thesis in the afternoon and note down points that still need to be added.
events.description: After returning home from the vegetable market, she had a simple lunch and went back to the study to continue writing. By 5 p.m., the first chapter's draft had accumulated to about 2,000 words. She read it through and used comments in the electronic document to mark five passages that needed follow-up data lookup or further analysis.

events.name: Signed for the Mandarin textbook and made a morning reading plan.
events.description: At 6 p.m., the courier delivered the Putonghua Proficiency Test Guide and a voice recorder. After opening the package, Sun Yuwei opened the textbook and, based on the table of contents, planned a daily morning reading schedule from tomorrow (March 12) until the exam: from 7:00 to 7:20 a.m., she would read monosyllabic words aloud for 10 minutes and short passages for 10 minutes on the balcony. She put the plan on the cover of the textbook. At the top of the plan, she wrote 'Test in May, aim for Grade 2A,' and pasted it on the monthly planning page of the journal as a daily reminder.

She planned to give them to Zhang Jing, Chen Sisi, and Zhou Lin.

events.name: Proofreading the final draft of the prose collection

She answered most questions quickly and read uncertain questions carefully, ultimately passing with a score of 98, printing the score report and signing it.

events.name: Bedtime meditation

end_state.mood: Excited

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Excited about the writing commission, she still maintained 10 minutes of meditation, focusing on her breathing to calm her mind.

She recorded the light, the crowds, and her memories, and wrote several pages of observation notes on a bench.

She got in the car and tried; on the first attempt she turned the wheel too late, and on the second attempt she adjusted and parked successfully. The instructor commented that she “has a knack for it.” After practicing for an hour and a half, she left.

events.name: Rushing to yoga class.
events.description: After driving practice, I hurried to the yoga studio and was 10 minutes late, but still completed most of the vinyasa flow poses and held a headstand for 40 seconds.

Building on the basic hand-feel practice from the day before yesterday, today she tried drawing a set of decorative lines with varying thickness, mimicking the curling feel of vines. This was the first small asset she designed for her journal.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: 10 minutes of meditation before bed, body scan to relax leg muscles.

end_state.mood: A little tired but fulfilled
