2025-09.daily_overview: On Friday, I did an in-depth exploration of the old street in the morning, wrote and organized my notes in the afternoon, and had a candid debate with my mother about writing topics in the evening. We eventually reached an understanding, and I ended the day with drawing tablet practice, feeling clear-minded.

events.name: Kunming Old Street excursion for inspiration
events.description: In the morning, she went to Wenming Street and Qianwang Street, walked through the flagstone-paved lanes, visited old teahouses and traditional handicraft shops, chatted with an old woman selling tofu pudding, recorded stories of change told orally, and had lunch at a time-honored rice noodle shop.

events.name: Organize the field notes and do initial writing.
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, she organized the morning's notes and recordings into an electronic document and, based on this material, wrote a passage of prose depicting the afternoon light and shadows of the old street, about 800 words.

events.name: Mother suggested shifting the writing topic.
events.description: After dinner, her mother Li Xiulan brought up in the living room that Yuwei's writing could take on weightier themes, and suggested trying serious historical and cultural subjects, which triggered a conversation.

events.name: A mother-daughter debate about writing topics
events.description: Around the mother's proposal, the two engaged in a two-hour-long debate. The mother insisted that historical subjects carry more weight, while Yuwei insisted that writing about the breath of everyday city life is equally valuable. Each stated their own views, and the atmosphere was spirited but respectful.

events.name: Mother understood and gave in.
events.description: After the debate, her mother finally said, "Your pen, your decision," expressing respect for her daughter's choice. Yuwei felt deeply understood, the mother-daughter relationship became closer, and her mother promised to learn more about the field she writes in.

events.name: Advanced line practice on the drawing tablet.
events.description: After the debate, she continued practicing on the drawing tablet in the study, focusing on smooth long lines and pressure sensitivity variations under different brush presets, while noting down questions about the operations for future reference. The practice lasted about an hour.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Despite emotional fluctuations, she still stuck to 10 minutes of meditation, calmed her mood with breathing, and went to sleep later than usual.

end_state.mood: Moved and clear-headed.

state.daily_exercise: Considerable walking

2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, she signed up for an offline writing group to expand her creative social circle and spent the whole day immersed in the first draft of a long prose piece. Although she hit bottlenecks, she persisted and completed most of it. The digital journal design brought small joys.

events.name: Discovered a writing group and signed up.
events.description: In the morning, she saw a recruitment post for the 'Ink and Breath' writing group on Douban City, was drawn to its sincere writing philosophy, clicked the sign-up link and carefully filled in the information. After submitting, it showed that the application was under review, and she felt full of anticipation.

events.name: Wrote the first draft of a long-form essay all day.
events.description: After registering, she turned off phone notifications in her study and devoted herself to writing “Kunming, Kunming.” Following a time thread, she wrote from the morning at Green Lake to the old streets at dusk, with delicate brushwork. She completed about 4,000 characters in the afternoon, but got stuck at the ending and decided to continue the next day.

events.name: Browsing Xiaohongshu during lunch and a break
events.description: During her lunch break, she ate a flower cake while browsing Xiaohongshu. Seeing that her previously posted watercolor works had received many likes, she felt delighted and replied to a few comments.

events.name: Chatting with Wang Xinran on WeChat
events.description: During a break from writing, she video-called her close friend Wang Xinran in Shenzhen on WeChat to share about signing up for a writing group. Wang Xinran encouraged her to take part in more offline social activities and also shared information about a cultural lecture at her company.

events.name: Designing tiny geometric flowers on a graphics tablet.
events.description: In the evening, she used Illustrator to design a simple geometric flower: starting from a basic circle, adjusting anchor points and Bezier curves, trying pink gradient petals, and exporting it as a transparent-background PNG for later use, laying the groundwork for journal stickers.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: 10 minutes of meditation to relieve writing fatigue.

end_state.mood: A little tired but satisfied.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, I went hiking in the early morning to get close to nature, a cleansing experience for body and mind; in the afternoon, I completed the first draft of a long essay, which was very rewarding; designing the digital journal added fun, and the meditation habit is beginning to show results.

events.name: Prepare and set off for a hike in the Western Hills
events.description: Got up at 6:00 a.m., checked the sneakers, backpack, water bottle, and mirrorless camera, brought some snacks, left home at 6:30 by bus to the Maomaoqing trailhead of the Western Hills, arrived at 7:30 and started climbing.

events.name: Mountain hiking and photography
events.description: Hiking along the Maomaoqing route, she used her mirrorless camera to capture autumn leaves, wildflowers, and distant views of Dianchi Lake. She stopped many times to adjust angles and feel the vegetation changes brought by altitude, and it took about 2 hours to reach Taihua Temple.

events.name: Meditation at Taihua Temple
events.description: I sat down in a quiet corner of Taihua Temple, closed my eyes, and meditated for half an hour, focusing on the mountain breeze and birdsong, relaxing both body and mind.

events.name: Go down the mountain and organize the photos
events.description: At 10:30, I went back down the mountain along the same path, continuing to record views from different angles. I returned to the foot of the mountain before noon and took a car home. After getting home, I imported the photos into my computer, sorted through them, and saved the ones I was satisfied with.

events.name: Decided to add weekly aerobic exercise.
events.description: Based on her hiking experience, she decided to add one more aerobic exercise session, such as a morning run or jump rope, each week starting next week, and wrote the plan in her journal.

events.name: Complete the first draft of the long essay and polish it.
events.description: Starting at 2 p.m., she continued writing 'Kunming, Kunming,' weaving the old-street material into the latter half, and completed an 8,000-word first draft. She then spent two hours reading it through and polishing, cutting redundancy and ensuring emotional coherence, before exporting the final draft as a document.

events.name: Designing cloud stickers with a graphics tablet
events.description: In the evening, she used her graphics tablet in Illustrator to combine ellipses into a cloud shape, added a flowing tail and a slight shadow, and designed a cute cloud sticker.

events.name: Record a week of meditation reflections
events.description: During the day, she recorded in her journal her feelings after 7 consecutive days of meditation: falling asleep faster, reduced daytime anxiety, satisfaction with the positive effects of the meditation habit, and a decision to keep going.

end_state.mood: A great sense of accomplishment

state.daily_exercise: Hiking up the mountain for about 3 hours

events.name: Bedtime meditation and relaxation

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the reply after submitting the manuscript

end_state.mood: Excited and relaxed.

At night, designed petal vector stickers and tried creating digital journal materials. The overall pace was steady, balancing exercise and creative work.

events.name: Morning flower arrangement practice
events.description: After getting up at 6:50, Sun Yuwei practiced the basic slanting style of Ikenobo flower arrangement at the workbench on the balcony. Using the dry branches and small chrysanthemums she bought the previous day, she repeatedly adjusted the angle of the main branch while referencing her notebook, for about 40 minutes.

events.name: Draw a medical insurance comparison table in the journal

With three different colored highlighters, she listed the product names horizontally on the journal, and vertically compared coverage items, deductibles, maximum coverage amounts, renewal terms, and annual premiums. Renewal terms need close attention."

Guided by the instructor, she focused on breathing and alignment, tried the shoulder-stand preparation pose, and kept her core stable. After class, she talked with He Lu about recent writing progress.

Her father nodded approvingly at her independent thinking, while her mother reminded her to pay attention to her diet. The walk lasted about 35 minutes.

events.name: Design petal vector stickers

She patiently adjusted the Bézier curves of each petal, filled them with a pink-to-white gradient, and used a circle of bolded small dots for the stamens. After finishing, she duplicated and rotated it to create a symmetrical version, ready to export as sticker material.

events.name: Bedtime meditation

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and full of anticipation for digital creation

events.name: In the morning, apply online for a million-yuan medical insurance.
events.description: In her study, Sun Yuwei turned on her computer, carefully compared several products, and chose one with an annual premium of about 300 yuan. After confirming that the health disclosure had no issues, she paid the premium, received the successful enrollment text message and e-policy, printed a copy, folded it, and put it in the transparent pocket of her journal.

events.name: Afternoon driving school session
events.description: At 14:00, Sun Yuwei took the bus to the driving school in Wuhua District to continue practicing reverse parking. Under the instructor's guidance, she repeatedly adjusted the steering wheel and finally completed three smooth reversals in a row. Her arms were sore, but her confidence grew.

events.name: At dinner, inform parents about the insurance purchase
events.description: During dinner, Sun Yuwei mentioned that she had bought insurance during the day. Her father nodded in approval, and her mother served her food while reminding her to pay more attention to nutrition. The atmosphere was warm.

events.name: Journal entry recording the social security milestone
events.description: After dinner, Sun Yuwei painted a shield pattern with watercolors on the health management page of her journal, wrote "Protection activated, 2025.9.17," and flipped the insurance policy storage page to the front of the transparent pocket, feeling a sense of relief and peace.

events.name: Bedtime meditation and walk canceled.
events.description: Because I was tired from driving practice in the afternoon, I didn't go for a walk after dinner and instead tidied up at home. At 22:45, I finished a 10-minute meditation, reviewed the insurance details, and felt at ease.

start_state.mood: A bit sleepy, but the task is clear

end_state.mood: Grounded and serene

2025-09.daily_overview: After her early-morning flower arrangement practice, she spent the morning designing an autumn piece using Dounan floral materials; in the afternoon she had her regular yoga class; in the early evening Aunt Xie brought pickled vegetables and she reciprocated with a flower arrangement, and they unexpectedly found they shared a love of literature and chatted happily; in the evening she designed moon-phase stickers, and the neighborly relationship quietly warmed.

events.name: Morning flower arrangement practice
events.description: At 6:50, Sun Yuwei practiced the Ikenobo upright style on the balcony, using a kenzan to secure pine branches and daisies, focusing on proportion and negative space, for about 40 minutes.

events.name: Preparing autumn-themed floral artwork.
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei set up a kenzan on the balcony worktable. She chose a withered branch as the main stem, paired it with three small yellow chrysanthemums and a few red and yellow maple leaves, and finished with gentian accents. Following the Ikenobo slanting style, she completed a work titled "Autumn Sound," intending to give it to Aunt Xie.

events.name: Afternoon yoga class
events.description: At 14:00, Sun Yuwei went to the yoga studio for class. Today's focus was headstand preparation; she could steadily hold a wall-assisted headstand for 30 seconds, showing improved core control. After class, she shared flower arrangement photos with He Lu.

events.name: In the evening, Aunt Xie brought over pickled vegetables, and I gave her floral arrangements in return.
events.description: A little after 6 p.m., neighbor Aunt Xie brought over homemade pickled dried radish. Sun Yuwei gladly accepted it and offered the "Autumn Sounds" flower arrangement in return, which Aunt Xie praised in delighted surprise.

events.name: Chatting about literature with Aunt Xie in the living room.
events.description: Yuwei invited Aunt Xie to sit in the living room and brewed barley tea. During the chat, she learned that Aunt Xie had been a literature enthusiast in her youth and had written essays submitted to local newspapers. Yuwei showed her column articles to Aunt Xie, and the two chatted about everything from Wang Zengqi to old streets in Kunming. Before leaving, they agreed to visit each other often and keep in touch.

events.name: Design moon-phase stickers
events.description: In the evening, Sun Yuwei used AI software to create a series of moon phases from new moon to full moon, adding a layered effect of clouds veiling the moon, and saved it for later.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: At 23:00, Sun Yuwei lit a lavender candle, sat cross-legged to meditate for 10 minutes, recalled moments of warm connection with people, and her heart softened.

end_state.mood: Warm and joyful, fulfilled by new friendships

Her literary exchanges with her neighbor brought a new perspective to her creation.

events.name: Sun Yuwei got up at 06:00 and went to bed at 23:00. That day she weighed 46.8 kg. Exercise included 30 minutes of morning yoga and meditation, and three outdoor walks totaling 105 minutes and 7.2 kilometers, with 13,550 steps for the day. Overall activity was moderate, stress level was low, and sleep quality was good.
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei took a blank journal and knocked on the door across the hall. Aunt Xie brought out several old notebooks. Yuwei carefully turned the yellowed pages, transcribed sentences describing Dianchi Lake and Cuihu Lake, and discussed with Aunt Xie the quoted sentence from Pascal in the text; both were deeply absorbed.

events.name: Afternoon driving school session
events.description: At 13:30, Sun Yuwei went to the driving school to practice curve driving. She controlled the steering wheel according to the instructor's mnemonic phrases, and her speed gradually stabilized. After two hours of practice, her shoulders were sore, but she was one step closer to getting her driver's license.

events.name: Evening self-study of watercolor landscape sketches
events.description: At 20:00, Sun Yuwei set up her easel and played an instructional video to practice 'Distant Mountains and Lake.' She used a large brush to wet the paper and paint the sky, but her water control was still poor and left water marks. Still, she noted the key points and kept trying, finally achieving a hazy effect, which she pasted into her journal.

events.name: Designing star vector stickers.
events.description: After watercolor practice, used the polygon tool to draw gold stars, adjusted the anchor points to make the star points lively, duplicated them in small, medium, and large sizes, arranged them into a starry-sky asset, and exported it.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: At 22:40, Yuwei finished 10 minutes of meditation, visualizing herself by a lakeside, her thoughts rippling with the wind.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and nourished by literature

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning, I wrote the Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles column article and emailed it to the editor, while also preparing the share essay for the evening writing gathering. In the afternoon, I went to the yoga studio to complete the large floral installation “Breath” and received the collaboration fee. In the evening, I attended the “Ink and Breath” writing group gathering at a café, read my work aloud, and received sincere feedback. A day that efficiently intertwined creative writing, craftsmanship, and social interaction.

events.name: Write a column article about Yunnan Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodles
events.description: Sun Yuwei sat in her study. Based on the topic chosen by editor Xu Mingyuan, she consulted materials and recalled the scene of her family sitting together eating rice noodles. She wrote the 2,000-character essay ‘The Landscape in a Bowl of Rice Noodles’ in one sitting, and sent the manuscript to Xu Mingyuan’s email before noon.

events.name: Organizing excerpts from the essay 'Watching from Behind the Glass'
events.description: After lunch, Yuwei opened the document, selected two paragraphs describing the old bookstore window, made slight cuts, printed two paper copies and clipped them into the notebook, and prepared a feedback record page.

events.name: Creating a floral installation for the yoga studio's anniversary celebration
events.description: At 14:30, Sun Yuwei brought her tools and hurried to Jingxin Yoga Life Studio. With He Lu’s assistance, she used four bamboo poles as a frame, suspended baby’s breath above, and arranged daisies and fern leaves in a staggered pattern below, naming it “Breath”. It was hung above the main space, light and flowing, drawing questions from the students.

events.name: Set off to an independent café to attend a writing gathering
events.description: At 17:40, Yuwei changed into a navy blue cotton-linen dress, carried a canvas bag, and took the bus to the independent café in Wuhua District she often went to. On the way, she confirmed the participation list, feeling a little nervous.

events.name: Attend the 'Ink and Breath' writing group gathering
events.description: At 19:00, after the group members introduced themselves, Sun Yuwei was the third to read an excerpt from Watching from Behind the Glass. Her voice was soft but clear. After she finished, the members suggested adding ambient sound description at the beginning and pointed out that the pace of the second section could be slowed down. Yuwei took careful notes and felt that face-to-face feedback was more direct than email, so she proactively added two literary friends on WeChat.

events.name: Return home, sort out the feedback, and record it.
events.description: After arriving home at 21:40, Sun Yuwei spread out her meet-up notes on the desk and marked the three most inspiring points in orange: 'include the old street's morning sounds,' 'adjust the frequency of the glass imagery,' and 'leave more space at the ending.' She wrote in her journal, 'Offline feedback is like a warm mirror,' then wrote the revision directions separately in the margins of the essay draft.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Tonight I deliberately extended the meditation to 12 minutes, focusing on gratitude for all the kindness and advice I received today.

end_state.mood: Excited and grateful, slightly tired.

state.daily_exercise: Floral installation setup (light physical activity).

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning, I prepared for tomorrow's online workshop and thanked the writing group members; then I took part in a city orienteering race with my best friends Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing, running through Kunming's old streets to unlock tasks; in the afternoon, I had tea at an old teahouse and reviewed the day; in the evening, I imported the newly designed stickers into my tablet to try digital journaling. It was a Sunday full of athletic energy and laughter with best friends.

events.name: Preparing for the online workshop
events.description: At breakfast, Sun Yuwei checked the internet, downloaded the cloud meeting software, skimmed the first module of the training outline, set aside a notes section in her journal, and prepared three-color pens.

events.name: Send thank-you messages to writing group members.
events.description: At 9:00, Yuwei sent sincere thanks in the WeChat group 'Ink and Breath', and separately sent the revised paragraph to the two members who had given suggestions, receiving warm replies.

events.name: Participate in a city orienteering race with best friends
events.description: At 9:30, Sun Yuwei met Chen Sisi and Zhang Jing at the Golden Horse and Green Rooster Archway Square and picked up their task booklet. Following clues, they shuttled through Qianwang Street and around Green Lake, completing quirky tasks such as 'buy three flaky buns in a local dialect' and 'find the designated poetry collection in an old bookstore.' The three got lost and ran in the wrong direction, but took selfies and joked around, laughing constantly. They finished the race by 2:00 p.m., with phones full of photos. A 0.5 cm blister formed on the sole of her left foot due to slight chafing from her new shoes (which was later reabsorbed).

events.name: Post-match review meeting at the teahouse
events.description: After the contest, the three of them sat in an old-town teahouse and ordered Pu'er tea and rose pastries. Zhang Jing flipped through photos and said they had taken a detour. Sisi laughed and said they had run into a stall selling sugar figurines. Yuwei leaned back in the rattan chair listening to her best friends' banter, feeling that even the sunshine had a hint of sweetness.

events.name: Importing vector stickers into the tablet for a digital journal.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Sun Yuwei transferred the star and moon phase stickers to her iPad, used GoodNotes to decorate a digital journal themed “September Starry Sky,” took a screenshot, and sent it to Shen Wei for feedback.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: 22:30, Yuwei sat cross-legged on the yoga mat, meditating while recalling the daytime run and her best friend's face, a smile curling at the corners of her mouth.

end_state.mood: Pleasant, with a clear and refreshed feeling after exercise

end_state.mood: Fulfilled, excited by new knowledge.

2025-09.daily_overview: In the morning, continued the workshop session on 'Reader Interaction and Emotional Resonance' and submitted the first writing exercise; in the afternoon, rushed to driving school to practice curve driving; in the evening, attended the regular yoga class; at night, sorted through two days of notes and meditated. events.name: Evening yoga class

2025-09.daily_overview: In the early morning, I hurried to the examination venue and completed the beginner Ikenobo School ikebana exam piece Autumn Sounds using dry branches, gentians, and smoke-tree leaves; I was satisfied with my performance. In the afternoon, I exchanged insights with fellow enthusiast Su Man; in the evening, I attended the local writing group at Mingyuan Bookstore for the first time, expanding my circle of local creators. It was a dual milestone of skill certification and social breakthrough, but the official result still needs to be awaited.

events.name: Set off to take the beginner's flower arrangement exam
events.description: At 6:30, Sun Yuwei carefully checked the kenzan, flower scissors, and conditioned flower materials, and packed them securely into a dedicated bag. She put on an elegant white shirt and dark green wide-leg trousers, had a simple breakfast, and took the bus to the exam venue, silently memorizing the key points of the slanting style structure on the way.

events.name: Complete the ikebana exam piece 'Autumn Sound'.
events.description: Entering the examination room, the theme was “Autumn Sound.” Yuwei chose a thick withered branch as the main branch and inserted it into the left rear of the kenzan. Gentians were placed low in a staggered arrangement, and three smoke tree leaves were positioned—one upward and two drooping. Finally, she tidied the water basin, keeping the water surface clean. The invigilator smiled at her, and she felt somewhat confident, but the official result still required waiting for notification. In her diary, she wrote: No matter the result, the work itself is already the best tribute to autumn. As soon as the 40 minutes were up, she put down her flower shears and let out a soft breath.

events.name: Shared exam insights with Su Man.
events.description: After the exam, Sun Yuwei ran into Su Man at the exit. The two excitedly compared their creative concepts. Su Man praised the dynamic arrangement of Yuwei's smoke tree leaves, while Yuwei praised the vigorous lines of Su Man's dried branches. They asked a passerby to take a photo of the two of them, and agreed to go to the flower market together next month.

events.name: In the evening, attended the Mingyuan Bookstore writing group for the first time.
events.description: At 19:00, led by Uncle Qin, Sun Yuwei walked to the second floor of the book house. The group leader was a freelance writer, and the new members introduced themselves one by one. Yuwei briefly said she was a Chinese literature student and freelance writer, and shared the essay she was working on, Dusk at the Alley, which told of the changes in an old street grocery store. Some of the other members had written local chronicles, and some were newspaper reporters; the atmosphere was friendly and diverse. She carefully wrote down the suggestions about her topic and joined the group's WeChat group.

events.name: After returning home, record notes and meditate.
events.description: It was past 21:30 when she returned to the quiet home. Yuwei stuck small flower stickers in her journal for today's two "firsts." Before ten o'clock, she began meditating and fell asleep feeling satisfied with the exam and looking forward to the new community.

end_state.mood: Slightly nervous anticipation, but satisfied with how I performed

state.daily_exercise: Evening run of 4 km (pace 7:15).

2025-09.daily_overview: In the early morning I ran 3 km along the Panlong River; in the morning I started writing the proposal for *Notes on Slow Travel* and finished the content summary and market analysis in one go; in the afternoon I attended my usual yoga class and tried a headstand, holding it steadily for 1 minute; in the early evening I had a video call with He Lu to review September's running data and make an October plan; after dinner I walked with my parents; at night, on a whim, I went to Snail Livehouse to watch an indie folk performance and bought the album as background music for writing. I went to bed late with inspiration. The month came to a satisfying close in creativity and release.

events.name: Morning run training
events.description: At 6:15, Sun Yuwei changed into her workout gear and went for an easy run along the Panlong River, covering 3 km at a pace of about 7:05, using a metronome to control her cadence. She stretched thoroughly after the run and felt that the muscle definition in her legs was clearer.

events.name: Writing the publishing proposal for "Slow Travel Notes"
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei turned on her computer and, referring to the notes from the previous two days and her mentor’s suggestions, began with an introduction to the content, emphasizing the collection’s quality as a cultural ramble through Kunming and the small towns around it. Then she analyzed the target readers (urban literary young people aged 20–35) and the market for similar books, citing “Rambling Notes on Jiangnan” as a comparison. She finished three pages in one morning, and the outline took shape.

events.name: Afternoon yoga class
events.description: At 14:30, Sun Yuwei attended a Vinyasa yoga class at the yoga studio. Today's challenge was to do a headstand away from the wall. With the coach's protection, she held it steadily for 1 minute for the first time, and her core control and shoulder-back strength were praised by the coach. After class, she discussed the floral design details for the anniversary celebration with He Lu.

events.name: Afternoon: revise and polish the proposal
events.description: After yoga class and returning home, she polished the wording sentence by sentence, checked the data sources, and added a suggestion to 'market via Xiaohongshu and signings at independent bookstores.' She generated a 5-page PDF, saved it to the 'Slow Travel Notes_Publishing Plan' folder, and backed it up to a USB drive.

events.name: Had a video call with He Lu in the evening to review September's running.
events.description: At 18:00, Sun Yuwei had a video call with He Lu. She shared her data for the month: a total of 42 kilometers run, with a longest single run of 4 kilometers. He Lu praised her for keeping it up, and together they planned to maintain three runs a week in October, attempt one 5-kilometer run, and add core strength training every Thursday. Looking at the screenshots of the routes she had run on her phone, Yuwei felt a real sense of accomplishment.

events.name: After dinner, accompany my parents for a walk.
events.description: After dinner at 18:30, the family of three strolled slowly along Cuihu Lake. Sun Yuwei mentioned that she might go to see a performance in the evening, and her mother told her to be careful. The walk lasted about 30 minutes.

events.name: Made a spontaneous decision to watch an indie folk music performance
events.description: At 19:30, while scrolling Weibo, Yuwei saw the Snail Livehouse announcement for tonight 20:30 local indie folk band [Erhai West] special show. Attracted by the demo, she immediately bought a ticket because there were still seats. She changed into jeans and a thin sweater, slung a small bag across her body, told her parents, and scanned the code to ride a shared bike there.

events.name: Watch a folk music performance and buy the album
events.description: Arrived at the Livehouse at 20:20. In the dim space, an acoustic guitar accompanied a love story by Dianchi Lake. Yuwei stood among the crowd, gently swaying, and a few tunes made her eyes well up. At the end, she bought an autographed album from the band and had a brief chat with the lead singer.

events.name: After returning home, listened to music and recorded inspiration
events.description: At 23:00, Yuwei got home, put the album in the CD player, and let the soothing folk music flow into her ears. She wrote down her feelings from the evening in her journal, drew a little guitar, and decided to use one of the songs as background music for her new essay.

events.name: Bedtime meditation
events.description: Despite her excitement, Sun Yuwei still completed a 10-minute meditation, thanked all the creative sparks from today, and then drifted off to sleep.

start_state.mood: Focused, with the excitement before creating

end_state.mood: Inspiration came bursting out; the body was tired but the spirit was joyful.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 3 km (pace 7:05), yoga 60 minutes, walk 30 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: On Labor Day, Sun Yuwei canceled her planned trip to Fuxian Lake and stayed home to focus on revising her thesis. During the day, she took a morning walk and practiced yoga and meditation, and in the evening she had dinner with her parents.

events.name: Family decided to cancel the short trip to Fuxian Lake
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei and her parents sat together in discussion. Because her graduation thesis required major revisions and she was leaving for Hangzhou on May 8, they unanimously decided to cancel the planned May Day self-driving trip to Fuxian Lake. Her father immediately canceled the reserved car through the car rental app, while the homestay room was kept until the summer for further discussion. Although Sun Yuwei felt a little regret, she quickly turned her attention to her studies.

events.name: Revise the first chapter of the thesis.
events.description: She returned to the study, turned on the computer, pulled up her advisor's comments on the first chapter of her graduation thesis, rewrote the theoretical transition in the introduction, and checked each citation one by one. She worked with focus for nearly four hours, getting up only twice to pour water.

events.name: Evening walk and yoga
events.description: In the late afternoon as the sun slanted westward, she power-walked for half an hour in the community garden, then went home, unrolled her yoga mat, and followed a Keep class for a 20-minute basic sequence, focusing on Mountain Pose and Cat-Cow Pose with abdominal breathing to relieve back, shoulder, and neck fatigue from sitting too long.

events.name: Family evening together
events.description: After dinner, she and her parents watched half of a documentary about Yunnan wild mushrooms in the living room and chatted for a while about mushroom topics from their hometown. Before ten o'clock, she returned to her room, opened her Kindle, read a chapter of a novel, then turned off the light and went to bed.

start_state.mood: Slightly regretful, but quickly turned to focus.

end_state.mood: Calm and content

state.daily_exercise: 30-minute walk + 20-minute yoga

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day of the vacation, Sun Yuwei went to Dounan Flower Market with her mother to buy fresh flowers. After returning home, they arranged flowers together to decorate the house. Their floral work won praise from the family and sparked warm interactions in the family group chat.

events.name: Mother and daughter set off for the flower market
events.description: After breakfast, Sun Yuwei and her mother Li Xiulan packed their shopping bags. She specifically brought her mirrorless camera and journal, planning to record what she saw at the flower market. According to the map on her phone, they took Metro Line 2 to Dongfeng Square, transferred to a bus, and headed to Dounan Flower Market in Chenggong District.

events.name: Mother-daughter conversation on the way
events.description: On the subway, her mother talked about how the hydrangeas she planted in her hometown Qujing when she was young were always praised by neighbors. Sun Yuwei shared the 'main, secondary, guest' branch arrangement principle she learned in Ikenobo-style flower arrangement class. The mother and daughter chatted from flowers to modern home aesthetics, in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.name: Carefully selecting floral materials at the flower market.
events.description: In the Dounan main trading hall, they wove through dozens of stalls. Sun Yuwei repeatedly compared how open the peonies were and the color of the eustomas, finally selecting large pink-and-white peonies and light purple eustomas. Her mother suggested on the side, “Adding a bit more eucalyptus leaves will make it more lively,” and she gladly accepted.

events.name: Purchased floral materials and headed back
events.description: After making her selection, she bargained with the flower farmer, paid 70 yuan in cash, and the farmer wrapped the flowers simply in newspaper. Sun Yuwei carefully held the flowers and took the bus and subway home, guarding them like treasures all the way, afraid they would be crushed or deformed.

events.name: Arranging flowers together to decorate the home
events.description: After arriving home, mother and daughter cut the flower stems at an angle by the kitchen sink and removed extra leaves. Following what she had learned in class, Sun Yuwei used peonies as the main branches and lisianthus as the secondary branches, arranging them in two clear glass vases—one on the living room coffee table and the other beside the TV cabinet. Her mother gently rotated the vase to adjust the best viewing angle.

events.name: Desk flower arrangement corner and photo sharing
events.description: She used the leftover small flower materials to set up a mini flower arrangement corner on her desk, took close-up photos from different angles with her phone, and posted them together with the living room piece to the WeChat family group "Sun Family Cottage," with the caption "Spring on Labor Day."

events.name: Warm response in the family group.
events.description: A few minutes later, her elder sister Sun Yutong, far away in Shenzhen, replied, "It feels like the living room is filled with the scent of flowers now," and her mother sent a smiley face. The three had a brief chat about the sister's recent work, and Sun Yuwei took a screenshot of the conversation and saved it to her journal material library.

start_state.location: Dining room at home in Kunming

end_state.mood: Pleasant and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 8,000 steps

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with light rain in the evening.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday, Sun Yuwei organized part of her travel plans at home in the morning. In the afternoon, she went to the cinema alone to watch the literary film Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains, became immersed in it, and after the screening wrote in her journal at a café. In the evening, she returned home to sort out her paper.

events.name: Planning a cultural itinerary for Hangzhou.
events.description: In the morning, she sat in the study, opened a map on her computer, marked places such as Xiaoshu Library, Innocent Times Book Bar, and the Folk Art Museum of the China Academy of Art, and planned a route. She also looked up shared-bike parking spots along West Lake and noted down in her memo app several independent bookstores in alleys she wanted to visit.

events.name: Go to the cinema to watch a movie
events.description: After a simple lunch and a short nap, she took the bus to Kunming Broadway Cinema in the afternoon, picked up her ticket in advance, and bought a cup of lemon tea. She watched director Gu Xiaogang's "Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains" alone in the screening hall. The four-season panorama along the Fuchun River and the slow narrative deeply immersed her; several empty shots reminded her of the liveliness of the flower market the previous day.

events.name: Journaling at a café after the event
events.description: After the movie ended, she sat by the window in the café beside the cinema, ordered a cup of mint tea, took out her journal from her canvas bag, and wrote down the thought that came to her: 'A good film is like a lake, reflecting the ripples in one's own heart.' Then, from memory, she lightly sketched the outline of the canopied boat from the film.

events.name: Revising the paper's literature review in the evening.
events.description: When she got home in the evening, she had a simple dinner with her parents and talked about the visuals of the movie. Afterward, she went to her study and, following the comments in her supervisor's last email, revised the literature review section of the thesis and added several citations from recent journals, working until 11.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and tranquil

state.daily_exercise: Walk to and from the cinema, about 20 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday, Sun Yuwei made final preparations at home for the upcoming trip to Hangzhou, while also making time to read and practice yoga, spending a quiet and fulfilling rest day.

events.name: List and pack travel items
events.description: After breakfast, she checked the travel list she had already made on her phone and packed a yoga mat, two sets of workout clothes, a Kindle, a mirrorless camera, a lightweight notebook, sunglasses, and sunscreen into a 20-inch carry-on suitcase, checking whether it was overweight as she packed.

events.name: Complete online check-in for the flight.
events.description: She used the Umetrip app to check flight information from Kunming to Hangzhou for tomorrow evening at 7:00, chose a window seat, and took a screenshot to send to the family group chat to let them know the departure time. Her mother reminded her to bring a light jacket.

events.name: Reading an essay collection and writing annotations
events.description: After lunch, she curled up on the bean bag in the study and read the essay collection “Here and Now” bought from Boss Qin's bookstore, penciling a few annotations in the margins and especially circling a passage about old-town streets again and again.

events.name: Afternoon yoga stretching.
events.description: At 4 p.m., she unrolled her yoga mat at home and followed a vinyasa flow yoga session on Keep for 40 minutes, focusing on stretching her hips and back to prepare for the flight tomorrow evening. After practice, she rolled up the mat, fastened it with the strap, and put it into the compartment of her suitcase.

events.name: Evening walk with my mother
events.description: After dinner, she and her mother took a half-hour walk in the neighborhood. Her mother talked about her first solo trip to Dali as a young woman, and Sun Yuwei listened intently. After returning home, she did a final check of her documents and charging devices.

start_state.location: Living room of her home in Kunming.

end_state.mood: The peace of mind of being fully prepared

state.daily_exercise: Yoga 40 minutes + walking 30 minutes.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the compensatory rest day, Sun Yuwei spent the entire afternoon sorting through her mother's old photos and making them into a digital album. In the evening, she video-called her sister to discuss the National Day family portrait plan, recalled warm memories, and received her sister's financial support.

events.name: Organized mother's old photos and made a digital photo album
events.description: In the afternoon, Sun Yuwei dug out the family's old photo albums from deep inside the cabinet, sat on the living room floor, and selected photos of her mother from girlhood to recent years one by one. She scanned them with her phone and imported them into a cloud album, created an album titled Mother's Time with categories, and added a few warm subtitles.

events.name: Preliminary concept for a family portrait
events.description: She opened her memo and wrote down the initial idea for the National Day family photo: the style leaning toward Republic of China vintage flair, a budget of about 500 yuan per person, and the shooting location preferably in an old street or a studio with historical ambiance. Then she marked three highly rated vintage studios on Dianping.

events.name: Video-chatted with sister to discuss the family portrait
events.description: At 8 p.m., she had a video call with her sister Sun Yutong in Shenzhen. First she showed the newly created digital photo album, and the sisters scrolled through the photos while recalling childhood fun. Then she explained the family portrait plan in detail. Her sister strongly agreed with the Republic of China style and transferred 500 yuan via WeChat as partial sponsorship, saying with a smile, 'You go scout the way first; I'll check the results on National Day.' The call lasted one and a half hours.

events.name: Keep a journal and set a savings goal
events.description: After hanging up the video call, she took out her TN journal, printed out her sister's transfer record and pasted it in, writing beside it, "National Day Family Photo Fund: received 500 yuan sponsorship from sister," and drew a small family tree in the corner of the page.

start_state.location: Living room of her home in Kunming.

end_state.mood: Warm and touching

state.daily_exercise: Paced around at home, no dedicated exercise

2025-05.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Sun Yuwei spent the morning comparing prices and buying a Kindle, attended a yoga class in the afternoon, and organized e-books and published a shopping guide in the evening, getting her digital reading ready for the trip.

events.name: Comparing prices to buy a Kindle
events.description: After breakfast, she opened JD.com, Tmall, and the Amazon official website in turn to compare prices for the Kindle Paperwhite. In the end, she found a discount in Amazon's student section and placed an order for 788 yuan, saving about 120 yuan compared to regular channels. She saved a screenshot of the order to share.

events.name: Download e-book resources.
events.description: During the rest of the morning, she searched online for classic essays, a guide to Hangzhou's history, and e-book versions of contemporary novels. Using the university library's partner platform, she downloaded more than ten books for free and imported them to the Kindle cloud via email.

events.name: Afternoon yoga class
events.description: After lunch, she took the bus to Serene Mind Yoga Studio for the 2 p.m. vinyasa flow class. The instructor, He Lu, specifically guided her to use props to deepen her forward fold. After class, the two sat down at a nearby tea shop, and He Lu shared links to several vegetarian restaurants in Hangzhou.

events.name: Unbox the Kindle and decorate it
events.description: When she got home in the evening, the Kindle had already been delivered. She unboxed it, turned it on, connected it to her computer via USB, transferred the essay collection and travel guide into the device, then took out the Van Gogh journal stickers she had bought long ago and carefully stuck them on the protective case.

events.name: Publish a Xiaohongshu shopping guide
events.description: Late at night, she took a few unboxing photos of the Kindle at her desk and published a post on Xiaohongshu, writing in detail about the student verification process and price comparisons across platforms, with the caption “Travel companion, let's go.” Soon she received several comments asking about discounts.

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Yoga for 60 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with cloudy intervals, windy in the evening.

2025-05.daily_overview: On departure day, Sun Yuwei organized her yoga gear and packed the last of her luggage in the morning, handled school affairs in the afternoon, and in the evening her parents saw her off at the airport. She flew to Hangzhou, beginning the long-awaited Jiangnan cultural journey.

events.name: Packing yoga gear in the morning.
events.description: In the early morning, she placed a foldable travel yoga mat and two sets of quick-dry sportswear into a small storage bag, and packed them together with a phone holder and sun-protection arm sleeves into the outer pocket of her carry-on suitcase. She then took a brisk 20-minute walk around the neighborhood and did some simple stretching.

events.name: Final check and confirmation.
events.description: After breakfast, she checked the suitcase and backpack against the list: mirrorless camera, laptop, planner, Kindle, a few skincare products, and two sets of everyday clothes, and she brought her ID card and student ID. Then she sent her advisor, Wu Mingyuan, a WeChat message telling him they could discuss the paper remotely at any time during the trip.

events.name: Handle school affairs
events.description: In the morning, she logged into the school's academic affairs system, confirmed the submission window for her graduation thesis, and processed an application to add an elective course. She printed the check-in confirmation for the Hangzhou youth hostel and put it, together with the flight itinerary, into her carry-on folder.

events.name: Parents Seeing Me Off at the Airport and the Flight
events.description: At 5 p.m., her father drove and her mother accompanied her to Changshui Airport. After passing through security, she read Selected Chinese Prose on her Kindle at the boarding gate. The flight took off on time at 7 p.m., and from the plane she looked down at the glittering lights of the city at night.

events.name: Arrived in Hangzhou and checked into a youth hostel.
events.description: She landed at Xiaoshan Airport at around 9:30, took the metro to Xihu District, got off at Longxiangqiao Station, and walked to the youth hostel she had booked. Because her roommate didn't return until late at night, she only gradually fell asleep in the early hours of the morning.

end_state.location: Youth hostel room in West Lake District, Hangzhou
end_state.mood: Novel yet tiring.

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute morning brisk walk

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day in Hangzhou, Sun Yuwei completed her first morning yoga by West Lake at dawn. In the morning, she cycled around West Lake and visited Xiaoshu Library and a book café. In the afternoon, she wrote on a lakeside bench, and in the evening, she sorted through photos.

events.name: Morning Yoga by West Lake
events.description: After tidying up the study, she put on a sun hat and walked along Renmin Middle Road to Zaiye Flower Shop on Qianju Street. She picked up the blue hydrangea bouquet she had reserved yesterday from owner Lin Jing; the blooms were full and lovely. She also selected light purple forget-me-nots and eucalyptus leaves to replace the flowers at home. The owner gave her some flower preservative and told her to spray the hydrangeas with water frequently.

events.name: West Lake cycling.
events.description: After a simple breakfast back at the youth hostel, she rented a shared bicycle and rode along Beishan Street, passing Broken Bridge and Su Causeway. She rode and stopped along the way, using her mirrorless camera to photograph the pleasure boats on the lake and the willow branches on the shore.

events.name: Immersion at Liangzhu Xiaoshu Library
events.description: At about 10 a.m., she took the subway to Liangzhu and visited the Xiaoshu Library designed by Tadao Ando. The massive bookshelves stunned her. She sat in the reading area for over an hour, browsing books on Jiangnan architecture, and bought a souvenir postcard on the first floor.

events.name: Baoshi Mountain Innocent Age Book Bar
events.description: In the afternoon, she walked up Baoshi Mountain, found the Innocent Age Book Bar, ordered a cup of Longjing tea, and sat by the window overlooking West Lake. She opened the essay collection she was carrying and wrote down scattered inspirations in her notebook: “The sandalwood scent in the book bar mixed with the old wood smell makes time feel like a still lake.”

events.name: In the evening, she organized her journal.
events.description: In the evening, after a walk by West Lake, she returned to the youth hostel, took out her TN journal, drew today’s cycling route as a simple map, pasted in the tickets and postcards, and wrote down her impressions of the geometric beauty of the Xiaoxiao Library’s architecture.

end_state.mood: Full of poetic charm

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga for 25 minutes + cycling for about 2 hours

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day in Hangzhou, Sun Yuwei continued her morning yoga. In the morning, she spent an artsy day with travel companion Fang Qing at a cafe in an alley and a bookstore. In the afternoon, she selected a Mother's Day gift and mailed it. In the evening, she had dinner with Fang Qing.

events.name: Morning Yoga by West Lake
events.description: At 6:30, she went to another lakeside platform and practiced Warrior pose and Cat-Cow pose, feeling the moisture in the morning mist. She shot a short video and posted it on Xiaohongshu, receiving many likes from netizens.

events.name: Meet up with Fang Qing and visit independent cafés.
events.description: At 9 o'clock, she met Fang Qing, a travel companion she had gotten to know online for a long time, at the entrance of the youth hostel. The two hit it off immediately. Fang Qing led her into a café hidden in an old house on Shihuqiao Road. Each ordered a pour-over coffee, and they exchanged their journals to share inspiration.

events.name: Treasure hunting in a bookshop tucked away in a deep alley
events.description: Then they strolled to Zhongshan Middle Road, where a tiny old bookstore made Sun Yuwei stop for a long time. She eventually found a West Lake photography collection published in the 1980s and treasured it like a gem.

events.name: Selected and mailed out a Mother's Day gift.
events.description: In the afternoon, accompanied by Fang Qing, she bought freshly baked flower cakes at Zhiweiguan, then picked out the essay collection “Here and Now” at a bookstore, wrapped it personally in gift paper, and attached a card: “Mom, when I return, we'll arrange fresh flowers together. Happy holiday.” Afterwards, she went to an SF Express outlet and sent it to her home in Kunming.

events.name: Dinner with Fang Qing.
events.description: At dinner, the two shared Hangzhou cuisine at a vegetarian restaurant in Lakeside Intime, talking about their aspirations and uncertainties about freelancing. Before parting, Fang Qing gave her a set of local journaling stickers, and they agreed to plan another cultural trip next year.

events.name: Evening WeChat chat with mother
events.description: Back at the youth hostel, she sent her mother a voice message, pretending to be very tired and wanting to sleep, without mentioning the gift. Her mother reminded her to be mindful of the weather changes.

start_state.mood: Excitement mixed with longing for her mother.

end_state.mood: The Warmth of Friendship

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga 25 minutes + walking about 13,000 steps

2025-05.daily_overview: An extremely productive day: after morning yoga, Sun Yuwei discussed remotely with her advisor by West Lake and submitted the final version of her thesis, bringing her academic task to an end; in the afternoon, she visited the fine arts academy and a book bar; in the evening, she successfully booked a National Day family portrait shoot; at night, she chatted with travelers at the youth hostel.

events.name: Morning Yoga by West Lake
events.description: At 6:30, she kept practicing yoga at the same spot by West Lake, added balancing poses, recorded a short video, and posted it on Xiaohongshu with the caption “Completed the fifth day of practice in the West Lake morning light.”

events.name: Prepare to meet the instructor at the pavilion by West Lake.
events.description: At 8:00, she took her laptop to a pavilion near Bai Causeway, connected to the mobile Wi-Fi provided by the youth hostel, opened the paper draft and the advisor’s annotation file, and waited quietly for the video call to begin.

events.name: Discussed the paper remotely with the supervisor.
events.description: At exactly 9 o'clock, the WeChat video call with advisor Wu Mingyuan connected. They discussed the chapters one by one. The advisor affirmed the overall framework and only suggested a few wording improvements for the final chapter. She kept her head down and quickly took notes. The video call lasted about 30 minutes.

events.name: Revise and submit the final draft
events.description: After the discussion, she immediately revised the text in the pavilion, adjusted three sentences in the conclusion, regenerated the PDF, logged into the school's thesis submission system, and uploaded it. When the successful submission page appeared, she took a screenshot and sent it to her advisor, who quickly replied, "Final version done, congratulations." At this point, the entire academic process of the thesis, from proposal to final draft, was officially concluded.

events.name: China Academy of Art and Nanshan Bookstore
events.description: In the afternoon, she went to the Xiangshan Campus of the China Academy of Art and visited the Folk Art Museum, drawn by the bamboo shadows and light in Kengo Kuma's architecture; afterward she walked to Nanshan Bookstore and purchased Records of Jiangnan Gardens and an old book about Shaoxing culture.

events.name: Booked a family portrait by phone
events.description: In the evening I cycled to Bai Causeway. In the twilight, I called that retro Republic-era photo studio in Kunming, talked through the package details in depth, and finally settled on a slot for the morning of October 3. I paid a 300 yuan deposit via WeChat Pay and sent a screenshot of the booking confirmation text to the family group chat.

events.name: Socializing at the youth hostel.
events.description: Back in the hostel's common area, she chatted with a freelance illustrator from Guangzhou about their impressions of Hangzhou, exchanged Weibo handles, and didn't return to her room until late at night.

end_state.mood: The Joy of Relief

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga 25 minutes + cycling 40 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Hangzhou: sunny with occasional clouds; Shaoxing: sunny

2025-05.daily_overview: On Mother's Day, after early-morning yoga, Sun Yuwei had a warm video call with her mother. Then she took a high-speed train to Shaoxing, drew inspiration at Lu Xun Native Place, and conceived a new essay on the spot. In the evening, she returned to Hangzhou.

events.name: Last morning yoga by the West Lake
events.description: At 6:30, she came to West Lake for the last time, completed a Sun Salutation practice, recorded a full video, and posted a summary post for the "Poetry and Distance" series on Xiaohongshu, looking back on the five-day journey of cultivating herself alongside mountains and water.

events.name: Mother's Day video call
events.description: At 8 o'clock, she made a WeChat video call. When her mother, Li Xiulan, answered, she was fiddling with the flower cakes Yuwei had sent home. The two chatted and laughed for half an hour. Her mother held up the phone to show the flowers already arranged in a vase and said, "It's wonderful to have a daughter like you." Sun Yuwei's eyes grew a little moist.

events.name: Take the high-speed rail to Shaoxing to visit Lu Xun's former residence
events.description: After checking out at 9, she took the metro to Hangzhou East Station, then a high-speed train for about 40 minutes to Shaoxing North. She transferred to a bus and arrived at Lu Xun's Hometown, and had fennel beans and braised pork with preserved mustard greens for lunch at Xianheng Hotel.

events.name: Inspiration from the Hundred-Plant Garden and the Three-Flavor Study
events.description: Throughout the afternoon, she lingered at Lu Xun's Former Residence, crouching by the base of the mud wall in Baicao Garden to touch the damp brick crevices, imagining childhood under the honey locust tree. She used her phone to record the sound of oars cutting through water from a black-awning boat, and in her memo app quickly drafted an outline for a prose essay, "The Rebirth from Baicao Garden to Sanwei Study."

events.name: Remembering the Past at Shen Garden.
events.description: Before dusk, she walked to Shen Garden and stood for a long time in front of the Phoenix Hairpin stele. The story of Lu You and Tang Wan came to mind, and she wrote in her journal: “Deep feeling and helplessness, a silent film of time.”

events.name: Returned to the new youth hostel in Hangzhou
events.description: After dark, she took a high-speed train back to Hangzhou and checked into another youth hostel near the Southern Song Imperial Street to experience a different atmosphere. In the evening, she sorted through the photos taken in Shaoxing and tucked a fallen leaf picked up from the Hundred-Plant Garden into the pages of the book she was carrying.

start_state.mood: Reluctant to leave, but looking forward to a new chapter

end_state.location: Another youth hostel room in Hangzhou
end_state.mood: Inspiration struck

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga 25 minutes + nearly 20,000 steps walking in Shaoxing

date_attribute.weather: Hangzhou: overcast turning to light rain; Kunming: cloudy.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the last day of the trip, Sun Yuwei did yoga by West Lake one last time, then went to the airport and returned to Kunming by plane. In the afternoon, her parents picked her up at the airport and went home. In the evening, she sorted through the gifts and souvenirs she had brought back.

events.name: Last morning yoga session at West Lake
events.description: At 6:30, she insisted on going to the usual spot and, in the fine drizzle, completed seated meditation and stretching, recording the last segment of footage. She posted on Xiaohongshu: Six days, six mornings; West Lake witnessed my breathing. Returning to the nest.

events.name: Checked out and headed to the airport
events.description: After breakfast, she packed up and carefully put away the three books and the mirrorless camera. She checked out at 10 o'clock, took the subway to Xiaoshan Airport, and bought a magazine at a bookstore while waiting for her flight.

events.name: Flight and airport pickup
events.description: The flight took off at 1 p.m. and arrived in Kunming shortly after 4. When she walked out of the arrivals hall, she saw her father and mother waiting together in the distance. She quickened her pace, went up and hugged them. Her father took her suitcase, and her mother held her hand and smiled.

events.name: Homecoming Gift and Dinner
events.description: After arriving home, she took out the West Lake Longjing tea and silk scarves for her parents. Her mother immediately tied one around her neck to try it. Dinner was crossing-the-bridge rice noodles specially made by her mother. While eating, she talked about the architecture of Xiaoshu Library, the stickers Fang Qing had given her, and the mud wall base in Baicao Garden.

events.name: Packing up luggage and souvenirs
events.description: After dinner, she put the laundry into the washing machine, spread the fallen leaves, bookmarks, and tickets brought back from Shaoxing on the desk, took a deep breath, and felt the lingering flavor of the trip slowly settle.

end_state.mood: The warmth of going home.

state.daily_exercise: Morning yoga 25 minutes + airport walk

2025-05.daily_overview: On her first day back in Kunming, Sun Yuwei stayed home all day organizing travel materials: selecting yoga photos, importing photos and audio, making a highlight journal, building momentum for creative work, and resuming her daily yoga practice.

events.name: Organizing travel photos and audio
events.description: After waking up naturally in the morning, she imported all the photos from her camera and phone into the computer and created folders categorized as "Hangzhou West Lake," "Xiaoshu Library," and "Shaoxing." At the same time, she used Audacity to edit the sounds of oars and birdsong recorded in Shaoxing, saving them as a separate audio track.

events.name: Publish yoga compilation and Xiaohongshu summary
events.description: She selected yoga photos from the six days, arranged them into a 3x3 grid with a photo-editing app, and posted them on Xiaohongshu with a long reflective post, looking back on each practice that resonated with the landscape. Fans left comments saying, "It's like a poetic documentary."

events.name: Making a Jiangnan travel journal
events.description: In the afternoon, she spread out her Traveler's Notebook, arranged and pasted the pre-printed photos, tickets, stickers from Fang Qing, and fallen leaves from Shaoxing one by one, drew the ripples of West Lake and a black-awning boat with watercolor pens, and wrote down the mood of each moment on every page.

events.name: Resume yoga practice.
events.description: In the evening, she spread out her mat at home and followed a shoulder-and-neck relaxation sequence video sent by He Lu for 30 minutes, alleviating the stiffness from flying and long periods of sitting.

events.name: Family projector sharing
events.description: After dinner, she cast photos from her phone to the TV to show her parents her favorite photos from the trip. When she talked about imagining Lu Xun's childhood at Baicaoyuan in Shaoxing, her mother said, "You've been like this since you were little—especially sensitive to literary scenes."

end_state.mood: Satisfied

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes of yoga

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, with brief showers in the afternoon.

2025-05.daily_overview: Sun Yuwei's literary inspiration flowed. In the morning she finished writing the essay "Shadow of Lake and Mountain," feeling she had broken through in her writing; in the afternoon she received her Mandarin proficiency certificate, and the family shared in the joy; in the evening she planned topics for her column, feeling fulfilled and happy.

events.name: Wrote the prose piece 'The Shadow of Lake and Mountain'
events.description: At 9 a.m., she sat down at her desk and, with the Mid-Lake Pavilion, Solitary Hill, and misty rain of West Lake as her backdrop, incorporated the clarity and tranquility they brought her into her writing. She wrote continuously for about three hours. After finishing, she read it aloud and felt it was delicate and vivid, breaking through her previous style.

events.name: Received the Mandarin certificate
events.description: At noon, the courier delivered her Mandarin proficiency test certificate. After signing for it and opening it, she saw 'Grade 2, Level A' on the score report, with scores for the reading aloud and speaking sections close to Grade 1, Level B, and felt a surge of relief and satisfaction.

events.name: Sharing the Certificate in the Family Group Chat
events.description: She took a photo of the certificate and sent it to the “Sun Family Home” group chat, adding “Got it!” Her mother replied instantly, “Awesome! Now you'll have more confidence for cultural programs in the future,” and her sister sent three thumbs-up emojis.

events.name: Afternoon tea listening to the rain
events.description: In the afternoon, a sudden rain pattered against the window. She brewed a cup of Longjing tea brought back from Hangzhou, leaned against the bay window in her study, and while listening to the rain, recorded two small achievements of the day in her journal.

events.name: Plan the topic for the "Kunming Slices" column
events.description: In the evening, she turned on her computer and, drawing on the reflections from the Shaoxing trip, planned a cultural column topic in a new document: "Cultural Root-Seeking of Contemporary Young People — Starting from Visits to Former Residences in Various Places." She wrote down candidate interviewees and an illustration plan, and prepared to submit it to editor Xu Mingyuan.

end_state.mood: Grateful and content

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of stretching after waking up

2025-05.daily_overview: Another day of productive writing: Sun Yuwei finished the essay 'The Storyteller's Shaoxing' and continued working on her travel journal. In the evening, she discussed details of the family portrait outfits with her sister, and the family began preparing for summer heat relief.

events.name: Writing the essay 'The Storyteller's Shaoxing'.
events.description: In the morning, using the material she had recorded in Shaoxing as a starting point and featuring the local black-awning boats, an old teahouse, and an imagined storyteller as the main thread, she completed an essay full of a sense of immediacy. She read it aloud twice and adjusted the rhythm of the penultimate paragraph.

events.name: Complete the finishing touches on the Jiangnan travel journal
events.description: Afterwards, she pasted the last postcards collected during the trip and a leaf from Shen Garden into her journal. On the last page, she wrote in brush calligraphy, "To the Jiangnan we will finally return to," then closed the notebook and gently patted its cover.

events.name: The family kicked off the seasonal transition to summer.
events.description: In the afternoon, her mother, Li Xiulan, took out summer quilts from the storage room and cleaned the air conditioner filters in the living room and master bedroom; Sun Yuwei took down the heavy curtains in the study, replaced them with bamboo blinds, and stored away the family's winter cotton slippers. Her father also helped wipe down the floor fan.

events.name: Discuss outfits for the family portrait with my older sister.
events.description: At 8 p.m., she had a video call with her sister, first showing the food photos from the Jiangnan trip in her journal, then got down to business. Her sister shared several pictures of Republic-era qipao and Zhongshan suit outfit ideas found online. The two agreed on a color scheme mainly of lotus-root pink and light gray. Her sister suggested buying a few pieces to try on first.

events.name: Evening reading.
events.description: Before going to sleep, she opened her Kindle and read a collection of short stories about Hangzhou. Paper was replaced by the screen, and travel memories surfaced again.

end_state.mood: Warm anticipation

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute evening walk.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the early morning, she completed a set of Sun Salutations on her yoga mat to start the new day. In the morning, she revised the draft of her essay 'The Shadow of Lake and Mountain' at home and received a WeChat message from her advisor Wu Mingyuan asking about the progress of her defense PPT. In the afternoon, she went to Mingyuan Bookstore to chat with Qin Mingyuan about the newly arrived magazine 'Southwest Folkways' and brought back a bunch of eucalyptus leaves. In the evening, she accompanied her mother to the market to shop. When she got home and was organizing the refrigerator, she noticed her shoulders and neck were a bit stiff.

events.name: Morning yoga
events.description: Got up at 6:45 and practiced yoga on the balcony for 40 minutes, focusing on stretching the neck, shoulders, and spine.

events.name: Revise the essay draft.
events.description: Rewrite the passage about the morning mist on Dianchi Lake in The Shadow of Lake and Mountain according to editor Xu Mingyuan's annotations, cutting redundant metaphors and strengthening the visual imagery.

events.name: Contact mentor
events.description: Professor Wu Mingyuan sent a voice message, reminding that the defense PPT should highlight the originality of the fieldwork and suggesting adding photos and oral citations from interviews with independent bookstores.

events.name: Sit a while at the bookstore
events.description: At Mingyuan Bookstore, while browsing the newly arrived Southwest Folkways magazine, Qin Mingyuan shared a report about old residential houses in Jianshui, which inspired a topic for a future column.

events.name: Family shopping.
events.description: In the evening, I went to Zhuanxin Farmers' Market with my mother, Li Xiulan, to buy groceries. We bought fresh mushrooms and mint, planning to make soup in the weekend.

start_state.mood: Calm but slightly grumpy from waking up

end_state.mood: Slightly anxious, with tight shoulders and neck

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, she had a video call with her roommates in the dormitory WeChat group and listened to Zhao Xiaowen talk about funny internship stories in Dali. In the afternoon, she held a small journal-sharing gathering with her close friends Zhang Jing and Chen Sisi at a cafe by Cuihu Lake. The three exchanged stickers and collaged a journal page for "Morning on Wenlin Street." After returning home in the evening, she organized the interview recordings for her column piece and found a clip of an old craftsman humming folk songs, deciding to use it as an element in the final draft.

events.name: Dormitory group video call
events.description: At 10:30, she had a video call with Liu Jia, Zhao Xiaowen, and Zhou Lin to share their graduation preparation progress, and they agreed to reunite after the defense in June.

events.name: Journal sharing session.
events.description: At the Chunxiao Cafe by Green Lake at 2 p.m., Zhang Jing brought newly bought washi tape, Chen Sisi showed the handmade paper she had made herself. The three of them drank tea and decorated their journals until five o'clock.

events.name: Organizing interview recordings.
events.description: In the evening, I put on my earphones and listened again to the recorded interview with Master Zhou, an old craftsman, and marked the folk song passage to use as the opening of the article.

end_state.mood: Inspiration surging, slightly excited

2025-05.daily_overview: Early in the morning, I accompanied my father Sun Mingyuan to Wuhua District Library to return books, and also borrowed 'A History of Yunnan Folk Music Collection' for background research for my column. After lunch, I stayed home alone working on the first draft of the defense PPT, turning field photos and interviewee quotes into a timeline. At 4 p.m., shoulder and neck pain flared up, and I tried to relieve it with a hot compress and neck rehabilitation yoga. In the evening, I received a WeChat message from editor Xu Mingyuan asking about the final draft of 'Morning Life on Wenlin Street'.

events.name: Library visit
events.description: Drive my father to the library. He reads newspapers in the periodicals room, while I find a mimeographed booklet of early folk singers in the local documents room, check it out, and photocopy it.

events.name: Make the defense presentation slides
events.description: At the desk in the bedroom, use Keynote to create an outline, insert interview photos of Qin Mingyuan, Master Zhou, and others, and adjust the animation order.

events.name: Shoulder and neck pain flare-up
events.description: After working with her head lowered for a long time, her neck suddenly twinged and her left shoulder was stiff. She applied a hot water bottle for 15 minutes and began trying neck rehabilitation yoga for the first time, slowly doing moves such as lateral neck flexion and subtle chin tucks.

events.name: Editor urging manuscript submission
events.description: In the evening, Xu Mingyuan sent a message saying the deadline is next week and he hoped to see the revised draft as soon as possible. Sun Yuwei replied, promising to submit the manuscript by Wednesday.

end_state.mood: Neck and shoulder pain; tired but with a clear plan

state.daily_exercise: Neck rehabilitation yoga for 15 minutes, walking for 30 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, I went to school in the rain to submit the graduate registration form. In the teaching building, I ran into Professor Wu Mingyuan, who suggested cutting the defense presentation down to 15 minutes. After the rain stopped at noon, I sat on a campus bench eating bread and recalled the past four years. In the afternoon, I returned home and received a call from the community hospital saying the HPV vaccine had arrived, and I made an appointment for Wednesday morning. In the evening, I continued revising my column article, embedding the folk song lyrics into the opening to create atmosphere.

events.description: Went to the college office to submit the graduate registration form, degree application, and other materials, and confirmed the defense date is June 3 at 8:30 a.m.

events.name: Chance encounter with mentor
events.description: She met Professor Wu Mingyuan in the corridor of the School of Humanities. He looked through the defense PPT screenshots stored on her phone and reminded her not to exceed the time limit for the opening.

events.name: HPV vaccination appointment confirmed
events.description: At 2 p.m., she received a call from the Wuhua District Community Health Service Center, saying that the nine-valent HPV vaccine had arrived and recommending that she get the first dose this week. She checked the calendar on her phone, found that she had no other plans on Wednesday, and so made an appointment for Wednesday morning.

events.name: Revise the column draft.
events.description: In the evening, write the four lines of the mountain song “Horse Driving Tune” from the interview recording at the beginning of the draft, and contact Xu Mingyuan to let him know that the deadline has been moved up to Tuesday.

end_state.mood: The sense of ease after completing a task.

In the afternoon, she attended the third session of the online nonfiction writing workshop, which covered "constructing tension in scenes," and actively interacted in the chat. After class, she quickly cooked herself a bowl of crossing-the-bridge rice noodles as a treat. At nine in the evening, she opened her computer to polish the defense PPT and inserted the corresponding audio clips.

events.name: Submitted the column manuscript
events.description: Sent the finalized column article and personal statement to editor Xu Mingyuan, and got his instant thumbs-up emoji reply.

events.name: Online workshop course
events.description: At 2:30, she joined a Tencent Meeting and listened to the speaker analyze the mise-en-scène of Chekhov's “The Steppe.” She completed the in-class writing exercise and received feedback from the instructor.

events.name: Finalized the defense PPT
events.description: Add an acknowledgments page at the end of the PPT, and adjust the color tones of all images to be uniformly warm-toned. Edit the folk song audio to 20 seconds and insert it as the intro sound.

start_state.mood: Anticipation with a hint of nervousness

end_state.mood: Tired but satisfied after deep concentration
