2025-05.daily_overview: After waking up, my shoulders and neck still ached faintly, so I decided to make daily rehabilitation yoga a fixed routine. In the morning I went to the community health service center to get the first dose of the HPV vaccine. While waiting for observation, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saw photos of a Kunming morning taken by a photographer; a flash of inspiration struck and I wanted to write a column. In the afternoon I went home, spread the yoga mat by the floor-to-ceiling window in the living room, and after half an hour of practice my shoulders and neck felt much lighter. In the evening, Xu Mingyuan sent revision comments with a positive assessment of the manuscript, marking only three factual details that needed to be verified.

events.name: Get HPV vaccine
events.description: At 9 o'clock, I went to the community hospital, filled out the form, paid, and then got the 9-valent HPV vaccine. I stayed for 30 minutes of observation with no discomfort. The nurse told me to avoid spicy food and keep the injection site dry for 24 hours.

events.name: Editor feedback
events.description: In the evening, Xu Mingyuan sent the review draft via Shimo Docs, with an overall comment: 'The writing has a clear, unobstructed flow; the use of the folk song is a stroke of genius. Please verify Master Zhou's apprenticeship years and the name of the folk song.'

events.name: Rehab yoga training
events.description: Spread the yoga mat in the living room and do left and right neck side bends, scapular retraction, Cat-Cow Pose, and Child's Pose, holding each movement for five breaths.

start_state.mood: Neck and shoulder discomfort, but feeling energetic.

end_state.mood: Joy of being recognized; physical comfort recovered.

state.daily_exercise: 25 minutes of rehabilitation yoga

2025-05.daily_overview: On the thunderous morning, I practiced breathing exercises on the yoga mat to ease my anxiety about the defense. In the morning, I revised those three details again based on the editor's feedback and called Master Zhou to confirm the apprenticeship year. In the afternoon, as rain poured down, I was stuck at home fixing the final formatting of my graduation thesis. I happened to come across a writing exercise from my sophomore year, and comparing it with my current style made me quite sentimental. In the evening, the rain stopped, and I went to the Cainiao Station to pick up the travel storage bags I had ordered, preparing for the National Day family trip.

events.name: Verify details
events.description: Called Master Zhou on his mobile phone to confirm that he started as an apprentice at age 12 and that the official name of the folk song is Horse Caravan Tune. While at it, chatted for over ten more minutes about the current state of handicraft inheritance.

events.name: Revise the final draft's formatting.
events.description: Adjusted line spacing, fonts, and reference order according to the school's thesis template, and changed the citation style from MLA to GB/T 7714.

events.name: Preparing for the National Day trip.
events.description: After getting the storage bags back, she organized several parent-child outfit links for family trips in her Taobao favorites, planning to select them with her mother on the weekend.

start_state.mood: Woken by thunder, feeling a bit dazed.

end_state.mood: A quiet rainy night, a peaceful heart

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, after reading the final manuscript through once more and sending it to Xu Mingyuan, I officially finalized "The Morning Haze of Wenlin Street." Feeling lighthearted, I gave myself half a day off. At noon, I went alone to my usual Sanyi Bookstore, where I found a copy of "The Way of Flowers" by Japanese author Ikenobo Senshu, and also bought a brown-sugar pearl milk tea. In the afternoon, I opened my dusty ikebana tools and, following the Rikka arrangement style in the book, tried to create a work with eucalyptus leaves and lisianthus. In the evening, when my mother came home from work, she praised it and said it was beautiful, then promised to take me to Dounan Flower Market on the weekend to choose a flower vase.

events.name: Column finalized
events.description: Received a WeChat message from the editor confirming the final draft, with the layout scheduled for next Monday and the payment to be issued together with next month's column.

events.name: A chance discovery at the bookstore
events.description: At the new arrivals table in Sanyi Bookstore, she found The Way of Flowers, a classic introduction to the Ikenobo school. Feeling as if she had found a treasure, she bought it immediately.

events.name: Flower Arranging at Home
events.description: Took out the old bamboo flower vessel left by her mother, trimmed the branches and leaves, completed a simple rikka arrangement, and placed it on the dining table.

start_state.mood: A feeling of relief and ease.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and happy.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, took the subway with her mother Li Xiulan to Dounan Flower Market. Amid the crowds, she picked out a terracotta-colored wide-mouth flower vase and a bunch of double-petaled sunflowers. After lunch, hurried to Mingyuan Bookstore for the tea-and-book gathering at 2 p.m. This time the theme was Kunming Dialect and Urban Memory, with participants including nearby residents, two professors from Yunnan Normal University, and an old gentleman who sings Yunnan opera. Sun Yuwei shared her experience of using dialect in her column. After the gathering, Qin Mingyuan asked her to stay and help organize the bookshelves, and she found a stack of old Kunming maps from the Republic of China period. In the evening, she carried the vase home, and on the way bought two ice pops to reward herself.

events.name: Shopping at Dounan Flower Market
events.description: The mother and daughter browsed for two hours and bought flower containers, sunflowers, a bundle of eucalyptus leaves, and dried baby's breath. The mother paid, saying it was a gift to celebrate her daughter's coming-of-age ceremony.

events.name: Mingyuan Bookstore tea and book gathering
events.description: The activity ran from 2:30 to 4:00. Everyone read poems in their dialects and talked about games from childhood. Sun Yuwei introduced the origin of the word “xiliu” in Morning Fireworks on Wenlin Street. After the event, while tidying the bookshelves with Qin Mingyuan, she found several Kunming maps from 1934 and borrowed three of them as supplementary appendices for her graduation thesis.

events.name: Old map discovery
events.description: With Qin Mingyuan, she dragged a dusty cardboard box from the bottom shelf of the ancient books bookcase. When they unrolled the map, they discovered the names of city gate towers and streets that no longer existed, and they got very excited.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the weekend event.

end_state.mood: Excited and a little tired; stayed up late shooting for the map record

2025-05.daily_overview: I slept in until 9:30 and was woken by a video call from my older sister Sun Yutang. We chatted for almost an hour, and she said she would fly back from Shenzhen for National Day to take a family portrait. After hanging up, I ate a bowl of leftover tofu pudding rice noodles from last night and started polishing my defense presentation script at the computer, weaving the place names “Luosiwan” and “Outside Xiaoxi Gate” from the old map I found yesterday into the narrative to add a sense of historical depth. At 4 p.m. the neighborhood lost power, so I moved a chair to the balcony and read the newly bought “The Way of Flowers,” jotting down several floral arrangement insights for next week's journal material. After the power came back in the evening, I watched a documentary about the old city of Kunming, and before bed I did a set of shoulder and neck rehabilitation exercises.

events.name: Video call with older sister
events.description: Elder sister Sun Yutong video-called, complaining that Shenzhen had failed to enter summer again, asked in detail about the graduation defense, and promised to have a custom cheongsam made for her younger sister for the family photo.

events.name: Revised the defense presentation.
events.description: Using the newly discovered historical map, add the sentence 'Luosi Bay was once the shoreline of Dianchi Lake; the memories of old craftsmen are attached to these vanished waterfront lines' to the statement.

events.name: Reading during a power outage
events.description: On the balcony, I speed-read The Way of Flowers in natural light, marking the chapter "Author Xiaoyuan Cang's 'Thrown-in Style'" and wanted to invite Su Man to practice it.

start_state.mood: Satisfaction after a full night's sleep.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling but tinged with longing.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, she took her laptop to the Yunnan University library and, in the current-periodicals reading room on the second floor, looked up discussions of Kunming’s old streets in the journal Human Geography to add to the theoretical part of her graduation thesis. At noon, while eating fried Ersi noodles in the school cafeteria, she received a layout link for her column article from Xu Mingyuan. Seeing that the end of the article was paired with a photo she had taken of a breakfast shop on Wenlin Street, she happily forwarded it to the family group. In the afternoon, she saw the defense grouping and schedule on the college bulletin board: she was the first in Group 3, at 8:30 a.m. on June 3. When she got home in the evening, she thoroughly cleaned the room, sorted and recycled the draft paper piled up over that period, and her desk instantly felt fresh and clutter-free.

events.name: Library research
events.description: Found three papers mentioning changes in Kunming's streets and alleys, copied key passages, and entered them into EndNote.

events.name: Received the layout link.
events.description: The editor sent a webpage preview, and the reading experience was good. She shared the link to her WeChat Moments and received quite a few likes.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, she practiced her thesis defense presentation at home and recorded it twice on her phone, finding that she spoke too quickly and her eyes wandered. In the afternoon, she attended the fourth session of the writing workshop, themed 'The "I" in Nonfiction.' A classmate sharply pointed out that 'the author intervenes too much.' Sun Yuwei reflected on the tone of her column and started a discussion in the group chat after class. In the evening, she took He Lu's yin yoga class at Jingxin Yoga Studio, thoroughly relaxing her shoulders and neck with long stretches. Afterward, the two chatted about their work frustrations at the milk tea shop next door. events.name: Mock defense
events.description: Practiced twice in front of the mirror, recorded with Voice Memos on the iPhone, found that the transition between the second and fourth paragraphs was stiff, and revised the transitional sentences.

events.name: Workshop session and discussion.
events.description: After the online course ended, I had a text-based debate with group members in the WeChat group about the boundaries of using 'I', and we eventually reached a consensus: allow the 'observer self' and avoid the 'judging self'.

events.name: Yin Yoga Class
events.description: He Lu taught the class, focusing on the transition from Downward Dog to Child's Pose, and added neck rotations. After class, the two discussed the anxiety of freelancing instability.

events.name: Rushing to finish writing homework.
events.description: Set against the clock shop at Zhuanxin Farmers' Market, write a dialogue between a watch repairman and a vegetable vendor, 2,000 words, submit at 1 a.m.

end_state.mood: Extremely tired but satisfied with completing a fine piece of work

2025-05.daily_overview: Because she had stayed up late the previous night, she struggled to get up this morning and did not wake up groggy until 8:30. After quickly eating a few crackers, she held on until 10 o'clock and went to the community hospital to pick up her vaccination record to use for requesting leave for the thesis defense. The entire afternoon was spent planning the schedule around the defense date in her journal: May 31, print the final thesis and PPT; June 1, go to school to scout the location; June 2, final rehearsal; June 3, the actual defense. In the evening, she emailed her advisor with the final version of the presentation speech. He quickly replied with a correction: change the starting station of the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway to Kunming North Station. She went to bed at 10 with lavender essential oil diffusing, but tossed and turned and did not fall asleep until after 11.

events.name: Collect vaccination record.
events.description: At the community hospital, I presented the immunization certificate, and the doctor reminded me that the second shot should be two months later.

events.name: Journal planning
events.description: Using a four-color ballpoint pen, she drew a countdown on the weekly page and marked the daily tasks: printing, scouting the venue, rehearsal, outfit, breakfast... down to the minute.

events.name: Email communication with supervisor
events.description: Sent the V3 version of the statement draft. Professor Wu pointed out the historical error in 'the starting station of the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway' and it was promptly corrected.

end_state.mood: Went to bed early but had trouble falling asleep.

2025-05.daily_overview: In the morning, she did her final full rehearsal of the defense, with her mother as the audience and filming. During review, she noticed her body language was stiff and she smiled too little. Her mother suggested she 'just treat it as pitching a new topic to an editor.' At noon, she copied the PPT to a USB drive and backed it up to cloud storage. In the afternoon, she went to Mingyuan Bookstore to return the map. Qin Mingyuan treated her to a cup of freshly roasted Mandheling coffee, and they talked about the viewpoint in her thesis of bookstores as a 'third space'. He suggested holding a small exhibition during the summer vacation. After returning home in the evening, she prepared the gifts to bring for tomorrow's Dragon Boat Festival — flower cakes for her grandmother and a dried mushroom gift box for her cousin, and ironed the white shirt she would wear to tomorrow afternoon's gathering. Before bed, she checked the alarm times for the defense day one more time: 5:50, 6:10, 6:30.

events.name: Final defense rehearsal
events.description: Standing in the living room, she started the timer and finished the presentation in 15 minutes 20 seconds. Her mother pointed out three slips of the tongue and demonstrated the technique of "looking at the judges' nose bridge while speaking."

events.name: Return the map
events.description: Put plastic protective covers on the four old Kunming maps she had borrowed and returned them to the bookstore. Discussed the exhibition concept with Qin Mingyuan: presenting independent bookstores as carriers of urban memory.

events.name: Prepare Dragon Boat Festival gifts
events.description: Put the dried flowers brought back from Dounan into a kraft paper bag, and packed the time-honored flower cakes her grandmother loves and the matsutake mushrooms her cousin mentioned last year.

end_state.mood: The calm of everything being prepared.

state.daily_exercise: A 1-hour round trip on foot to the bookstore

2025-05.daily_overview: On the Dragon Boat Festival morning, she was awakened by the fragrance of zongzi; her mother had already cooked a pot of alkaline zongzi and red bean paste zongzi. After breakfast, the family video-called her sister far away in Shenzhen. She had tied her newly dyed red hair into a bun and said, "Graduation day must be grand." In the morning, she went with her mother to her grandmother's house to deliver festival gifts, and watched a small dragon boat race by the Panlong River. In the afternoon, she attended the Dragon Boat Festival poetry gathering at Mingyuan Bookstore. She recited "Morning on Wenlin Street" in Kunming dialect, winning a burst of applause. Qin Mingyuan announced that next month's exhibition would be on July 12. Returning home in the evening, she ironed and hung up her defense outfit. After checking all the documents, she wrote in her gratitude journal, "Thank you for every blessing I received today." Before bed, she did 10 minutes of abdominal breathing. As she closed her eyes, the scale showed 44.8, slightly more than at the beginning of the month, but the face in the mirror was even more radiant.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival family breakfast.
events.description: Her father unwrapped a salted egg yolk zongzi, and her mother specially made a low-sugar red bean paste zongzi for her.

events.name: Video call with older sister
events.description: Sister Sun Yutong showed off her newly done red highlights in a WeChat video call and promised to take annual leave in July and return to Kunming to host the exhibition opening together.

events.name: Visiting Grandmother
events.description: Talked with her maternal grandparents in the living room for an hour. Grandma pressed a protective charm into her hand and told her not to be nervous about the defense.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival dragon boat race viewing
events.description: Passing by the Panlong River, she stopped to watch a folk dragon boat team race, with the sound of gongs and drums filling the air, and also tried cold rice noodles from a roadside stall.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival poetry gathering at Mingyuan Bookstore
events.description: At 3 p.m., more than twenty people sat in a circle in the bookstore’s backyard, reciting poems related to the Dragon Boat Festival or Kunming. She read her own passage in the local dialect, and the grandmother next to her praised her, saying it sounded like ‘an old Kunming cultural-radio broadcast.’

events.name: Pre-defense preparation
events.description: Hang the black graduation gown, white shirt, and document folder behind the bedroom door, and set three consecutive alarms. Record today's warm moments in the Moleskine gratitude journal.

start_state.mood: The happiness awakened by the fragrance of zongzi.

end_state.mood: Surrounded by love, calm and resolute.

state.daily_exercise: Walking (along Panlong River + before and after the poetry gathering) about 10,000 steps, 10 minutes of abdominal breathing before bed
